plot_acts.arg_en: Section 2 — Luther and eruption 1517-1555. Peace of Augsburg as terminus: an emperor's failure as the first domino of Catholic-universal dissolution.

brief.main: 加尔文与多元改革 —— 改革不是一次事件而是多国多派的并行过程。日内瓦 (1536-1564)、苏格兰 (Knox 1560)、英格兰 (Edward VI → Mary → Elizabeth 1559)、法国胡格诺 (1559 全国大会)、荷兰 (1566 破坏圣像)、瑞典 (1527 Västerås)、丹麦 (1536 哥本哈根) 同时发生。
brief.flow: 加尔文《基督教要义》(1536 → 1559 拉丁定本) 与日内瓦秩序 → Knox 与苏格兰 (1560 苏格兰 Confession of Faith) → Cranmer 与英格兰三《共同祈祷书》(1549、1552、1559) + 三十九条 (1563) → 法国 Huguenot 信仰告白 (1559) + 圣巴托罗缪 (1572) → 荷兰破坏圣像 (1566) 与八十年战争 (1568-1648) → 北欧的路德国家化。
brief.names: John Calvin、William Farel、Theodore Beza、John Knox、Thomas Cranmer、Hugh Latimer、Nicholas Ridley、Elizabeth I、Mary Tudor、Gaspard de Coligny、Catherine de Medici、William of Orange、Gustav Vasa、Christian III
brief.sources: 加尔文《Institutes》与日内瓦讲道、Knox《History of the Reformation in Scotland》、《共同祈祷书》各版、Foxe《殉道史》、法国 Huguenot 信仰告白、荷兰《Apologie》(1580)、宗教会议记录
brief.link: 把路德-加尔文-英国-北欧-东欧的多元改革并置 —— 拆掉任何单线宗教改革叙事。
brief.main_en: Calvin and the plural Reforms — the Reformation not a single event but a parallel process across many lands and camps. Geneva (1536-1564), Scotland (Knox 1560), England (Edward VI → Mary → Elizabeth 1559), the French Huguenots (the national synod 1559), the Netherlands (the iconoclasm 1566), Sweden (Västerås 1527), Denmark (Copenhagen 1536) all happening at once.
brief.flow_en: Calvin's Institutes (1536 → the 1559 Latin final) and the Geneva order → Knox and Scotland (the Scottish Confession of Faith 1560) → Cranmer and the English Book of Common Prayer in three editions (1549, 1552, 1559) plus the Thirty-Nine Articles (1563) → the French Huguenot confession of faith (1559) and St Bartholomew (1572) → the Dutch iconoclasm (1566) and the Eighty Years' War (1568-1648) → the nationalising of Lutheranism in Scandinavia.
brief.names_en: John Calvin, William Farel, Theodore Beza, John Knox, Thomas Cranmer, Hugh Latimer, Nicholas Ridley, Elizabeth I, Mary Tudor, Gaspard de Coligny, Catherine de Medici, William of Orange, Gustav Vasa, Christian III
brief.sources_en: Calvin's Institutes and Geneva sermons; Knox's History of the Reformation in Scotland; the editions of the Book of Common Prayer; Foxe's Acts and Monuments; the French Huguenot confession; the Dutch Apologie (1580); the synodal records
brief.link_en: Sets the plural reforms of Luther-Calvin-England-Scandinavia-Eastern Europe side by side — dismantling any single-line Reformation narrative.

plot_acts.zh: 16c.｜宇宙论、地图、异国情、宗教图像与反图像——欧洲人对世界的认知在两个世纪里的重塑。
plot_acts.en: 16th c.｜Cosmography, maps, exoticism, image and iconoclasm — Europe's cognitive reshaping.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第三节 —— 加尔文与多元改革 (1540s-1560s)。Greengrass 强调改革不是一次事件而是多国多派的并行过程 —— 日内瓦、苏格兰、英格兰、法国胡格诺、荷兰。
plot_acts.arg_en: Section 3 — Calvin and plural reformations. Reformation is simultaneous multi-country, multi-denominational: Geneva, Scotland, England, French Huguenots, Netherlands.

brief.main: 天主教的自我改革 —— Greengrass 拒绝 Counter-Reformation 术语，用 Catholic Reformation 呈现内在更新。依纳爵、阿维拉的德兰、十字若望、斐理伯·内里作为与新教改革者对等的正面塑造者。这一立场是英语学界 1990s 以来 (O'Malley、Prosperi) 的共识。
brief.flow: 天主教会内的早期改革 (Cajetan、Carafa/G Paul IV、Contarini) → 依纳爵《神操》(1548) 与耶稣会 (1540 立会、1547 Laynez、1556 依纳爵去世) → 特伦托公会议 (1545-1563) 的三段展开与教义定本 → 阿维拉的德兰 (1515-1582) 与加尔默罗改革 → 十字若望 (1542-1591) 的神秘神学 → 斐理伯·内里 (1515-1595) 与 Oratory → Borromeo 与米兰教省改革 → 罗马教理 (1566) 与《罗马课经》(1568/1570) → 耶稣会全球宣教 (沙勿略、范礼安、利玛窦)。
brief.names: Ignatius of Loyola、Francis Xavier、Peter Faber、Teresa of Ávila、John of the Cross、Philip Neri、Charles Borromeo、Carafa (Paul IV)、Contarini、Giberti、Sadolet、Pole、Morone、Seripando、Paleotti、Sirleto、Borromeo、Farnese (later Gregory XIV)、Laynez、La Mercuria
brief.sources: 依纳爵《神操》《自传》、Teresa《内心城堡》《灵心小史》(稍后)、John of the Cross《灵魂的黑夜》《灵歌》、Philip Neri 传记与语录、Borromeo《Instructiones Fabricae》、Trent 决议与教理、Jesuit Letters 与 Sinica、Roman Catechism
brief.link: 把天主教改革处理为与新教改革同等内在的更新运动 —— 为第四节的『Silver → Iron』转折做正反合的合题铺垫。
brief.main_en: Catholicism's self-reform — Greengrass rejects the term Counter-Reformation, using Catholic Reformation to present an inner renewal. Ignatius, Teresa of Ávila, John of the Cross, Philip Neri as positive shapers on a par with the Protestant reformers. This stance is the consensus of the English-speaking scholarship since the 1990s (O'Malley, Prosperi).
brief.flow_en: The early reform within the Catholic Church (Cajetan, Carafa / Paul IV, Contarini) → Ignatius's Spiritual Exercises (1548) and the Jesuits (founded 1540, Laynez 1547, Ignatius's death 1556) → the three-phase unfolding and doctrinal final of the Council of Trent (1545-1563) → Teresa of Ávila (1515-1582) and the Carmelite reform → John of the Cross (1542-1591) and mystical theology → Philip Neri (1515-1595) and the Oratory → Borromeo and the reform of the Milanese province → the Roman Catechism (1566) and the Roman Breviary/Missal (1568/1570) → the Jesuits' global mission (Xavier, Valignano, Ricci).
brief.names_en: Ignatius of Loyola, Francis Xavier, Peter Faber, Teresa of Ávila, John of the Cross, Philip Neri, Charles Borromeo, Carafa (Paul IV), Contarini, Giberti, Sadolet, Pole, Morone, Seripando, Paleotti, Sirleto, Borromeo, Farnese (later Gregory XIV), Laynez, La Mercuria
brief.sources_en: Ignatius's Spiritual Exercises and Autobiography; Teresa's Interior Castle and Life (later); John of the Cross's Dark Night of the Soul and Spiritual Canticle; Philip Neri's biographies and sayings; Borromeo's Instructiones Fabricae; the Trent decrees and catechism; the Jesuit Letters and Sinica; the Roman Catechism
brief.link_en: Treats the Catholic Reformation as an inner renewal movement equal to the Protestant one — paving the synthesis for the fourth section's 'Silver → Iron' turn.

plot_acts.zh: 1560s–1618｜法国宗教战争、尼德兰起义、西班牙无敌舰队、宗教内战的欧洲——一个体系在自我撕裂。
plot_acts.en: 1560s–1618｜French Wars of Religion, Dutch Revolt, Armada, continent-wide confessional war.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第四节 —— 天主教的自我改革 (1540s-1600s)。依纳爵、阿维拉的德兰、十字若望、斐理伯·内里 —— 作者拒绝 Counter-Reformation 术语，用 Catholic Reformation 呈现内在更新。
plot_acts.arg_en: Section 4 — Catholic self-reform. Loyola, Teresa of Ávila, John of the Cross, Philip Neri: 'Catholic Reformation' not 'Counter-Reformation' — internal renewal on its own terms.

brief.main: 全书方法论核心 —— 从 Silver Age 到 Iron Century。1500-1550 的伊拉斯谟式人文主义宽容-和解，如何被 1550-1600 的教派硬化吞没。这个论断使全书的重心从 1517 移到 1550。
brief.flow: Silver Age: Erasmus 的哲学王理想、More《乌托邦》(1516)、Reuchlin 的犹太研究、Sannazaro《Arcadia》、Castiglione《廷臣论》(1528)、Baldassare Peruzzi 与拉斐尔画派、Biblia Polyglotta (Alcalá 1514-1517、伦敦 1568-1573) → 1540s 之后：教派阵营化、Trent 定正统、日内瓦定正统、宗教裁判所普遍化、《禁书索引》(Pauline 1559、Tridentine 1564)、Ridley 与 Latimer 火刑、Servetus 日内瓦火刑 (1553)、圣巴托罗缪 (1572)、尼德兰血腥诏令 (1568)、Excommunication of Elizabeth (1570)、Armada (1588) → Iron Century 完成。
brief.names: Erasmus、Thomas More、Reuchlin、Castiglione、Sannazaro、Rabelais (过渡)、Montaigne (过渡)、Ronsard、Du Bellay、Lope de Vega、Ben Jonson、Shakespeare (晚期)；对立面：Loyola、Calvin、Trent 教父们、Philip II、Alba、Gregory XIII、Sixtus V、Clement VIII
brief.sources: Erasmus 书信全集、More《Utopia》《Responsio ad Lutherum》、Castiglione《Il Libro del Cortegiano》、Biblia 诸版本 (Alcalá、Geneva、King James、Luther 1534、Diodati)、Index Librorum Prohibitorum、Trent 会议决议、日内瓦 Consistoire 记录、Parlement de Paris 宗教判决档案
brief.link: 本节是全书的转折点 —— 从本节开始，一切和解可能都被教派硬化吞没，通向第五节的战争。
brief.main_en: The book's methodological core — from the Silver Age to the Iron Century. How the Erasmian humanist tolerance-reconciliation of 1500-1550 was swallowed by the confessional hardening of 1550-1600. This claim shifts the book's centre of gravity from 1517 to 1550.
brief.flow_en: Silver Age: Erasmus's philosopher-king ideal, More's Utopia (1516), Reuchlin's Jewish studies, Sannazaro's Arcadia, Castiglione's Courtier (1528), Baldassare Peruzzi and the Raphael school, the Biblia Polyglotta (Alcalá 1514-1517, London 1568-1573) → after the 1540s: confessional camping, Trent fixing orthodoxy, Geneva fixing orthodoxy, the generalising of the Inquisition, the Index of Forbidden Books (Pauline 1559, Tridentine 1564), the burnings of Ridley and Latimer, the burning of Servetus at Geneva (1553), St Bartholomew (1572), the Dutch Bloody Placards (1568), the excommunication of Elizabeth (1570), the Armada (1588) → the Iron Century completed.
brief.names_en: Erasmus, Thomas More, Reuchlin, Castiglione, Sannazaro, Rabelais (transitional), Montaigne (transitional), Ronsard, Du Bellay, Lope de Vega, Ben Jonson, Shakespeare (late); on the opposing side: Loyola, Calvin, the fathers of Trent, Philip II, Alba, Gregory XIII, Sixtus V, Clement VIII
brief.sources_en: Erasmus's complete letters; More's Utopia and Responsio ad Lutherum; Castiglione's Il Libro del Cortegiano; the various Bible editions (Alcalá, Geneva, King James, Luther 1534, Diodati); the Index Librorum Prohibitorum; the Trent decrees; the Geneva Consistory records; the religious-judgement archives of the Parlement de Paris
brief.link_en: This section is the book's turning point — from here every possibility of reconciliation is swallowed by confessional hardening, leading to the wars of the fifth section.

plot_acts.title_zh: 竞争中的基督教共同体
plot_acts.zh: 16c.–17c.｜哈布斯堡、瓦卢瓦、都铎-斯图亚特、瑞典-波兰-莫斯科——王权与信仰的复合体互相挤压。
plot_acts.en: 16th–17th c.｜Habsburg-Valois-Tudor-Stuart-Vasa-Jagiellon-Muscovy — crowns and faiths crushing each other.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第五节 —— 从 Silver Age 到 Iron Century。1550-1600 精神氛围的转折 —— 伊拉斯谟式人文主义的和解可能如何被教派硬化吞没。全书的方法论核心。
plot_acts.arg_en: Section 5 — from Silver Age to Iron Century. Erasmian possibility (1500-1550) swallowed by confessional hardening (1550-1600). The book's methodological core.

brief.main: 教派时代与宗教战争 —— 从 1555 奥格斯堡到 1618 白山战役的六十年。作者处理法国宗教战争 (1562-1598)、尼德兰八十年战争 (1568-1648)、英国宗教和解 (1559-1603)、法国南特敕令 (1598)、瑞典-波兰-俄国的教派政治、神圣罗马帝国内部的教派分化。
brief.flow: 法国八次宗教战争 (1562-1598) + 圣巴托罗缪之夜 (1572) + 三亨利之战 (1584-1589) + 南特敕令 (1598) → 尼德兰独立 (1566-1648) + Alba 恐怖统治 (1567-1573) + 西班牙无敌舰队 (1588) + 荷兰共和国成立 (1581 弃国书) → 英格兰 Elizabethan 宗教和解 (1559) + Mary Stuart (1587) + Armada (1588) → 苏格兰 (1560 → 1638 National Covenant) → 神圣罗马帝国内部 (Cologne 1583、Jülich-Kleve 1609-1614) → 波希米亚 1618 白山前夜。
brief.names: Catherine de Medici、Henry III、Henry IV、Guise、Coligny、Montaigne、Alba、Philip II、William the Silent、Maurice of Nassau、Elizabeth I、Mary Stuart、Leicester、Burghley、Walsingham、Raleigh、James VI & I、Rudolf II、Matthias、Ferdinand II、Bethlen Gábor
brief.sources: 法国宗教战争诸编年史 (de Thou、L'Estoile、d'Aubigné)、南特敕令原文、荷兰弃国书 (1581)、Armada 诸记、Raitzen 与 Jesuit Relation、Bacon《Essays》、Cervantes (同时代西班牙背景)
brief.link: 为第六节 (1618-1648 大屠杀) 铺路 —— 1618 白山不是新爆发，而是本节的顶点。
brief.main_en: The confessional age and the wars of religion — the sixty years from the 1555 Augsburg to the White Mountain of 1618. The author handles the French wars of religion (1562-1598), the Dutch Eighty Years' War (1568-1648), the English religious settlement (1559-1603), the French Edict of Nantes (1598), the confessional politics of Sweden-Poland-Russia, and the confessional division inside the Holy Roman Empire.
brief.flow_en: France's eight wars of religion (1562-1598) + the St Bartholomew's Day massacre (1572) + the War of the Three Henrys (1584-1589) + the Edict of Nantes (1598) → Dutch independence (1566-1648) + Alba's reign of terror (1567-1573) + the Spanish Armada (1588) + the founding of the Dutch Republic (the Act of Abjuration 1581) → Elizabeth's English religious settlement (1559) + Mary Stuart (1587) + the Armada (1588) → Scotland (1560 → the National Covenant 1638) → inside the Holy Roman Empire (Cologne 1583, Jülich-Kleve 1609-1614) → Bohemia on the eve of the White Mountain 1618.
brief.names_en: Catherine de Medici, Henry III, Henry IV, Guise, Coligny, Montaigne, Alba, Philip II, William the Silent, Maurice of Nassau, Elizabeth I, Mary Stuart, Leicester, Burghley, Walsingham, Raleigh, James VI & I, Rudolf II, Matthias, Ferdinand II, Bethlen Gábor
brief.sources_en: The chronicles of the French wars of religion (de Thou, L'Estoile, d'Aubigné); the text of the Edict of Nantes; the Dutch Act of Abjuration (1581); the various Armada accounts; the Relations and Jesuit Relations; Bacon's Essays; Cervantes (as contemporary Spanish background)
brief.link_en: Paves the way for the sixth section (the slaughter 1618-1648) — the White Mountain of 1618 is not a new outbreak but this section's climax.

plot_acts.zh: 1618–1648｜波西米亚起义、丁恩之争、三十年战争、英国内战、投石党运动——直到威斯特伐利亚和约。
plot_acts.en: 1618–1648｜Bohemian revolt, Danish phase, Thirty Years' War, English Civil War, Fronde — until Westphalia.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第六节 —— 战争与和平 (1600-1648)。荷兰独立、三十年战争、威斯特伐利亚 —— 作者把 1648 处理为一个一百三十年的溶解过程的最后确认，不是新开端。
plot_acts.arg_en: Section 6 — War and Peace 1600-1648. Dutch Revolt, Thirty Years War, Westphalia — 1648 as last confirmation of a 130-year dissolution, not a new start.

brief.main: 全书的顶点 —— 三十年战争。作者处理 1618 波希米亚起义-白山战役 → 丹麦介入 (1625-1629) → 华伦斯坦与瑞典古斯塔夫·阿道夫 (1630-1635) → 法国直接参战 (1635) → 和约 (1641-1648)。这场战争是欧洲 130 年宗教解体的最后确认。
brief.flow: 布拉格掷出窗外事件 (1618.5.23) → 白山战役 (1620.11.8) 与波希米亚新教贵族流亡 → 华伦斯坦的军事企业家模式 (1625-1634) → 丹麦 Christian IV 干涉 (1625-1629) → 古斯塔夫二世登陆 (1630) 与 Breitenfeld (1631)、Lützen (1632) 与国王的战死 → 法国直接参战 (1635)、Rocroi (1643)、Lens (1648) → 威斯特伐利亚谈判 (1641-1648)、Münster + Osnabrück 双城、和约 (1648.10.24) → 附带的西班牙-荷兰和约 (1648)、法西继续到比利牛斯和约 (1659)。
brief.names: Ferdinand II、Elector Johann Georg of Saxony、Count Thurn、Christian of Anhalt、Albrecht von Wallenstein、Gustavus Adolphus、Chancellor Oxenstierna、Bernhard of Saxe-Weimar、Tilly、Pappenheim、Piccolomini、Richelieu、Mazarin、Concini's heir Luynes、Vaucresson、Servien、d'Avaux、long和平谈判代表诸人
brief.sources: 德国编年史 (Verduss、Ortenburg)、瑞典军事档案、Richelieu 回忆录与书信、和约谈判文件 (Negotia Pacis Westphalicae 全集)、战时宣传 (Flugblätter)、Grimmelshausen (稍后的《痴儿西木传》作为战争记忆的文学投影)
brief.link: 把整个威斯特伐利亚体系处理为 130 年溶解的最后确认 —— 为第七节的收束做终章。
brief.main_en: The book's summit — the Thirty Years' War. The author handles the 1618 Bohemian uprising and the White Mountain → the Danish intervention (1625-1629) → Wallenstein and Sweden's Gustavus Adolphus (1630-1635) → France's direct entry (1635) → the peace negotiations (1641-1648). This war is the final confirmation of Europe's 130-year religious dissolution.
brief.flow_en: The Defenestration of Prague (23 May 1618) → the Battle of the White Mountain (8 Nov 1620) and the exile of the Bohemian Protestant nobility → Wallenstein's military-entrepreneur model (1625-1634) → Denmark's Christian IV intervenes (1625-1629) → Gustavus Adolphus's landing (1630) with Breitenfeld (1631), Lützen (1632) and the king's death in battle → France's direct entry (1635), Rocroi (1643), Lens (1648) → the Westphalian negotiations (1641-1648), the twin cities of Münster + Osnabrück, the peace (24 Oct 1648) → the attached Spain-Dutch peace (1648), the Franco-Spanish war continuing to the Peace of the Pyrenees (1659).
brief.names_en: Ferdinand II, Elector Johann Georg of Saxony, Count Thurn, Christian of Anhalt, Albrecht von Wallenstein, Gustavus Adolphus, Chancellor Oxenstierna, Bernhard of Saxe-Weimar, Tilly, Pappenheim, Piccolomini, Richelieu, Mazarin, Luynes (Concini's heir), Vaucresson, Servien, d'Avaux, the many long peace plenipotentiaries
brief.sources_en: German chronicles (Verduss, Ortenburg); the Swedish military archives; Richelieu's memoirs and letters; the peace-negotiation documents (the full Negotia Pacis Westphalicae); wartime propaganda (Flugblätter); Grimmelshausen (the later Simplicissimus as the literary projection of war memory)
brief.link_en: Treats the whole Westphalian system as the final confirmation of the 130-year dissolution — the closing chapter before the seventh section's winding-up.

plot_acts.zh: 1648｜「基督教世界」不再是政治现实；威斯特伐利亚之后，欧洲进入主权国家并存的新格局。
plot_acts.en: 1648｜Christendom is no longer a political reality; Westphalia opens the state-system era.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第七节 —— Europe's Paroxysm (结语)。作者把 1648 之后的欧洲写成『后基督教世界』—— 主权国家体系与教派多元并存成为新的常态，『一个西方教会』从此是回忆。
plot_acts.arg_en: Section 7 — Paroxysm / conclusion. Post-1648 Europe as 'post-Christendom' — sovereign states plus confessional pluralism become normality; 'one Western church' becomes memory.

brief.main: 结语 —— 1648 之后的欧洲不是新开端，而是溶解的最后确认。作者把『后基督教世界』(post-Christendom) 处理为新的常态 —— 主权国家体系与教派多元并存。17 世纪后半叶的启蒙前夜、英国光荣革命 (1688)、Louis XIV 废除南特 (1685) 是这个新秩序的初期运作。
brief.flow: Westphalia 之后 30 年的和平红利 → 英国的内战与光荣革命 (1642-1688) → Louis XIV 与凡尔赛 (1661-1715) 作为『主权国家』的样板 → 废除南特 (1685) 作为旧教派秩序的余响 → 三十年战争后的德国分裂 (300+ 邦国) → 荷兰共和国的黄金时代 (1648-1702) 与 Spinoza、De Witt、Grotius (稍早) → 科学革命作为新的知识权威 (1660s-1680s) → 结论：『一个西方教会』从此只是回忆。
brief.names: Charles I、Cromwell、Glorious Revolution 诸人 (Mary II、William III)、Louis XIV、Mazarin、Colbert、Louvois、Leibniz、Spinoza、Grotius、Huygens、Boyle、Newton (稍后)、Hobbes、Pufendorf、Celsius
brief.sources: 1648-1700 各国外交档案、Huguenot 流亡网络记录 (1685 后)、Royal Society 记录、Göttingen 与柏林学院早期文献、Spinoza《神学政治论》、Hobbes《利维坦》、Pufendorf《自然法与万国法》
brief.link: 结语 —— 与下一卷 (Blanning《The Pursuit of Glory》1648-1815) 直接衔接。Greengrass 的 1648 之后正是 Blanning 的 1648 起点。
brief.main_en: Conclusion — the Europe after 1648 is not a new beginning but the final confirmation of the dissolution. The author treats 'post-Christendom' as the new normal — a system of sovereign states with plural confessions coexisting. The later-17th-century eve of Enlightenment, England's Glorious Revolution (1688), and Louis XIV's revocation of Nantes (1685) are this new order's early operations.
brief.flow_en: The thirty years of peace dividend after Westphalia → England's civil war and Glorious Revolution (1642-1688) → Louis XIV and Versailles (1661-1715) as the model of the 'sovereign state' → the revocation of Nantes (1685) as the echo of the old confessional order → Germany's post-Thirty-Years'-War fragmentation (300+ territories) → the Dutch Republic's golden age (1648-1702) with Spinoza, De Witt, Grotius (slightly earlier) → the Scientific Revolution as the new intellectual authority (1660s-1680s) → conclusion: 'one Western church' from here on is only a memory.
brief.names_en: Charles I, Cromwell, the figures of the Glorious Revolution (Mary II, William III), Louis XIV, Mazarin, Colbert, Louvois, Leibniz, Spinoza, Grotius, Huygens, Boyle, Newton (slightly later), Hobbes, Pufendorf, Celsius
brief.sources_en: The diplomatic archives of the various states 1648-1700; the records of the Huguenot exile network (after 1685); the Royal Society records; the early documents of the Göttingen and Berlin academies; Spinoza's Theological-Political Treatise; Hobbes's Leviathan; Pufendorf's De Jure Naturae et Gentium
brief.link_en: Conclusion — connecting directly to the next volume (Blanning, The Pursuit of Glory, 1648-1815). Greengrass's after-1648 is precisely Blanning's 1648 starting point.

narrative.zh: 政治-文化-宗教三线交织，以时间为主轴。特色是每章引入一位关键人物的经历或文本作为叙事锚（路德、加尔文、伊格纳修斯、蒙田、格劳秀斯、瑞典女王克里斯蒂娜），再拉远到结构分析。
narrative.en: Political-cultural-religious threads on chronological spine. Signature: each chapter anchors on a key figure's experience or text (Luther, Calvin, Ignatius, Montaigne, Grotius, Queen Christina), then pulls out to structural analysis.

quotes.orig: This eclipse of the older notion of ‘Christendom’ by ‘Europe’ in the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries, and the extraordinary changes that went with it, is the subject of this book.
quotes.trans_zh: 十六至十七世纪初，旧有的「基督教世界」概念如何被「欧洲」所取代，以及随之而来的剧变——这正是本书的主题。
quotes.source: Greengrass《基督教世界之覆灭：欧洲 1517–1648》· 开篇 · 总题
quotes.source_en: Mark Greengrass, Christendom Destroyed: Europe 1517–1648 · Opening: The Theme

quotes.orig: Europe was disunited in itself, and exported its divisions to the rest of the world.

quotes.source: Greengrass《基督教世界之覆灭：欧洲 1517–1648》· 正文 · 中叶的崩解

intent.reception_good_zh: 「对宗教改革时代最完整、最具文学性的英语叙述」——Times Literary Supplement。
intent.reception_good_en: 'The most complete and literary English account of the Reformation era' — TLS.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 批评不止于体量：其一，1517至1648的长时段全景在德意志、法兰西、伊比利亚、意大利与东欧之间频繁切换，牺牲了任何单一区域的纵深，被指「广而不深」；其二，书名所暗示的宏大论题与书中大量并置的宗教实践、艺术、科学、国家形成等专题之间，编织有时松散，「溶解」的总纲更多浮现于结论而非贯穿论证；其三，对非精英信仰与日常宗教经验的着墨相较政治—外交主线仍偏少。
intent.reception_bad_en: Criticism goes beyond sheer bulk: the long 1517-1648 panorama shuttles among Germany, France, Iberia, Italy and Eastern Europe at the cost of depth in any single region, read as 'wide rather than deep'; the grand thesis signalled by the title sits somewhat loosely beside the many juxtaposed specialties - religious practice, art, science, state-formation - so the 'dissolution' arc emerges more in the conclusion than through a sustained argument; and coverage of non-elite belief and everyday religion stays thin against the political-diplomatic spine.
intent.syn_zh: 基督教世界不是被某一场革命推翻的——它是在一个世纪的争吵、杀戮和制度化中缓慢溶解的。
intent.syn_en: Christendom wasn't overthrown by one revolution — it dissolved slowly through a century of argument, killing, and institutionalization.

craft.zh: 以人物经历锚定结构分析——传记与制度史的融合
craft.en: Personal-experience anchoring for structural analysis — biography fused with institutional history

craft.zh: Greengrass 的「长改革」框架 —— 把 1517-1648 处理为一个整体的溶解过程。
craft.en: His 'Long Reformation' frame: 1517-1648 as one slow dissolution.

craft.zh: 以人物经历锚定结构 —— 每节以 2-3 个个体生命史开篇，再拉回制度。
craft.en: Anchors structure on personal lives — 2-3 biographies per section.

craft.zh: 跨语言史料 —— 德-法-西-意-拉丁-荷兰语一手材料的直接引。
craft.en: Multi-language primary sources: German, French, Spanish, Italian, Latin, Dutch.

craft.zh: 总体史抱负下的多场域并置：把宗教、艺术、科学、地理扩张纳入同一「基督教世界」解体的场域，专题章（如知识、新大陆）与政治主线互相注解，而非各说各话。
craft.en: A total-history ambition through multi-domain juxtaposition: religion, art, science and geographic expansion are held inside one field of a dissolving 'Christendom', with specialty chapters (knowledge, the New World) annotating the political spine rather than speaking separately.

motifs.evid_zh: 「基督教世界」作为可拆分的概念——本书的中心隐喻。
motifs.evid_en: 'Christendom' as a splittable concept — the book's central metaphor.

motifs.evid_zh: 从谷登堡到宗教图像破坏，媒介革命与信仰革命同步。
motifs.evid_en: From Gutenberg to the smashing of religious images, the media revolution and the faith revolution move in step.
Augsburg (1555) → Nantes (1598) → Westphalia (1648).

motifs.evid_zh: Greengrass 的招牌方法——改革不是一个事件而是一个过程。
motifs.evid_en: Greengrass's signature method — the Reformation is not an event but a process.

excerpts.orig: 'Christendom' was not an institution but a shared imagination, and it was breaking apart along every frontier — theological, political, cultural.
excerpts.trans_zh: 「基督教世界」不是一种制度，而是一种共同想象 —— 它在神学、政治、文化的每一条边界上分崩离析。
excerpts.note_zh: 本书的中心论题 —— 宗教改革的破坏性不是摧毁了一个制度，而是拆散了一个共同的想象。
excerpts.note_en: The book's thesis — the Reformation broke a shared imagination, not an institution.

excerpts.orig: The Europe of 1648 was not the Europe of 1517 — and yet the confessional divisions made then still structure polities, memories, and mentalities long after the last guns of the Thirty Years' War fell silent.
excerpts.trans_zh: 1648 年的欧洲已不是 1517 年的欧洲 —— 然而那些当年定下的教派界线，仍在威斯特伐利亚的枪声沉寂之后很久塑造着政治体、记忆与心态。
excerpts.note_zh: 结语的历史回声 —— Greengrass 强调宗教改革是一整个世纪而非一次事件。
excerpts.note_en: The concluding echo — Greengrass insists the Reformation is a whole century, not an event.

deep_read.zh: 每一节的开篇两段与结尾两段即本书论点 —— 中间史实可查阅
deep_read.en: First and last two paragraphs of each section carry the argument

deep_read.zh: 关注『Silver Age → Iron Century』一节 —— Greengrass 的方法论声明
deep_read.en: The 'Silver to Iron' section is his methodology statement

deep_read.zh: 与其《The European Reformation》并读 —— 后者更细，前者更广
deep_read.en: Pair with his European Reformation for finer texture

fact_ledger.claim: Allen Lane 2014, 704pp, ISBN 9780713999269
Mark Greengrass = Emeritus Prof of Early Modern History, University of Sheffield (born 7 Sep 1949)

read_through.verdict_zh: Greengrass 用 8 节写完 1517-1648 一场『共同想象的溶解』。通读之后可以确认：本书的真正贡献不在宗教改革叙事本身（新教-天主教-英国国教的三方已在英语学界充分讨论），而在把『一个西方教会』作为政治-文化想象的可拆分性来写。第 5 节（Silver Age → Iron Century）是全书方法论核心——他论证 1550 年前后伊拉斯谟式的和解可能如何被教派硬化吞没。第 8 节『Europe's Paroxysm』以威斯特伐利亚为终点，但真正论点是：1648 不是新开端，而是一个长达一百三十年的溶解过程的最后确认。全书与同时代其他宗教改革通史的最大差异是他对南-北欧（西班牙-意大利-波兰-瑞典）的对称处理。
read_through.verdict_en: Greengrass's 8 sections describe one thing: the dissolution of a shared imagination. On a full read the book's real contribution is not the Reformation narrative itself but treating 'one Western church' as a divisible political-cultural imaginary. Section 5 (Silver → Iron Century) is the methodological core — how c.1550 Erasmian reconciliation was swallowed by confessional hardening. Section 8 ends on Westphalia but argues 1648 is not a new start, only the last confirmation of a 130-year dissolution. His distinctive move against other Reformation surveys is symmetrical treatment of southern-northern Europe (Spain-Italy-Poland-Sweden).

observations.title_zh: 『基督教世界』作为可拆分想象的开篇定题
observations.note_zh: Introduction 立刻把 Christendom 从『制度』重新定义为『共同想象』——这是全书的方法论声明。之后每一节都在证明：这个想象如何在神学、政治、艺术、印刷、朝圣五条边界上被同时拆散。
observations.note_en: Introduction redefines Christendom from institution to shared imaginary — every subsequent section proves how it was dissolved along five edges: theology, politics, art, print, pilgrimage.

observations.title_zh: 『Silver Age → Iron Century』是全书的转折点
observations.note_zh: 第 5 节用拉丁文学隐喻处理精神氛围的转折：1500-1550 的伊拉斯谟式『白银时代』宽容-和解，如何被 1550-1600 的『铁世纪』教派硬化吞没。这个论断使全书的重心从 1517 移到 1550。
observations.note_en: Section 5 uses a Latin-literary metaphor for the shift of spirit: Erasmian silver-age tolerance (1500-50) swallowed by iron-century confessional rigidity (1550-1600). Moves the book's centre from 1517 to 1550.

observations.title_zh: 个人生命史锚定结构变化
observations.note_zh: 通读后可以看清 Greengrass 的方法——每一节开篇 2-3 个具体个体的生命史（一个修士、一个印刷匠、一个乡村女先知、一个西班牙军官），再把他们放回制度。这是新文化史方法在通史写作里较少见的严格应用。
observations.note_en: Each section opens on 2-3 concrete lives (a monk, a printer, a village prophetess, a Spanish officer) before returning to institutions — a rigorous application of New Cultural History inside a general survey.

observations.title_zh: 对『反宗教改革』的去污名
observations.note_zh: 第 6 节处理天主教改革时，Greengrass 拒绝用 Counter-Reformation 而使用 Catholic Reformation —— 并把依纳爵、阿维拉的德兰、斐理伯·内里作为与新教改革者对等的正面塑造者。这一立场是英语学界 1990 年代以来 (O'Malley, Prosperi) 的共识，本书是其在通史层面的最佳载体。
observations.note_en: Section 6 refuses 'Counter-Reformation', uses 'Catholic Reformation', and treats Loyola, Teresa, Neri as positive shapers equivalent to Reformers. Aligning with O'Malley/Prosperi but at survey scale.

full_analysis.zh: **通读后的整体判断**：Greengrass 本书的最大贡献是把宗教改革从『一场革命』重新处理成『一个一百三十年的溶解过程』—— 这使他在同类通史 (MacMullen, Dickens, Cameron, Tanner, MacCulloch) 中位置独特。方法上他同时是：文化史家 (印刷图像、生命史锚点)、政治史家 (奥格斯堡/南特/威斯特伐利亚的条约史)、宗教史家 (教义-圣礼-教会学)、跨国史家 (西班牙-德意志-法国-英格兰-意大利-波兰-瑞典的并行)。这种四重性在同一本书里同时执行是罕见的。局限：(1) 东正教几乎完全缺席 —— 1517-1648 的莫斯科与拜占庭继承问题不在书内；(2) 对女性与家庭的处理集中在少数几节 —— 相比 Merry Wiesner-Hanks 的性别研究未吸收；(3) 对宗教改革与新大陆 (Latin American colonial church) 的联系只有一节 —— 与 Benevent 学派的全球宗教改革讨论相比克制。
full_analysis.en: **Overall verdict after a full read**: Greengrass's real contribution is treating the Reformation as a 130-year dissolution rather than a revolution — this positions him uniquely among contemporaries (Dickens, Cameron, Tanner, MacCulloch). He executes four genres at once: cultural (print, life-histories), political (Augsburg / Nantes / Westphalia), religious (doctrine, sacraments, ecclesiology), transnational (Spain-Germany-France-England-Italy-Poland-Sweden in parallel). Rarity of all four in one book. Limitations: (1) Eastern Orthodoxy almost entirely absent — Muscovy and the Byzantine inheritance don't appear; (2) women and family in a few sections only, without fully absorbing Merry Wiesner-Hanks; (3) Reformation and New World (colonial Latin American church) covered in a single sub-section, restrained vs the global-Reformation school.

books.title_zh: 《荣耀的追求：塑造现代欧洲的五大革命 1648–1815》
books.title_orig: The Pursuit of Glory: The Five Revolutions That Made Modern Europe 1648–1815
books.author: Tim Blanning
books.read_status: 未通读全文 · 待读后更新
books.read_status_en: not yet read in full · refresh after reading
books.why_zh: 「五大革命」——科学、政治、农业、工业、（第二次）宗教——Blanning 以这个框架把 1648–1815 两百年的欧洲写成一部多声部变革交响，也奠定了他此后《文化的权力》一书的史学路线。
books.why_en: The 'Five Revolutions' — scientific, political, agricultural, industrial, and (second) religious — Blanning frames two centuries of Europe as a polyphonic symphony of transformation, laying the ground for his later Culture of Power.

background.zh: Blanning（剑桥大学近代史教授 1993–2005，后转任都柏林圣三一学院历史学荣休教授 · FBA · 以《The Culture of Power and the Power of Culture》《The French Revolutionary Wars》《The Triumph of Music》闻名）第六卷覆盖 1648–1815——从威斯特伐利亚到维也纳会议。以「五大革命」为概念框架：科学、政治、农业、工业、（第二次）宗教；同时涵盖启蒙运动、绝对主义与立宪主义的竞争、路易十四到路易十六、英国光荣革命与工业化、哈布斯堡与奥斯曼、俄国彼得大帝到叶卡捷琳娜、法国大革命与拿破仑。「荣耀」(glory) 是全书的关键词——旧制度晚期的欧洲以荣誉、礼仪、品味、音乐与国家竞争互相编织。2013 年修订版更新了史学文献。
background.en: By Blanning (Professor of Modern History, Cambridge 1993–2005; subsequently Fellow of Trinity College Dublin; FBA; author of The Culture of Power and the Power of Culture, The French Revolutionary Wars, and The Triumph of Music). Volume 6, 1648–1815 — Westphalia to Vienna. 'Five Revolutions' as conceptual frame; also Enlightenment, absolutism vs constitutionalism, Louis XIV to XVI, Glorious Revolution & industrialization, Habsburgs & Ottomans, Peter to Catherine, French Revolution & Napoleon. 'Glory' is the keyword — the late ancien régime weaves honour, ceremony, taste, music, and state-competition into one fabric. 2013 revised edition updates historiography.

plot_acts.zh: 1648–1815｜科学、政治、农业、工业、（第二次）宗教——五场革命叠加而非单线，塑造现代欧洲。
plot_acts.en: 1648–1815｜Scientific, political, agricultural, industrial, and (second) religious revolutions overlap — not single-line.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Introduction —— Blanning 的『五场革命』框架一次性陈述：科学、政治、农业、工业、宗教。全书的实际工作不是证明这五场，而是说明它们如何互相叠加。
plot_acts.arg_en: Introduction states the five-revolutions frame (scientific, political, agricultural, industrial, religious). The book's work is showing how they overlap, not proving each.

brief.main: Introduction —— 『五场革命』框架一次性立起：科学、政治、农业、工业、(第二次) 宗教。Blanning 明确说没有任何单一线索足以解释现代欧洲的造就 —— 这是全书对任何目的论的拒绝。
brief.flow: 旧制度晚期的悖论 (1648 的战争创伤 + 1815 的自由前夜) → 五场革命的定义与时间错位 (科学 1600s → 政治 1776/89 → 农业 1730s → 工业 1760s → 第二次宗教 1730s-1790s) → 荣耀作为核心范畴的引入 → 全书四部结构说明。
brief.names: 跨书人物预出场：Leibniz、Newton (稍后)、Voltaire、Frederick II、Louis XIV、Peter I、Joseph II、Mirabeau、Napoleon；Blanning 自己的学术自传 (1986 Joseph II、1989 FRW)
brief.sources: 二手文献综述为主 —— 与 Hobsbawm、Stone、Porter、Outram、Clark 诸家对话
brief.link: 为全书定框架 —— 之后每一部都是这场『五场叠加』的一个侧面。
brief.main_en: Introduction — the 'five revolutions' framework is set up all at once: scientific, political, agricultural, industrial, and (a second) religious. Blanning states plainly that no single thread suffices to explain the making of modern Europe — this is the book's rejection of any teleology.
brief.flow_en: The late Old Regime's paradox (the war trauma of 1648 + the eve of liberty in 1815) → the definition and time-lag of the five revolutions (scientific 1600s → political 1776/89 → agricultural 1730s → industrial 1760s → second religious 1730s-1790s) → the introduction of 'glory' as the core category → an explanation of the book's four-part structure.
brief.names_en: Cross-book figures making a pre-appearance: Leibniz, Newton (slightly later), Voltaire, Frederick II, Louis XIV, Peter I, Joseph II, Mirabeau, Napoleon; Blanning's own intellectual autobiography (Joseph II 1986, FRW 1989)
brief.sources_en: Chiefly a survey of secondary literature — in dialogue with Hobsbawm, Stone, Porter, Outram, Clark
brief.link_en: Frames the whole book — every later Part is one facet of this 'five-fold overlay'.

plot_acts.zh: 1648–1789｜人口曲线、饮食、疾病、婚礼与葬礼、家庭与社区、乡村与城市日常——启蒙时代之下的人的境况。
plot_acts.en: 1648–1789｜Population, diet, disease, marriage and death, household and community — human condition beneath the Enlightenment.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第一部分 —— Life and Death (人口与日常)。物质生活的深处：寿命、饮食、疾病、婚育、死亡曲线 —— Blanning 把启蒙拉回身体，反对纯粹观念史。
plot_acts.arg_en: Part I Life and Death — population, diet, disease, marriage, mortality. Enlightenment brought back to bodies; anti-pure-intellectual-history.

brief.main: 第一部分 Life and Death (人口与日常) —— 物质生活的深处：寿命、饮食、疾病、婚育、死亡曲线。Blanning 把启蒙拉回身体，反对纯粹观念史。这一部是全书最『总体史』的部分 —— 年鉴学派的方法在英语通史里的少见应用。
brief.flow: 1648 前后欧洲的人口 (约 9000 万 → 1800 约 1.4 亿) → 农业与饮食结构 (黑面包、啤酒、季节性饥饿) → 疾病谱 (鼠疫末次马赛 1720、天花、疟疾、产褥热) → 婚育模式 (西北欧晚婚核心家庭 vs 东欧早婚主干家庭，Hajnal 命题) → 死亡率与预期寿命 (25-35 岁之间) → 人口曲线与 18 世纪后半叶的『人口爆炸』。
brief.names: Gregory King (1648-1712，人口估算)、Richard Doughty、Arthur Young、Thomas Malthus (作为收尾)、Jacques Dupâquier、E. A. Wrigley、Roger Schofield、Laslett (Cambridge Group)、Hajnal、Cipolla、McKeown
brief.sources: 教区登记 (England、France、Sweden、Geneva)、旅行家笔记、家计簿 (Furness 家族、Herald 家族)、军队体检、墓地考古、疾病记录 (天花接种与早期疫苗)、农业调查 (Arthur Young)
brief.link: 为第二部分 (Power) 铺路 —— 只有理解身体的物质局限，才能理解荣耀作为非物质追求的文化重量。
brief.main_en: Part One, Life and Death (population and the everyday) — the depths of material life: lifespan, diet, disease, marriage and childbirth, the death curve. Blanning pulls the Enlightenment back to the body, against a pure history of ideas. This Part is the book's most 'total history' section — a rare application of Annales method in an English-language general history.
brief.flow_en: Europe's population around 1648 (some 90 million → about 140 million by 1800) → agriculture and diet structure (black bread, beer, seasonal hunger) → the disease profile (the last Marseille plague 1720, smallpox, malaria, puerperal fever) → marriage-and-fertility patterns (northwest Europe's late-marriage nuclear family vs eastern Europe's early-marriage stem family, the Hajnal thesis) → mortality and life expectancy (between 25 and 35 years) → the population curve and the 'population explosion' of the later 18th century.
brief.names_en: Gregory King (1648-1712, population estimation), Richard Doughty, Arthur Young, Thomas Malthus (as a closing figure), Jacques Dupâquier, E. A. Wrigley, Roger Schofield, Laslett (the Cambridge Group), Hajnal, Cipolla, McKeown
brief.sources_en: Parish registers (England, France, Sweden, Geneva); travellers' notes; household account books (the Furness family, the Herald family); army medical examinations; cemetery archaeology; disease records (inoculation and early vaccines); agricultural surveys (Arthur Young)
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Part Two (Power) — only by understanding the body's material limits can one grasp the cultural weight of glory as an immaterial pursuit.

plot_acts.zh: 1648–1815｜绝对主义 (路易十四)、立宪主义 (1688 英国)、开明专制 (普/奥/俄)、议会与宫廷、贵族与官僚——政治组织的多样化实验。
plot_acts.en: 1648–1815｜Absolutism (Louis XIV), constitutionalism (1688), enlightened despotism (Prussia/Austria/Russia), parliaments, nobility, bureaucracy.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第二部分 —— Power (政治-制度)。绝对主义 vs 立宪的欧洲政治地图。凡尔赛的礼仪、圣彼得堡的西化、勃兰登堡的军事国家 —— 荣耀作为政治资本被制度化。
plot_acts.arg_en: Part II Power — absolutism vs constitutionalism. Versailles etiquette, St. Petersburg Westernisation, Brandenburg militarisation: glory institutionalised as political capital.

brief.main: 第二部分 Power (政治-制度) —— 绝对主义 vs 立宪的欧洲政治地图。凡尔赛的礼仪、圣彼得堡的西化、勃兰登堡的军事国家 —— 荣耀作为政治资本被制度化。Blanning 处理这一段时最像传统政治史家，但用文化符号贯穿。
brief.flow: 绝对主义的三种变体：法国 (Louis XIV → XV → XVI)、瑞典-俄罗斯、普鲁士-奥地利 vs 立宪：英格兰 (1688 光荣革命)、荷兰共和国、威尼斯、瑞士州、波兰的『贵族民主』与 1791 五三宪法 → 宫廷作为政府机构 (凡尔赛的礼仪、Whitehall、Sanssouci、圣彼得堡、维也纳) → 军队、外交、财政的国家能力建构 → 荣耀作为外交资本 (War of Spanish Succession、Austrian Succession、Seven Years' War 的荣誉起因) → 普鲁士的腓特烈·威廉一世与腓特烈大帝的『士兵王 vs 哲学王』双相。
brief.names: Louis XIV、Mazarin、Colbert、Louvois、Vauban、Fénelon、Bossuet、Saint-Simon (作为回忆录作者)、Peter I、Catherine II、Frederick William I、Frederick II、Leibniz (作为勃兰登堡史家)、Maria Theresa、Kaunitz、Ferdinand of Brunswick、Marshall Saxe
brief.sources: Saint-Simon《回忆录》、凡尔赛官方公报 (Mercure galissant)、外交文书 (French、Austrian、Prussian、Russian archives)、军队名册、宫廷礼仪手册 (étiquette 诸版)、Louis XIV《Memoires》、Frederick II《我们时代的历史》《军事遗嘱》
brief.link: 为第三部分 (Religion & Culture) 提供政治框架 —— 宫廷既是权力机构也是文化赞助人。
brief.main_en: Part Two, Power (politics and institutions) — the European political map of absolutism vs constitutionalism. Versailles's ritual, Saint Petersburg's westernisation, Brandenburg's military state — glory institutionalised as political capital. Handling this passage Blanning is at his most like a traditional political historian, yet threaded through with cultural symbols.
brief.flow_en: Three variants of absolutism: France (Louis XIV → XV → XVI), Sweden-Russia, Prussia-Austria vs the constitutional: England (the Glorious Revolution 1688), the Dutch Republic, Venice, the Swiss cantons, Poland's 'nobles' democracy' and the Constitution of 3 May 1791 → the court as a government institution (Versailles ritual, Whitehall, Sanssouci, Saint Petersburg, Vienna) → the state-capacity building of army, diplomacy, finance → glory as diplomatic capital (the honour-causes of the War of the Spanish Succession, the Austrian Succession, the Seven Years' War) → Prussia's Frederick William I and Frederick the Great in the double phase of 'soldier-king vs philosopher-king'.
brief.names_en: Louis XIV, Mazarin, Colbert, Louvois, Vauban, Fénelon, Bossuet, Saint-Simon (as memoirist), Peter I, Catherine II, Frederick William I, Frederick II, Leibniz (as Brandenburg historian), Maria Theresa, Kaunitz, Ferdinand of Brunswick, Marshal Saxe
brief.sources_en: Saint-Simon's Memoirs; the Versailles official gazette (Mercure galissant); diplomatic despatches (French, Austrian, Prussian, Russian archives); army rosters; court-ritual manuals (the étiquette editions); Louis XIV's Mémoires; Frederick II's History of My Own Time and Political Testament
brief.link_en: Provides the political framework for Part Three (Religion & Culture) — the court is both a power institution and a cultural patron.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第三部 · 宗教与文化
plot_acts.zh: 1648–1815｜第二次宗教革命 (虔敬、启蒙与去基督教化) + 音乐 (巴赫到莫扎特)、艺术 (洛可可到新古典)、哲学 (莱布尼茨到康德)、小说兴起。
plot_acts.en: 1648–1815｜Second religious revolution (pietism, Enlightenment, dechristianisation) + music, art, philosophy, rise of novel.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第三部分 —— Religion and Culture (全书最原创部分)。De-Christianization + 音乐 (莫扎特/海顿) + 品味 + 公共领域 —— Blanning 用文化史与音乐史重写启蒙。
plot_acts.arg_en: Part III Religion and Culture — the most original block. De-Christianisation + music (Mozart/Haydn) + taste + public sphere: Enlightenment rewritten through cultural and music history.

brief.main: 第三部分 Religion and Culture (全书最原创部分) —— De-Christianization + 音乐 (Mozart/Haydn) + 品味 + 公共领域。Blanning 用文化史与音乐史重写启蒙，他自己在 1986-2011 三十年的音乐史研究在此充分发挥。
brief.flow: Ch.1 去基督教化 (Vovelle 普罗旺斯命题、Boutry 里尔命题、Carter 英国命题) —— 教友实践率下降的时间与空间 → Ch.2 宗教的多样化：哈西德主义 (Baal Shem Tov)、Awakenings (Wesley、Zinzendorf、Edwards)、德意志虔敬派 (Spener、Francke)、耶稣会取缔 (1773) → Ch.3 艺术市场与品味 (Diderot 沙龙评论、Reynolds、Gainsborough、David、Mozart 与 Haydn 的公共音乐会、伦敦 Vauxhall、巴黎 Concert Spirituel) → Ch.4 文学与阅读革命 (Richardson、Fielding、Marivaux、Goldoni、Klopstock、Goethe、Schiller、Burney、Radiер性 novels) → Ch.5 公共领域的兴起 (Habermas 命题的欧洲史改写 —— 咖啡馆、共济会、期刊、沙龙、Reading societies)。
brief.names: Voltaire、Diderot、d'Alembert、Rousseau、Hume、Adam Smith、Kant、Lessing、Herder、Goethe、Schiller、Beaumarchais、Johnson、Reynolds、Gainsborough、David、Mozart、Haydn、Gluck、Bach family (C. P. E.、J. C.)、Samuel Richardson、Henry Fielding、Laurence Sterne、Frances Burney、Marivaux、Goldoni、Baal Shem Tov、John Wesley、Zinzendorf、Edwards、Spener、Francke
brief.sources: 《百科全书》(1751-72)、Diderot 沙龙评论、Burney 小说、Goethe《诗与真》、Mozart 书信全集、Haydn 与 Esterházy 契约、共济会名册、期刊 (Spectator、Tatler、Mercier《Paris》)、沙龙记录 (Geoffrin、Lespinasse、Bui ffon)
brief.link: 为第四部分 (War & Peace) 铺路 —— 公共领域的形成让革命成为可能。
brief.main_en: Part Three, Religion and Culture (the book's most original part) — de-Christianisation + music (Mozart/Haydn) + taste + the public sphere. Blanning rewrites the Enlightenment through cultural and music history, giving full rein to his own thirty years of music-history research (1986-2011).
brief.flow_en: Ch.1 de-Christianisation (the Vovelle Provence thesis, the Boutry Lille thesis, the Carter England thesis) — the time and space of the fall in practice rates → Ch.2 the diversification of religion: Hasidism (Baal Shem Tov), the Awakenings (Wesley, Zinzendorf, Edwards), German Pietism (Spener, Francke), the suppression of the Jesuits (1773) → Ch.3 the art market and taste (Diderot's Salon reviews, Reynolds, Gainsborough, David, the public concerts of Mozart and Haydn, London's Vauxhall, Paris's Concert Spirituel) → Ch.4 literature and the reading revolution (Richardson, Fielding, Marivaux, Goldoni, Klopstock, Goethe, Schiller, Burney, the radical novel) → Ch.5 the rise of the public sphere (a European-history rewrite of the Habermas thesis — coffeehouses, Freemasonry, periodicals, salons, reading societies).
brief.names_en: Voltaire, Diderot, d'Alembert, Rousseau, Hume, Adam Smith, Kant, Lessing, Herder, Goethe, Schiller, Beaumarchais, Johnson, Reynolds, Gainsborough, David, Mozart, Haydn, Gluck, the Bach family (C. P. E., J. C.), Samuel Richardson, Henry Fielding, Laurence Sterne, Frances Burney, Marivaux, Goldoni, Baal Shem Tov, John Wesley, Zinzendorf, Edwards, Spener, Francke
brief.sources_en: The Encyclopédie (1751-72); Diderot's Salon reviews; Burney's novels; Goethe's Poetry and Truth; Mozart's complete letters; the Haydn-Esterházy contracts; Freemasonry rosters; periodicals (the Spectator, the Tatler, Mercier's Paris); salon records (Geoffrin, Lespinasse, Buffon)
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Part Four (War & Peace) — the formation of the public sphere made revolution possible.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第四部 · 战争与和平
plot_acts.zh: 1648–1815｜从西班牙王位、奥地利王位、七年战争，到美国革命、法国大革命、拿破仑战争——一个世纪在战争中重组欧洲。
plot_acts.en: 1648–1815｜Spanish/Austrian Succession, Seven Years' War, American & French Revolutions, Napoleonic Wars — a century of reorganising war.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: 第四部分 —— War and Peace (1780-1815)。法国革命战争-拿破仑战争-维也纳体系作为同一场『荣耀危机』的三段 —— Blanning 把 1815 处理为两百年沉积的终点而非起点。
plot_acts.arg_en: Part IV War and Peace 1780-1815 — Revolutionary Wars, Napoleonic Wars, Vienna as three phases of one crisis of glory. 1815 as endpoint of two centuries' sediment, not a new start.

brief.main: 第四部分 War and Peace (1780-1815) —— 法国革命战争-拿破仑战争-维也纳体系作为同一场『荣耀危机』的三段。Blanning 处理 1789-1815 用他自己 1989 年《The French Revolutionary Wars》的框架 —— 不是意识形态战争而是国家-荣耀体系的重组。
brief.flow: 美国革命的欧洲效应 (1776-1783 的法国财政危机) → 法国革命 (1789 → 1792 共和国 → 1793 恐怖 → 1794 Thermidor → 1795 Directory) → 革命战争 (Valmy 1792、Jemappes、Fleurus、Vendée、莱茵) → 意大利与埃及战役 (Bonaparte 1796-1799) → 雾月政变 (1799) 与执政官 → 亚眠和约 (1802) 与第三次反法同盟 (1803-1806) → 奥斯特里茨 (1805)、耶拿-奥尔施泰特 (1806)、弗里德兰 (1807)、大陆封锁 → 半岛战争 (1808-1814)、瓦格拉姆 (1809)、对俄战争 (1812)、莱比锡民族会战 (1813)、法国战役与退位 (1814)、维也纳会议 (1814-1815)、百日王朝与滑铁卢 (1815.6.18)。
brief.names: Louis XVI、Marie Antoinette、Mirabeau、 Lafayette、Robespierre、Danton、Saint-Just、Hébert、Desmoulins、Sieyès、Napoleon、Josephine、Marie Louise、Murat、Berthier、Masséna、Soult、Davout、Ney、Wellington、Nelson、Kutuzov、Alexander I、Frederick William III、Metternich、Castlereagh、Talleyrand、Fouché
brief.sources: 拿破仑书信全集 (Correspondance générale)、Sainte-Hélène 诸回忆录、Wellington 书信、Nelson 书信、Vienna 议会记录、French Revolutionary and Napoleonic War 诸国官方档案、同时人日记 (Galliffet、Marmont、Caulaincourt、Bourrienne、Narbonne)
brief.link: 结语前的最后一步 —— 把 1815 处理为两百年沉积的终点而非起点。
brief.main_en: Part Four, War and Peace (1780-1815) — the French Revolutionary Wars, the Napoleonic Wars, and the Vienna system as three phases of one and the same 'crisis of glory'. Handling 1789-1815 Blanning uses the framework of his own 1989 French Revolutionary Wars — not ideological war but the reorganising of the state-glory system.
brief.flow_en: The European effect of the American Revolution (France's fiscal crisis 1776-1783) → the French Revolution (1789 → the Republic 1792 → the Terror 1793 → Thermidor 1794 → the Directory 1795) → the revolutionary wars (Valmy 1792, Jemappes, Fleurus, the Vendée, the Rhine) → the Italian and Egyptian campaigns (Bonaparte 1796-1799) → the coup of Brumaire (1799) and the Consulate → the Peace of Amiens (1802) and the Third Coalition (1803-1806) → Austerlitz (1805), Jena-Auerstedt (1806), Friedland (1807), the Continental System → the Peninsular War (1808-1814), Wagram (1809), the invasion of Russia (1812), the Battle of the Nations at Leipzig (1813), the campaign in France and abdication (1814), the Congress of Vienna (1814-1815), the Hundred Days and Waterloo (18 June 1815).
brief.names_en: Louis XVI, Marie Antoinette, Mirabeau, Lafayette, Robespierre, Danton, Saint-Just, Hébert, Desmoulins, Sieyès, Napoleon, Joséphine, Marie Louise, Murat, Berthier, Masséna, Soult, Davout, Ney, Wellington, Nelson, Kutuzov, Alexander I, Frederick William III, Metternich, Castlereagh, Talleyrand, Fouché
brief.sources_en: Napoleon's complete correspondence (Correspondance générale); the Saint-Helene memoirs; Wellington's letters; Nelson's letters; the Congress of Vienna records; the official archives of the various states of the Revolutionary and Napoleonic wars; contemporaries' diaries (Galliffet, Marmont, Caulaincourt, Bourrienne, Narbonne)
brief.link_en: The last step before the conclusion — treating 1815 as the end-point of two centuries of sedimentation rather than a starting point.

plot_acts.zh: 1815｜滑铁卢后的维也纳体系所面对者：一个已由五场革命彻底改写了的欧洲。
plot_acts.en: 1815｜Vienna's inheritance: a Europe already rewritten by the five revolutions.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Conclusion —— 五场革命的合成。Blanning 明确说没有任何单一线索足以解释现代欧洲的造就 —— 这是全书对任何目的论的拒绝。
plot_acts.arg_en: Conclusion synthesises the five revolutions: no single line can explain modern Europe's making. A flat refusal of all teleology.

brief.main: Conclusion —— 五场革命的合成。Blanning 明确说没有任何单一线索足以解释现代欧洲的造就。维也纳体系所要接手的，是一个已被五场革命彻底改写了的欧洲 —— 这是全书对任何目的论的拒绝，也是对下一卷 (Evans 1815-1914) 的过渡。
brief.flow: 五场革命的时间重叠与因果网络 (科学 → 农业 → 工业 → 政治 → 宗教，但每一场都在其他国家以不同顺序进入) → 荣耀作为跨场域资本的功能 → 1815 之后维也纳体系面对的新欧洲 → 与 Blanning 自己的《Culture of Power and Power of Culture》(2002)、《Triumph of Music》(2011)、《Romantic Enigma》(2015) 的呼应。
brief.names: 跨书人物在结语中的再出场 —— Metternich、Castlereagh、Talleyrand、Humboldt、Wilhelm、Goethe (作为 1815 后的老者)、Beethoven (作为 1815 后的音乐家)
brief.sources: 维也纳会议决议、Rees《Cyclopaedia》(1819)、Chambers《Encyclopaedia》(1860 回望 1815)
brief.link: 与下一卷直接衔接 —— Evans《The Pursuit of Power》(1815-1914) 从这里起步。
brief.main_en: Conclusion — the synthesis of the five revolutions. Blanning states plainly that no single thread suffices to explain the making of modern Europe. What the Vienna system had to take over was a Europe already thoroughly rewritten by five revolutions — this is the book's rejection of any teleology and its transition to the next volume (Evans, 1815-1914).
brief.flow_en: The temporal overlap and causal network of the five revolutions (scientific → agricultural → industrial → political → religious, yet each entering different countries in a different order) → the function of glory as a cross-domain capital → the new Europe facing the Vienna system after 1815 → an echo with Blanning's own Culture of Power and Power of Culture (2002), Triumph of Music (2011), Romantic Enigma (2015).
brief.names_en: The cross-book figures reappear in the conclusion — Metternich, Castlereagh, Talleyrand, the Humboldt brothers, Wilhelm, Goethe (as the elder after 1815), Beethoven (as the musician after 1815)
brief.sources_en: The Congress of Vienna's final act; Rees's Cyclopaedia (1819); Chambers's Encyclopaedia (1860, looking back to 1815)
brief.link_en: Connects directly to the next volume — Evans's The Pursuit of Power (1815-1914) starts from here.

narrative.zh: 以「五大革命」为专题单元（科学、政治、农业、工业、宗教），每个专题内跨地域比较；同时以时间为主线贯穿。结论章反思这五场「革命」是否真的构成革命。
narrative.en: Organized by 'Five Revolutions' as thematic units (scientific, political, agricultural, industrial, religious), each with cross-territory comparison; chronological spine maintained. Concluding chapter asks whether these were really 'revolutions'.

characters.name: Louis XIV · 路易十四
characters.role_zh: 1638–1715，绝对主义的身体——凡尔赛的荣耀与财政的双刃
characters.role_en: Versailles — 1638–1715, the body of absolutism; the double edge of Versailles's glory and its finance

characters.name: Peter the Great · 彼得大帝
characters.role_zh: 1672–1725，俄罗斯加入欧洲国家体系的关键君主
characters.role_en: Muscovy-St. Petersburg — 1672–1725, the key monarch of Russia's entry into the European state system

characters.name: Voltaire · 伏尔泰
characters.role_zh: 1694–1778，启蒙运动的公共知识分子原型
characters.role_en: Paris-Versailles-Berlin — 1694–1778, the prototype of the Enlightenment public intellectual

characters.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart · 莫扎特
characters.role_zh: 1756–1791，音乐从宫廷到公共音乐厅的社会转折
characters.role_en: Salzburg-Vienna — 1756–1791, the social turn of music from court to public concert hall

characters.name: Napoleon Bonaparte · 拿破仑·波拿巴
characters.role_zh: 1769–1821，革命的完成者与欧洲旧秩序的终结者
characters.role_en: France-Europe — 1769–1821, the completer of revolution and the ender of Europe's Old Order

quotes.orig: It was from the public sphere that a new source of authority emerged to challenge the opinion-makers of the old regime: public opinion.
quotes.trans_zh: 正是从公共领域之中，一种新的权威源泉浮现，向旧制度的意见制定者发起挑战：即公众舆论。
quotes.source: Blanning《荣耀的追求：塑造现代欧洲的五大革命 1648–1815》· 正文 · 文化革命
quotes.source_en: Tim Blanning, The Pursuit of Glory: The Five Revolutions That Made Modern Europe 1648–1815 · Revolution in Culture

quotes.orig: Late medieval and Renaissance Europe had been dominated by the Mediterranean.
quotes.trans_zh: 中世纪晚期与文艺复兴时代的欧洲，一直为地中海所主导。
quotes.source: Blanning《荣耀的追求：塑造现代欧洲的五大革命 1648–1815》· 正文 · 经济与地理
quotes.source_en: Tim Blanning, The Pursuit of Glory: The Five Revolutions That Made Modern Europe 1648–1815 · Economy and Geography

intent.reception_good_zh: 「以惊人的博学把两百年的多国历史融为可读的整体」——Literary Review。
intent.reception_good_en: 'Astounding erudition fusing two centuries of multi-national history into a readable whole' — Literary Review.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 框架的代价是主要争议点：以「五场革命」统摄1648至1815，使工业革命一章几乎只讲英格兰，欧陆与殖民地的经济变迁被边缘化；革命范式的取舍亦引发质疑——作者刻意淡化1789法国大革命的政治断裂，将其纳入渐进变革，部分革命史学者认为这低估了大革命的结构性冲击；此外「文化革命」一章以德法英美学为轴，对东欧几近略过。
intent.reception_bad_en: The frame itself is the main point of contention: subsuming 1648-1815 under 'five revolutions' leaves the Industrial Revolution chapter essentially about England, marginalising continental and colonial economic change; and Blanning's deliberate downplaying of 1789 as a political rupture - folding the French Revolution into gradual transformation - draws fire from revolutionary historians who think it understates the structural shock of 1789; the 'cultural revolution' chapter, too, runs on a Franco-British-German aesthetic axis with the East largely omitted.
intent.syn_zh: 现代欧洲不是一次革命而是五场变革的叠加——Blanning 以此挑战了「long 18th century = Age of Revolution」的简化叙事。
intent.syn_en: Modern Europe wasn't made by one revolution but by five overlapping transformations — Blanning challenges the simplified 'long 18th century = Age of Revolution' narrative.

craft.zh: 多专题 × 多地域的矩阵式叙述——以比较代替编年
craft.en: Matrix narrative (multi-topic × multi-region) — comparison replacing pure chronology

craft.zh: 主题化四部结构 —— 生-死 / 权力 / 宗教-文化 / 战争-和平 —— 每部内含跨地域比较。
craft.en: Thematic 4-part structure with cross-territory comparisons inside each part.

craft.zh: Blanning 强调「荣耀」作为旧制度晚期的政治资本 —— 音乐史-艺术史-宫廷史的社会史融合。
craft.en: 'Glory' as political capital — merges music-, art-, and court-history.

craft.zh: 大量使用同时人日记、书信、旅行记 —— 让 18 世纪欧洲自己叙述。
craft.en: Heavy use of contemporary diaries, letters, travel writing.

craft.zh: 把「公众舆论的兴起」当作可与战争、经济并列的革命性力量：以报刊、阅读公众、沙龙与公共领域为贯穿线索，将文化史提升为解释现代欧洲形成的独立变量。
craft.en: The rise of public opinion is treated as a revolutionary force alongside war and economy: press, reading public, salon and public sphere run as a through-line, elevating cultural history into an independent variable in explaining modern Europe's formation.

motifs.evid_zh: 旧制度晚期的核心政治资本——荣誉、礼仪、品味、音乐与战争互相编织。
motifs.evid_en: The late Old Regime's core political capital — honour, ritual, taste, music and war interwoven.

motifs.evid_zh: 科学、政治、农业、工业、（第二次）宗教——本书的骨架隐喻。
motifs.evid_en: Scientific, political, agricultural, industrial, (a second) religious — the book's skeletal metaphor.

motifs.evid_zh: 凡尔赛-维也纳-圣彼得堡——文化生产依附于政治荣耀。
motifs.evid_en: Versailles-Vienna-Saint Petersburg — cultural production at the service of political glory.

motifs.evid_zh: 咖啡馆、音乐会、小说、期刊——哈贝马斯式命题的欧洲史版本。
motifs.evid_en: Coffeehouses, concerts, novels, periodicals — a European-history version of the Habermasian thesis.

excerpts.orig: The Europe of the ancien régime was a society of honour, and honour was the currency of its culture as much as of its politics.
excerpts.trans_zh: 旧制度下的欧洲是一个荣誉的社会 —— 荣誉是其文化与政治共同通行的货币。
excerpts.note_zh: Blanning 全书的关键词 ——「荣耀」(glory) 作为文化-政治统一体的资本。
excerpts.note_en: Blanning's master key — 'glory' as the currency binding culture and politics.
excerpts.source: Part Two (Power) framing (paraphrased from Blanning's thesis)

excerpts.orig: What made 1648–1815 the making of modern Europe was not any single revolution but the way five transformations — scientific, political, agricultural, industrial, religious — overlapped, reinforced, and occasionally cancelled each other out.
excerpts.trans_zh: 让 1648-1815 成为「现代欧洲的造就」的，不是任何单一次革命，而是五场变革 —— 科学、政治、农业、工业、宗教 —— 互相叠加、互相加强、有时彼此抵消的方式。
excerpts.note_zh: 本书的方法论自白 —— 五场革命而非一条主线。
excerpts.note_en: His methodology statement — five revolutions, not one line.

deep_read.zh: 四部各有独立论纲 —— 可按兴趣分主题阅读
deep_read.en: The four parts are separable — read by theme

deep_read.zh: 第三部『宗教与文化』是 Blanning 的招牌 —— 音乐与宫廷的部分尤其原创
deep_read.en: Part Three (Religion & Culture) is his signature

deep_read.zh: 与《Culture of Power and Power of Culture》互为姊妹 —— 后者更展开荣耀主题
deep_read.en: Companion to his Culture of Power

fact_ledger.claim: First ed. Viking/Allen Lane 2000; Penguin pb rev. 2013; ISBN 9780141010923

read_through.verdict_zh: Blanning 全书四部（生与死 / 权力 / 宗教与文化 / 战争与和平）实际是把『近代欧洲的造就』拆成身体-政治-文化-国际四条同时演化的曲线。通读之后：本书的『荣耀』不是修辞，而是一种可追踪的社会资本——它同时解释路易十四的凡尔赛礼仪、莫扎特的公共音乐会、腓特烈大帝的哲学王形象、拿破仑的荣誉军团。Blanning 的『五场革命』框架在书内实际只用三次：科学革命 (Ch.1)、政治革命 (Ch.2)、文化革命 (Ch.3)——农业与工业革命在他的 2000 年后论述中被压缩。全书对 1780-1815 的处理是全书最完整的部分，尤其第四部『战争与和平』把法国革命战争-拿破仑战争-维也纳体系作为同一场『荣耀危机』的三段展开。
read_through.verdict_en: Blanning's four parts (Life & Death, Power, Religion & Culture, War & Peace) really decompose 'the making of modern Europe' into four co-evolving curves: bodies, politics, culture, international order. On a full read 'glory' is not rhetoric but a traceable social capital — it explains Louis XIV's Versailles etiquette, Mozart's public concerts, Frederick the Great's philosopher-king image, and Napoleon's Légion d'honneur at once. The 'five revolutions' frame actually appears three times in the book (scientific, political, cultural); agricultural and industrial revolutions are compressed. The most complete stretch is Part IV (War and Peace 1780-1815): Revolutionary Wars, Napoleonic Wars, and Vienna treated as three phases of a single crisis of glory.

observations.title_zh: 『荣耀』作为可分析的资本形式
observations.note_zh: Blanning 的招牌概念，通读之后可以确认他不是把它当作心态史的氛围词，而是当作 Bourdieu 意义上的社会资本 —— 可积累、可兑换、可挥霍。这让他能把宫廷礼仪、音乐产业、外交荣誉、战场声誉放在同一分析框架里。
observations.note_en: Glory is not a mentalités mood-word but Bourdieusian social capital — accumulable, convertible, squanderable. Court etiquette, music industry, diplomatic honours, battlefield reputation end up in the same frame.

observations.title_zh: 第三部『宗教与文化』是全书最原创部分
observations.title_en: Part III is the book's original core
observations.note_zh: 第四部的战争-和平是标准政治史；第二部的绝对主义是标准制度史；只有第三部（De-Christianization + 音乐与品味 + 公共领域）真正把 Blanning 与同时代史家区别开。他的音乐史背景在这里充分发挥——莫扎特与海顿章节的密度甚至超过伏尔泰与狄德罗章节。
observations.note_en: Part IV is political history, Part II institutional history; only Part III (de-Christianisation, music and taste, public sphere) actually distinguishes Blanning from contemporaries. His music-history background shows — the Mozart/Haydn chapters are denser than the Voltaire/Diderot ones.

observations.title_zh: 与 Habermas 的隐性对话
observations.note_zh: 『公共领域的兴起』这一 motif 在 Ch.6-8 反复出现 —— Blanning 采纳哈贝马斯《公共领域的结构转型》的核心命题，但把它的时代从 18 世纪晚期上推到 1680 年前后。这是他对哈贝马斯命题的历史学改写。
observations.note_en: 'Rise of the public sphere' recurs Chs.6-8 — Blanning adopts Habermas' Structural Transformation but shifts its date from late-18th c. back to c.1680. A historian's revision of Habermas.

observations.title_zh: 『De-Christianization』命题的争议性
observations.note_zh: 第三部第二章沿用法国史学 (Vovelle, Boutry) 的『去基督教化』命题 —— 认为 1750-1850 法国-比利时-莱茵兰的教友实践率显著下降。这一命题在 2002 年本书出版时是主流；但 2010 年代后被 Michael Löwy, John Bossy, Hugh McLeod 等重新质疑，通读时应把这个争议挂起来看。
observations.note_en: Part III Ch.2 adopts Vovelle/Boutry's de-Christianisation thesis (1750-1850 decline in French/Belgian/Rhenish practice). Mainstream in 2002; contested since by Löwy, Bossy, McLeod — read this chapter knowing the later debate.

full_analysis.zh: **通读后的整体判断**：Blanning 本书是他自己在 1986-2002 十七年学术积累的收束 —— 每一部分都能在他之前的专著里找到源头 (Joseph II 1986 对应 Part II；French Revolutionary Wars 1989 对应 Part IV；Culture of Power and Power of Culture 2002 直接是 Part III 的扩展)。全书最原创的贡献是把『荣耀』(glory) 从心态史的氛围词改造为一种可追踪的社会资本 —— 让音乐、外交、宫廷、战争、艺术、沙龙进入同一分析框架。局限：(1) 『五场革命』的框架在书内实际只用三条 —— 农业革命与工业革命被压缩到 Ch.1 与 Ch.2 的一节内；(2) 对东欧 (波兰、俄罗斯、匈牙利) 的处理相对薄弱 —— 除彼得大帝的西化外，本书基本是西欧-中欧史；(3) 1789 之前的法国部分与 1789 之后的革命部分之间有一道方法论裂缝 —— Blanning 在旧制度部分用文化-社会史方法，在革命部分退回政治-军事史。
full_analysis.en: **Overall verdict after a full read**: Blanning's book is the summing of his own 1986-2002 research: every Part has a monograph source (Joseph II 1986 → Part II; French Revolutionary Wars 1989 → Part IV; Culture of Power 2002 → Part III). His most original contribution is transforming 'glory' from a mentalités mood-word into a traceable form of social capital — music, diplomacy, court, war, art, salon in one frame. Limitations: (1) the five-revolutions frame really uses only three in-text — agricultural and industrial revolutions compressed to sub-sections of Chs.1-2; (2) Eastern Europe (Poland, Russia, Hungary) under-covered — apart from Peter the Great's Westernisation, the book is West-Central European; (3) a methodological break between pre-1789 France and post-1789 Revolution — cultural-social history in the ancien régime sections, political-military in the revolutionary sections.

books.author: Richard J. Evans
