books.why_zh: 「漫长的19世纪」一百年——从维也纳会议到萨拉热窝——Evans（前剑桥 Regius 近代史教授）以928页的体量完成英语世界最好的19世纪欧洲通史。
books.why_en: The 'long 19th century' — Vienna to Sarajevo — Evans (former Regius Professor of Modern History, Cambridge) delivers the English-speaking world's best 19th-century European survey in 928 pages.

background.zh: Evans（剑桥大学 Regius 历史讲座教授 2008–2014 · FBA · 2012 年封爵 · Gresham College 校长）第七卷 1815–1914。时间一百年、地理全欧洲。核心论题：这是一个「权力被追求」的世纪——民族主义、自由主义、社会主义、帝国主义四大意识形态互相竞争；工业化重塑社会结构；科学（进化论、细菌学说、物理学）改变认知框架；1914 年一切走向灾难。2016 年出版即获广泛好评，被誉为「企鹅欧洲史系列中最出色的一卷」。
background.en: By Evans (Regius Professor of History Cambridge 2008–2014, FBA, knighted 2012, Provost of Gresham College since 2014; author of the Third Reich Trilogy). Volume 7, 1815–1914. One century, all of Europe. Core thesis: a century of 'power pursued' — nationalism, liberalism, socialism, imperialism competing; industrialization reshaping society; science (evolution, germ theory, physics) altering cognitive frameworks; 1914 heading to catastrophe. Hailed on publication as 'the strongest volume in the Penguin Europe series'.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第一章 · 革命的遗产
plot_acts.zh: 1815｜法国大革命与拿破仑的遗产 —— 维也纳体系、神圣同盟、民族与自由的双火种。
plot_acts.en: 1815｜French Revolution & Napoleon's legacy: Vienna settlement, Holy Alliance, twin sparks of nation and liberty.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.1 Legacies of Revolution —— 1815 欧洲的三重遗产：法国革命的政治语言、工业革命的初步物质基础、启蒙的知识框架。Evans 明确拒绝『复辟时代』的说法 —— 维也纳体系是在革命之后的稳定化。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.1: 1815 Europe's triple legacy — Revolutionary France's political language, industrial revolution's early material base, Enlightenment's intellectual frame. Vienna as stabilisation after revolution, not restoration.

brief.main: Ch.1 Legacies of Revolution —— 1815 欧洲的三重遗产：法国革命的政治语言、工业革命的初步物质基础、启蒙的知识框架。Evans 明确拒绝『复辟时代』的说法 —— 维也纳体系是在革命之后的稳定化，任何复辟都不得不吸收革命的语言。
brief.flow: 法国革命的制度遗产 (拿破仑法典、行政省制、荣誉军团、教务专约、度量衡、义务教育理想) → 工业革命的初步 (1800 之前的英国煤矿、纺织、冶铁、运河；欧洲大陆仍Agrarian) → 启蒙的知识框架 (科学共同体、百科全书派、废奴主义、公共舆论) → 维也纳会议 (1814-1815) 与 Holy Alliance / Quadruple Alliance → 复辟王朝 (Louis XVIII、Ferdinand VII、Franz I、Alexander I) 的内在矛盾 → 百日王朝与滑铁卢作为革命的余响。
brief.names: Metternich、Castlereagh、Talleyrand、Alexander I、Wilhelm III、Louis XVIII、Ferdinand VII、Franz I、Napoleon、Wellington、Blücher、Hardenberg、Watt (作为工业遗产)、Franklin、Voltaire、Rousseau
brief.sources: 维也纳会议决议与外交档案、拿破仑法典、Saint-Simon 早期政治写作、Hegel《法哲学原理》(1821 作为对 1815 的哲学回应)、同时人回忆录 (Gent、Narbonne、Metternich《Posthumous Papers》)
brief.link: 为 Ch.2 (1815-1849 大陆革命) 铺设结构性背景。
brief.main_en: Ch.1 Legacies of Revolution — the triple inheritance of 1815 Europe: the political language of the French Revolution, the early material base of the Industrial Revolution, and the intellectual framework of the Enlightenment. Evans explicitly rejects the label 'Restoration era' — the Vienna system is a stabilisation after revolution, and any restoration had to absorb the language of revolution.
brief.flow_en: The institutional legacy of the French Revolution (the Napoleonic Code, the département system, the Legion of Honour, the Concordat, metrics, the ideal of mass schooling) → the early Industrial Revolution (British coal, textiles, iron, canals before 1800; the Continent still agrarian) → the Enlightenment's intellectual framework (the scientific community, the philosophes, abolitionism, public opinion) → the Congress of Vienna (1814-1815) and the Holy / Quadruple Alliance → the internal contradiction of the restored dynasties (Louis XVIII, Ferdinand VII, Franz I, Alexander I) → the Hundred Days and Waterloo as revolution's after-echo.
brief.names_en: Metternich, Castlereagh, Talleyrand, Alexander I, Wilhelm III, Louis XVIII, Ferdinand VII, Franz I, Napoleon, Wellington, Blücher, Hardenberg, Watt (as industrial legacy), Franklin, Voltaire, Rousseau
brief.sources_en: The Vienna Congress final act and diplomatic archives; the Napoleonic Code; Saint-Simon's early political writings; Hegel's Philosophy of Right (1821 as a philosophical response to 1815); contemporaries' memoirs (Gent, Narbonne, Metternich's Posthumous Papers)
brief.link_en: Lays the structural background for Ch.2 (the continental revolutions 1815-1849).

plot_acts.title_zh: 第二章 · 自由的悖论
plot_acts.zh: 1815–1848｜复辟与革命之间 —— 立宪君主制、工业资本主义、工人运动、女性与少数群体的边缘自由。
plot_acts.en: 1815–1848｜Between restoration and revolution: constitutional monarchy, industrial capitalism, labour, marginalised freedoms.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.2 The Continental powers 1815-1849 —— 从维也纳到 1848。Evans 用同一时间轴处理法德奥俄意 —— 1848 是民族-自由-社会三场革命的同时爆发。这一章的方法论意义大于叙事意义。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.2: Vienna to 1848 across France/Germany/Austria/Russia/Italy simultaneously — 1848 as nationalist + liberal + social revolution exploding at once. Method > narrative here.

brief.main: Ch.2 The Continental Powers 1815-1849 —— 从维也纳到 1848。Evans 用同一时间轴处理法德奥俄意 —— 1848 是民族-自由-社会三场革命的同时爆发。这一章的方法论意义大于叙事意义：六国同叙事是 Evans 招牌。
brief.flow: Legitimist 复辟 (法国 1815-1830、西班牙 1814-1820、意大利诸邦) → 拉丁美洲独立 (Bolívar、San Martín 1810-1830) 对欧洲的影响 → 希腊独立 (1821-1830) 与东方问题 → 七月革命 (1830 法国、比利时、波兰) → 七月王朝 (Louis-Philippe) → 1830 英国 Reform Act → 意大利烧炭党、德国 Wartburg 集会 (1817)、Carlsbad 决议 (1819)、Hambach 集会 (1832)、1848 前夜的德意志自由主义 → 1848 二月革命 (法国) → 三月革命 (维也纳、柏林、米兰、威尼斯、布达佩斯、布拉格) → Frankfurt Paulskirche → 六月起义与巴黎血腥周 → 1849 反扑 (Louis-Napoleon 当选 1848.12、奥地利对匈牙利的镇压 1849)。
brief.names: Louis XVIII、Charles X、Louis-Philippe、Napoleon III、Metternich、Franz Joseph I、Ferdinand I、Pius IX、Lamartine、Cavaignac、Ledru-Rollin、Kossuth、Batthyány、Armand Marrast、Mazzini、Garibaldi、Frederick William IV、Friedrich Hecker、Gottfried Kinkel、Robert Blum、Carl Vogt、Ruge、Marx (1848《宣言》)
brief.sources: 1848 诸国议会记录 (Frankfurt Paulskirche、Paris 制宪议会、Berlin 议会、Vienna Reichstag、Frankfurt)、当时报纸 (Neue Rheinische Zeitung、Times、Presse、Reform)、Marx/Engels《宣言》与《法兰西阶级斗争》、Tocqueville《回忆录》、Heine《Deutschland》
brief.link: 为 Ch.3 (帝国) 与 Ch.4 (社会-经济) 铺路 —— 1848 失败说明单纯民族-自由革命不够，还需要社会与帝国的重组。
brief.main_en: Ch.2 The Continental Powers 1815-1849 — from Vienna to 1848. Evans treats France, Germany, Austria, Russia and Italy on a single timeline — 1848 as the simultaneous outbreak of national, liberal and social revolution. This chapter's methodological significance exceeds its narrative: six-states-as-one-story is Evans's signature.
brief.flow_en: Legitimist restoration (France 1815-1830, Spain 1814-1820, the Italian states) → Latin American independence (Bolívar, San Martín 1810-1830) and its effect on Europe → Greek independence (1821-1830) and the Eastern Question → the July Revolution (1830 France, Belgium, Poland) → the July Monarchy (Louis-Philippe) → Britain's 1830 Reform trajectory → the Italian Carbonari, the Wartburg festival (1817), the Carlsbad Decrees (1819), the Hambach festival (1832), German liberalism on the eve of 1848 → the February Revolution (France 1848) → the March Revolution (Vienna, Berlin, Milan, Venice, Budapest, Prague) → the Frankfurt Paulskirche → the June days and the bloody week in Paris → the 1849 backlash (Louis-Napoleon's election Dec 1848, Austria's suppression of Hungary 1849).
brief.names_en: Louis XVIII, Charles X, Louis-Philippe, Napoleon III, Metternich, Franz Joseph I, Ferdinand I, Pius IX, Lamartine, Cavaignac, Ledru-Rollin, Kossuth, Batthyány, Armand Marrast, Mazzini, Garibaldi, Frederick William IV, Friedrich Hecker, Gottfried Kinkel, Robert Blum, Carl Vogt, Ruge, Marx (the 1848 Manifesto)
brief.sources_en: The parliamentary records of 1848 across states (the Frankfurt Paulskirche, the Paris constituent assembly, the Berlin assembly, the Vienna Reichstag); the newspapers of the day (Neue Rheinische Zeitung, the Times, the Presse); Marx/Engels's Manifesto and Class Struggles in France; Tocqueville's Recollections; Heine's Deutschland
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.3 (Empires) and Ch.4 (Society-Economy) — the failure of 1848 shows that a purely national-liberal revolution is not enough; social and imperial reorganisation is also needed.

plot_acts.zh: 1848–1849｜1848 年革命 —— 从巴黎到维也纳、柏林、布达佩斯、米兰的百年一遇浪潮，其挫败与遗产。
plot_acts.en: 1848–1849｜1848: Paris to Vienna, Berlin, Budapest, Milan — the once-in-a-century wave, its defeat and its inheritance.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.3 The Imperial Powers —— 大英-哈布斯堡-罗曼诺夫三大帝国的多民族治理。Evans 强调：19 世纪的『民族国家』只是路径之一，帝国才是常态；一战不是帝国的失败而是它内部矛盾的外溢。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.3: British-Habsburg-Romanov multi-ethnic governance. Evans stresses nation-state was only one path; empire was the norm. WWI isn't empire's failure but its internal contradictions leaking out.

brief.main: Ch.3 The Imperial Powers —— 大英-哈布斯堡-罗曼诺夫三大帝国的多民族治理。Evans 强调：19 世纪的『民族国家』只是路径之一，帝国才是常态；一战不是帝国的失败而是它内部矛盾的外溢。这一章把本书与同期『新帝国史』(Bayly、Darwin) 区别开。
brief.flow: 大英帝国的第二帝国 (1783 美洲失去 → 1815 印度-非洲扩张 → 1857 印度兵变与 Crown 接管 → 1867 加拿大自治领 → 1880s 非洲瓜分) → 哈布斯堡的 1848-1867 重组 (Ausgleich 1867) → 罗曼诺夫帝国 (波兰、芬兰、高加索、中亚、西伯利亚、波兰起义 1830/1863) → 奥斯曼帝国的『欧洲病夫』化 (希腊 1830、比利时-黎巴嫩 1840、克里米亚 1853-56、巴尔干危机 1875-78、柏林会议 1878、亚美尼亚 1890s) → 民族主义作为帝国内部离心力的机制 → 帝国作为集体心理的对外扩张。
brief.names: Queen Victoria、Palmerston、Disraeli、Gladstone、Canning、Cornwallis、Wellesley、Havelock、Canning、Lyton、Dufferin、Rosebery、Chamberlain、Kitchener；Franz Joseph、Elisabeth (Sissi)、Andrássy、Deák、Bacony；Nicholas I、Alexander II、Alexander III、Nicholas II、Pobedonostsev、Muravyov、Stolypin (稍后)；Abdülmecid、Abdülhamid II、Midhat Pasha
brief.sources: 各帝国殖民档案 (British India Office、Austrian Haus-Hof-und Staatsarchiv、Russian RGIA、Ottoman BOA)、探险与游记、民族志、帝国普查、军用地图、Exposition Universelle 记录
brief.link: 为 Ch.8 (The Wages of Empire) 的 1914 收尾做长线布局。
brief.main_en: Ch.3 The Imperial Powers — the multinational governance of the British, Habsburg and Romanov empires. Evans stresses: the 19th-century 'nation state' is only one path, empire is the norm; the Great War is not empire's failure but the outward spillover of its internal contradictions. This chapter distinguishes the book from the contemporary 'new imperial history' (Bayly, Darwin).
brief.flow_en: Britain's Second Empire (the loss of America 1783 → the India-Africa expansion after 1815 → the 1857 Indian mutiny and Crown takeover → the Canadian dominion 1867 → the 1880s Scramble for Africa) → Habsburg reorganisation 1848-1867 (the Ausgleich 1867) → the Romanov empire (Poland, Finland, the Caucasus, Central Asia, Siberia, the Polish uprisings 1830/1863) → the Ottoman 'sick man of Europe' (Greece 1830, Lebanon 1840, Crimea 1853-56, the Balkan crisis 1875-78, the Berlin Congress 1878, Armenia in the 1890s) → nationalism as the mechanism of internal centripetal force → empire as collective psychology's outward expansion.
brief.names_en: Queen Victoria, Palmerston, Disraeli, Gladstone, Canning, Cornwallis, Wellesley, Havelock, Lyton, Dufferin, Rosebery, Chamberlain, Kitchener; Franz Joseph, Elisabeth (Sissi), Andrássy, Deák; Nicholas I, Alexander II, Alexander III, Nicholas II, Pobedonostsev, Muravyov, Stolypin (slightly later); Abdülmecid, Abdülhamid II, Midhat Pasha
brief.sources_en: The colonial archives of each empire (British India Office, the Austrian Haus-Hof-und Staatsarchiv, the Russian RGIA, the Ottoman BOA); exploration and travel writing; ethnographies; imperial censuses; military maps; the Exposition Universelle records
brief.link_en: A long-line setup for Ch.8's 1914 conclusion (The Wages of Empire).

plot_acts.zh: 1850s–1870s｜城市化、铁路、电报、工人阶级与大众政党的形成 —— 日常生活的深层重组。
plot_acts.en: 1850s–1870s｜Urbanisation, railways, telegraph, working class, mass parties — deep reshaping of everyday life.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.4 Society and Economy —— 人口爆炸、城市化、铁路、阶级形成。Evans 处理『群众』如何成为 19 世纪下半叶的历史主体 —— 从乡村手工业者到无产阶级到新中产白领。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.4: population boom, urbanisation, railways, class formation. How 'the masses' became history's subject in the second half of the 19th century — artisan → proletariat → new white-collar middle.

brief.main: Ch.4 Society and Economy —— 人口爆炸、城市化、铁路、阶级形成。Evans 处理『群众』如何成为 19 世纪下半叶的历史主体 —— 从乡村手工业者到无产阶级到新中产白领。这一部分是本书社会史的核心。
brief.flow: 人口：欧洲 1800 约 1.9 亿 → 1914 约 4.6 亿，翻倍以上 → 农业革命 (轮作、化肥、机械) 与土地释放 → 城市化 (Manchester、Essen、Lille、Milan、St. Petersburg 的爆炸增长) → 铁路 (1830 利物浦-曼彻斯特 → 1850 欧洲大陆网 → 1880 全球网) → 工业结构 (纺织 → 钢铁 → 化学 → 电气) → 阶级形成 (工人阶级 E. P. Thompson 命题、中产阶级的维多利亚理想、贵族的持续) → 生活水平的『标准辩论』(Standard of Living Debate 1950s-) → 消费社会的形成 (百货、连锁、广告)。
brief.names: Robert Owen、Friedrich List、Karl Marx、Friedrich Engels、Louis Blanc、St-Simon、Fourier、Proudhon、Bakunin、Chadwick (英国公共卫生)、Lyon Playfair、Liebig、Siemens、Bessemer (钢)、Perkin (苯胺染料)、Edison、Werner von Siemens
brief.sources: 工厂视察员报告 (British Parliamentary Blue Books)、Engels《英国工人阶级状况》(1845)、Marx《资本论》、Villermé《法国工人阶级状况》、Le Play 家计调查、Booth 伦敦贫困调查 (1889-1903)、Rowntree 约克调查 (1901)、人口普查、教区登记、工会档案
brief.link: 为 Ch.7 (民主的挑战) 铺路 —— 阶级形成必然导致大众政治。
brief.main_en: Ch.4 Society and Economy — the population explosion, urbanisation, the railways, class formation. Evans treats how 'the masses' became the historical subject of the later 19th century — from rural artisan to proletariat to the new white-collar middle class. This part is the book's social-history core.
brief.flow_en: Population: Europe some 190 million in 1800 → about 460 million by 1914, more than a doubling → the agricultural revolution (rotation, fertiliser, machinery) and the release of land → urbanisation (the explosive growth of Manchester, Essen, Lille, Milan, St Petersburg) → the railways (Liverpool-Manchester 1830 → the continental network by 1850 → a global network by 1880) → industrial structure (textiles → steel → chemicals → electricity) → class formation (the working class, the E. P. Thompson thesis; the Victorian middle-class ideal; the persistence of the aristocracy) → the 'standard of living debate' (1950s-) → the forming of a consumer society (department stores, chains, advertising).
brief.names_en: Robert Owen, Friedrich List, Karl Marx, Friedrich Engels, Louis Blanc, Saint-Simon, Fourier, Proudhon, Bakunin, Chadwick (British public health), Lyon Playfair, Liebig, Siemens, Bessemer (steel), Perkin (aniline dye), Edison, Werner von Siemens
brief.sources_en: The factory inspectors' reports (British Parliamentary Blue Books); Engels's Condition of the Working Class in England (1845); Marx's Capital; Villermé on the French working class; Le Play's household surveys; Booth's London poverty survey (1889-1903); Rowntree's York survey (1901); census data, parish registers, trade-union archives
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.7 (The Challenge of Democracy) — class formation necessarily leads to mass politics.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第五章 · 自然的征服
plot_acts.zh: 1850s–1880s｜达尔文、巴斯德、开尔文、电磁学与化学工业 —— 科学如何重塑认知框架与国家能力。
plot_acts.en: 1850s–1880s｜Darwin, Pasteur, Kelvin, electromagnetism, chemical industry — science re-making cognition and state capacity.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.5 The Conquest of Nature —— 表面是农业-工业技术史，实际论点是：1850-1880 的欧洲同时征服了外部自然 (化肥/铁路/电报) 与内部自然 (细菌学/麻醉/统计治理)。这是全书的方法论双联画之一。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.5: surface agrarian-industrial tech, real thesis 1850-1880 Europe conquers both external nature (fertiliser, rail, telegraph) and internal nature (bacteriology, anaesthesia, statistical governance). Diptych.

brief.main: Ch.5 The Conquest of Nature —— 表面是农业-工业技术史，实际论点是：1850-1880 的欧洲同时征服了外部自然 (化肥/铁路/电报) 与内部自然 (细菌学/麻醉/统计治理)。Evans 处理科学-感官双联画的第一联。
brief.flow: 外部自然：农业化学 (Liebig 1840s)、化肥进口 (智利硝石、秘鲁鸟粪)、机械 (McCormick 收割机、蒸汽脱粒)、育种 (Vilmorin)、森林科学 (Höss、Heyer)、河流治理 (莱茵 Tulla、多瑙、波河)、铁路 (工程：Brunel、Stephenson、Talbot)、电报 (Cooke-Wheatstone 1837、Morse 1844、跨大西洋 1866)、蒸汽船 (Brunel 大不列颠 1845、苏伊士 1869) → 内部自然：麻醉 (Ether 1846、Chloroform 1847 Snow)、消毒 (Semmelweis 1847、Lister 1865)、细菌学 (Pasteur 1857-1885、Koch 1876-1890)、疫苗 (Pasteur 狂犬 1885)、公共卫生统计 (Guy's Hospital、Farr、Wundt 心理物理学的量化)、性科学 (Krafft-Ebing 1886 Psychopathia Sexualis、Havelock Ellis、Freud 1900)、精神病学 (Morselli、Kraepelin 1883 分类)、犯罪学 (Lombroso 1876)。
brief.names: Liebig、Wöhler、Brunel、Stephenson、Cooke、Wheatstone、Morse、Siemens、Pasteur、Koch、Jenner (作为背景)、Lister、Semmelweis、Snow、Nightingale、Farr、Galton、Darwin (Ch.5 与 Ch.6 双联画的轴心)、Huxley、Lyell、Mendel (1866 修院论文，当时被忽视)、Krafft-Ebing、Ellis、Charcot、Freud、Kraepelin、Lombroso
brief.sources: 科学论文 (Philosophical Transactions、Comptes rendus、Annalen der Physik)、医学杂志 (Lancet、BMJ)、工业专利、农业调查、人口普查统计、医院病案、精神病学档案、解剖学教科书
brief.link: 与 Ch.6 (情感的时代) 形成双联画 —— 一个处理外部-内部自然的征服，一个处理情感成为知识对象。
brief.main_en: Ch.5 The Conquest of Nature — on the surface an agricultural-industrial technology history, but its real thesis is that Europe between 1850 and 1880 conquered both external nature (fertiliser/railway/telegraph) and internal nature (bacteriology/anaesthesia/statistical governance). Evans's first panel of the science-sensation diptych.
brief.flow_en: External nature: agricultural chemistry (Liebig, 1840s), fertiliser imports (Chilean nitrate, Peruvian guano), machinery (the McCormick reaper, steam threshing), breeding (Vilmorin), forest science (Höss, Heyer), river regulation (the Rhine Tulla, the Danube, the Po), the railways (engineering: Brunel, Stephenson, Talbot), the telegraph (Cooke-Wheatstone 1837, Morse 1844, transatlantic 1866), the steamship (Brunel's Great Britain 1845, Suez 1869) → internal nature: anaesthesia (ether 1846, chloroform, Snow 1847), antisepsis (Semmelweis 1847, Lister 1865), bacteriology (Pasteur 1857-1885, Koch 1876-1890), vaccines (Pasteur's rabies 1885), public-health statistics (Farr, quantification), sexology (Krafft-Ebing's Psychopathia Sexualis 1886, Havelock Ellis, Freud 1900), psychiatry (Kraepelin's classification 1883), criminology (Lombroso 1876).
brief.names_en: Liebig, Wöhler, Brunel, Stephenson, Cooke, Wheatstone, Morse, Siemens, Pasteur, Koch, Jenner (as background), Lister, Semmelweis, Snow, Nightingale, Farr, Galton, Darwin (the pivot of the Ch.5/Ch.6 diptych), Huxley, Lyell, Mendel (the 1866 monastery paper, ignored at the time), Krafft-Ebing, Ellis, Charcot, Freud, Kraepelin, Lombroso
brief.sources_en: Scientific papers (Philosophical Transactions, Comptes rendus, Annalen der Physik); medical journals (Lancet, BMJ); industrial patents; agricultural surveys; census statistics; hospital case records; psychiatric archives; anatomy textbooks
brief.link_en: Forms a diptych with Ch.6 (The Age of Emotion) — one treats the conquest of external-internal nature, the other the becoming-an-object-of-knowledge of the emotions.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第六章 · 情感的时代
plot_acts.zh: 1850s–1900s｜维多利亚式家庭与性别秩序 —— 从查尔斯·狄更斯到西格蒙德·弗洛伊德，情感成为知识对象。
plot_acts.en: 1850s–1900s｜Victorian family and gender order: from Dickens to Freud — emotion emerges as an object of knowledge.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.6 The Age of Emotion —— 小说、音乐、绘画、宗教复兴、性科学被处理为『情感成为知识对象』的同一进程 —— 从简·奥斯汀到威尔第到弗洛伊德。Evans 最像新文化史的一章。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.6: novel, music, painting, evangelical revival, sex science as one process — emotion becoming an object of knowledge, from Austen to Verdi to Freud. Evans' most New-Cultural-History chapter.

brief.main: Ch.6 The Age of Emotion —— 小说、音乐、绘画、宗教复兴、性科学全部处理为『情感成为知识对象』的同一进程 —— 从简·奥斯汀到威尔第到弗洛伊德。Evans 最像新文化史的一章。
brief.flow: 文学与情感教育 (Austen 1811-1815、Balzac 1829-1846、Stendhal 1830 红与黑、George Eliot 1859-1871、Dickens 1836-1870、Flaubert 1856/1869、Tolstoy 1869/1877、Dostoevsky 1866/1879/1880、Ibsen 1879、Strindberg、Wilde 1890) → 音乐 (Beethoven 中期英雄 → Chopin、Schumann、Liszt、Wagner 1845-1882、Verdi 1839-1893、Brahms 1850s-1890s、Tchaikovsky 1866-1893) → 绘画 (Romanticism David→Géricault→Delacroix→Friedrich→Turner→Constable → Realism Courbet→Daumier→Millet → Impressionism 1874 → Post-Impressionism 1880s-1900s) → 宗教复兴 (Newman、Oxford Movement 1833、Vianney、de Montfort、Ratisbonne、Catholic revival in Bavaria、Awakenings) → 情感科学化 (Duchenne 面部表情 1862、Darwin《人与动物的情感表达》1872、Wundt 心理物理 1879、James《心理学原理》1890、Freud《梦的释义》1900)。
brief.names: Austen、Balzac、Stendhal、Dickens、Eliot、Brontës、Flaubert、Zola、Tolstoy、Dostoevsky、Ibsen、Strindberg、Wilde、Beethoven、Chopin、Schumann、Liszt、Berlioz、Wagner、Verdi、Brahms、Tchaikovsky、Delacroix、Géricault、Friedrich、Turner、Constable、Courbet、Millet、Manet、Monet、Renoir、Degas、Cézanne、van Gogh、Gauguin、Newman、Pusey、Vianney、Darwin、Duchenne、Wundt、James、Freud
brief.sources: 小说原文、乐谱与音乐会节目、画展目录、Salon 记录、宗教复兴小册子、期刊与书评、心理生理学实验记录、Freud 临床笔记 (Project for a Scientific Psychology 1895)
brief.link: 与 Ch.5 双联画的第二联 —— 外部-内部自然 + 情感成为知识对象。为 Ch.7 民主的挑战做文化-心理铺垫。
brief.main_en: Ch.6 The Age of Emotion — the novel, music, painting, religious revival and sexology all treated as one and the same process, 'the emotions becoming an object of knowledge' — from Jane Austen to Verdi to Freud. The chapter where Evans is closest to the new cultural history.
brief.flow_en: Literature and the education of feeling (Austen 1811-1815, Balzac, Stendhal's Red and Black 1830, George Eliot, Dickens, Flaubert, Tolstoy, Dostoevsky, Ibsen 1879, Strindberg, Wilde 1890) → music (Beethoven's middle heroic phase → Chopin, Schumann, Liszt, Wagner, Verdi, Brahms, Tchaikovsky) → painting (Romanticism David→Géricault→Delacroix→Friedrich→Turner→Constable → Realism Courbet→Daumier→Millet → Impressionism 1874 → Post-Impressionism 1880s-1900s) → religious revival (Newman, the Oxford Movement 1833, the Curé of Ars, Catholic revival in Bavaria, the Awakenings) → the scientising of emotion (Duchenne on facial expression 1862, Darwin's Expression of the Emotions 1872, Wundt's psychophysics 1879, James's Principles of Psychology 1890, Freud's Interpretation of Dreams 1900).
brief.names_en: Austen, Balzac, Stendhal, Dickens, Eliot, the Brontës, Flaubert, Zola, Tolstoy, Dostoevsky, Ibsen, Strindberg, Wilde, Beethoven, Chopin, Schumann, Liszt, Berlioz, Wagner, Verdi, Brahms, Tchaikovsky, Delacroix, Géricault, Friedrich, Turner, Constable, Courbet, Millet, Manet, Monet, Renoir, Degas, Cézanne, van Gogh, Gauguin, Newman, Pusey, Darwin, Duchenne, Wundt, James, Freud
brief.sources_en: The novels themselves; scores and concert programmes; exhibition catalogues; Salon records; religious-revival pamphlets; periodicals and book reviews; psychophysics experiment records; Freud's clinical notes (the Project for a Scientific Psychology 1895)
brief.link_en: The second panel of the Ch.5 diptych — external-internal nature + the emotions becoming an object of knowledge. A cultural-psychological preamble to Ch.7's challenge of democracy.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第七章 · 民主的挑战
plot_acts.zh: 1870s–1900｜议会改革、工人政党、妇女运动、社会主义与国际 —— 自由主义秩序对大众政治的接生。
plot_acts.en: 1870s–1900｜Reform acts, labour parties, suffrage, socialism and International — liberalism giving birth to mass politics.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.7 The Challenge of Democracy —— 议会改革、工人政党、妇女运动、社会党与民族主义的关系。Evans 论证自由主义秩序对大众政治的吸纳是 1870-1900 的核心政治史。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.7: parliamentary reform, labour parties, suffragettes, social democracy vs nationalism. Liberal order's absorption of mass politics is the core of 1870-1900 political history.

brief.main: Ch.7 The Challenge of Democracy —— 议会改革、工人政党、妇女运动、社会党与民族主义的关系。Evans 论证自由主义秩序对大众政治的吸纳是 1870-1900 的核心政治史 —— 民主既颠覆又强化了民族国家。
brief.flow: 选举权扩展 (Reform Act 1832、1867、1884；法国 1848 男性普选；德国 1871 男性普选但帝国议会权力受限；奥地利 1907 男性普选；意大利 1882、1912/1913) → 工人政党 (German SPD 1875 Gotha / 1891 Erfurt、French SFIO 1905、British Labour 1900、Italian PSI 1892、Russian RSDLP 1898) → 工会合法化 (UK 1824-1875、France 1884、Germany 1890s) → 社会主义理论 (Marx/Engels 1848 →《资本论》1867/1885/1894、Bernstein 修正主义 1899、Kautsky、Bebel、Jaurès、Plekhanov、Lenin 1902《怎么办》) → 妇女运动 (Seneca Falls 1848 美、英国 Pankhurst WSPU 1903、法国 Hubertine Auclert、新西兰 1893 首获选举权) → 农民政党与大众天主教 (Deutschland Zentrumspartei 1870、荷兰 ABVP、比利时天主教党、意大利 Partito Popolare) → 民族主义的大众化 (泛凯尔特、泛日耳曼、泛斯拉夫、锡安主义 Herzl 1896) → 军国主义与殖民大众化。
brief.names: Marx、Engels、Bernstein、Kautsky、Bebel、Jaurès、Guesde、Broussier、Lloyd George、Gladstone、Disraeli、Chamberlain、Balfour、Pankhurst (Emmeline、Christabel)、Asquith、Lloyd George、Briand、Combes、Sanger (稍后)、Bebel、Scheidemann、Ebert、Auclert、Richards、Pankhurst、Hubertine、Séverine、Herzl、Nordau、Chamberlain (Joseph)、Dreyfus 事件诸人 (1894-1906)
brief.sources: 议会记录、党纲 (Gotha、Erfurt)、工会档案、警方监控记录 (Okhrana、Special Branch)、妇女运动报刊、Marx/Engels 全集、Lenin 早期著作、选举统计、人口普查、宣传漫画
brief.link: 为 Ch.8 (帝国的代价) 与 1914 铺路 —— 民主既让战争更不可想象又更不可阻止。
brief.main_en: Ch.7 The Challenge of Democracy — parliamentary reform, workers' parties, the women's movement, and the relation of socialism to nationalism. Evans argues that liberalism's absorption of mass politics is the core political history of 1870-1900 — democracy both undermined and strengthened the nation state.
brief.flow_en: The extension of the franchise (Reform Acts 1832, 1867, 1884; French male universal suffrage 1848; German male suffrage 1871 with a limited Reichstag; Austrian male suffrage 1907; Italy 1882, 1912/1913) → workers' parties (the German SPD 1875 Gotha / 1891 Erfurt, the French SFIO 1905, British Labour 1900, the Italian PSI 1892, the Russian RSDLP 1898) → the legalising of trade unions (UK 1824-1875, France 1884, Germany in the 1890s) → socialist theory (Marx/Engels 1848 → Capital 1867/1885/1894, Bernstein's revisionism 1899, Kautsky, Bebel, Jaurès, Plekhanov, Lenin's What Is to Be Done? 1902) → the women's movement (Seneca Falls 1848 in the US, the Pankhursts' WSPU 1903 in Britain, Hubertine Auclert in France, New Zealand the first to grant the vote 1893) → peasants' parties and mass Catholicism (the German Zentrum 1870, the Dutch ABVP, the Belgian Catholic Party, the Italian Partito Popolare) → the popularising of nationalism (Pan-Celtic, Pan-German, Pan-Slav, Zionism Herzl 1896) → militarism and the popularising of colonisation.
brief.names_en: Marx, Engels, Bernstein, Kautsky, Bebel, Jaurès, Guesde, Lloyd George, Gladstone, Disraeli, Chamberlain, Balfour, the Pankhursts (Emmeline, Christabel), Asquith, Briand, Combes, Scheidemann, Ebert, Auclert, Séverine, Herzl, Nordau, the figures of the Dreyfus affair (1894-1906)
brief.sources_en: Parliamentary records; party programmes (Gotha, Erfurt); trade-union archives; police surveillance records (the Okhrana, the Special Branch); women's-movement press; the Marx/Engels collected works; Lenin's early writings; election statistics; census data; propaganda cartoons
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.8 (The Wages of Empire) and 1914 — democracy made the war at once more unimaginable and more unstoppable.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第八章 · 帝国的代价
plot_acts.zh: 1870–1914｜新帝国主义、'瓜分非洲'、大博弈、社会达尔文主义 —— 直到 1914 年 8 月那场谁也不真正想要、又谁也不真正避免的大战。
plot_acts.en: 1870–1914｜New imperialism, Scramble for Africa, Great Game, Social-Darwinism — up to the 1914 war nobody wanted but nobody averted.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.8 The Wages of Empire —— 全书的高潮。新帝国主义不是力量的过度而是焦虑的外溢 —— 到 1914 年主要欧洲国家都在自我说服一场谁也不想要的大战。Evans 的宿命论收尾。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.8: climax. New imperialism not overreach of strength but leakage of anxiety — by 1914 every major state had talked itself into a war nobody wanted. Evans' fatalistic close.

brief.main: Ch.8 The Wages of Empire —— 全书的高潮。新帝国主义不是力量的过度而是焦虑的外溢 —— 到 1914 年主要欧洲国家都在自我说服一场谁也不想要的大战。Evans 的宿命论收尾 —— 通读全书的政治-社会-文化-科学各章，全部指向这一句。
brief.flow: 新帝国主义 (1870s-)：欧洲海外扩张的速度与逻辑 (Berlin Conference 1884-85 刚果瓜分、Fashoda 1898、Boer War 1899-1902、Morocco 危机 1905/1911) → 社会达尔文主义 (Spencer、Haeckel、Galton 优生学 1869/1904) 与 races hierarchy → 军备竞赛 (德国舰队法 1898/1900、Battleship 无畏舰 1906、法俄与德奥同盟体系硬化) → 民族主义的大众化 (泛斯拉夫、泛日耳曼、法兰西复仇主义、意大利 irredentism、锡安主义) → 巴尔干 Wars (1912-1913) 与『欧洲火药桶』 → 1914 七月危机：Sarajevo 6.28 → Austria 最后通牒 7.23 → Russia 总动员 7.30 → Germany 对俄宣战 8.1、对法 8.3 → Belgium 入侵 8.4 → UK 对德宣战 8.4 → 各大国的自我说服过程。
brief.names: Disraeli、Gladstone、Milner、Chamberlain (Joseph)、 Rhodes、Cecil、Brod (Israel)、Hilferding、Luxemburg、Lenin (1916《帝国主义》作为事后论)、Bernhardi《Deutschland und der nächste Krieg》1912、Fischer (1961 汉堡论战主角)、Grey、Poincaré、Sazonov、Bethmann-Hollweg、Jagow、Szöllrenyi、Conrad von Hötzendorf、Ivanov、Nikolai Nikolaevich、Crown Prince Rudolf (1889 Mayerling 事件)、Gavrilo Princip、Franz Ferdinand
brief.sources: 各国外交文书 (DBI、DDF、ADGP、CAP、British Documents on the Origins of the War)、军备与舰队法文本、社会达尔文主义论著、1914 七月危机各国决策记录、War Guilt 论战 (Fischer 学派 vs Ritter/Gallop)、同时人回忆录 (Asquith、Lloyd George、Grey、Nicholas II、Bethmann-Hollweg)
brief.link: 与下一卷 Vol.8 (Kershaw《To Hell and Back》1914-) 直接衔接 —— Evans 的 1914 正是 Kershaw 的起点。
brief.main_en: Ch.8 The Wages of Empire — the book's climax. The new imperialism is not an excess of strength but an overflow of anxiety — by 1914 the major European states were all persuading themselves into a great war that no one actually wanted. Evans's fatalistic close — reading across the book's political, social, cultural and scientific chapters, all point to this one sentence.
brief.flow_en: The new imperialism (from the 1870s): the speed and logic of overseas expansion (the Berlin Conference 1884-85's Congo partition, Fashoda 1898, the Boer War 1899-1902, the Morocco crises 1905/1911) → Social Darwinism (Spencer, Haeckel, Galton's eugenics 1869/1904) and the hierarchy of races → the arms race (the German fleet laws 1898/1900, the Dreadnought 1906, the hardening of the Franco-Russian and German-Austrian alliance systems) → the popularising of nationalism (Pan-Slav, Pan-German, French revanchism, Italian irredentism, Zionism) → the Balkan Wars (1912-1913) and the 'powder keg of Europe' → the July Crisis of 1914: Sarajevo 28 June → Austria's ultimatum 23 July → Russia's general mobilisation 30 July → Germany's declarations of war on Russia 1 Aug and France 3 Aug → the invasion of Belgium 4 Aug → Britain's declaration of war 4 Aug → the process of each great power's self-persuasion.
brief.names_en: Disraeli, Gladstone, Milner, Chamberlain (Joseph), Rhodes, Lansdowne, Hilferding, Luxemburg, Lenin (the 1916 Imperialism as an after-the-fact theory), Bernhardi's Deutschland und der nächste Krieg 1912, Fischer (the 1961 Hamburg controversy's protagonist), Grey, Poincaré, Sazonov, Bethmann-Hollweg, Jagow, Szöllrenyi, Conrad von Hötzendorf, Ivanov, Grand Duke Nikolai Nikolaevich, Crown Prince Rudolf (the 1889 Mayerling affair), Gavrilo Princip, Franz Ferdinand
brief.sources_en: The diplomatic documents of each state (DBI, DDF, ADGP, CAP, British Documents on the Origins of the War); the texts of arms and fleet laws; Social-Darwinist writings; the decision records of the July Crisis 1914 across states; the war-guilt controversy (the Fischer school vs Ritter/Gallop); contemporaries' memoirs (Asquith, Lloyd George, Grey, Nicholas II, Bethmann-Hollweg)
brief.link_en: Connects directly to Vol.8 (Kershaw, To Hell and Back, from 1914) — Evans's 1914 is precisely Kershaw's starting point.

narrative.zh: 三段式大编年（革命年代、统一年代、帝国年代），每段内按政治、经济、文化、科学四线展开。Evans 特色：在宏观叙事中不断插入微观轶事和引文，让结构分析有血肉感。
narrative.en: Three-phase grand chronology (revolutionary, unification, imperial decades), each with political/economic/cultural/scientific sub-threads. Evans signature: inserting micro-anecdotes and quotations into macro-narrative, giving structural analysis flesh and blood.

quotes.orig: The pursuit of power permeated European society in the nineteenth century.
quotes.trans_zh: 对权力的追求，渗透进十九世纪欧洲的整个社会。
quotes.source: Evans《权力的追求：欧洲 1815–1914》· 导论 · Introduction
quotes.source_en: Richard J. Evans, The Pursuit of Power: Europe 1815–1914 · Introduction

quotes.orig: And yet, as well as being an evolving assemblage of individual states, Europe, as this book hopes to demonstrate, also had a definable existence as a collective entity.
quotes.trans_zh: 然而，欧洲不仅是众多主权国家不断演化的集合；本书试图证明，它同样具有一种可辨识的、作为共同体的存在。
quotes.source: Evans《权力的追求：欧洲 1815–1914》· 导论 · Introduction
quotes.source_en: Richard J. Evans, The Pursuit of Power: Europe 1815–1914 · Introduction

intent.reception_good_zh: 「当代英语世界最权威的19世纪欧洲史」——The Guardian、TLS 一致好评。
intent.reception_good_en: 'The most authoritative 19th-century European history in contemporary English' — unanimous Guardian, TLS acclaim.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 体量与视角是主要保留：近千页、材料密度极高，对普通读者门槛不低；东欧、巴尔干与殖民帝国虽优于多数同类通史，主轴仍是「革命—民族国家—工业化」的西北欧轨迹。埃文斯以大量转引二手文献支撑全景，个别领域（全球经济、生态、技术）依赖他人研究而非原创综合，被一些评论者认为「最好的部分是叙述、最弱的是判断」；性别与种族线索虽前所未有地被织入，却有时呈专题拼贴而非贯穿的分析轴。
intent.reception_bad_en: Scale and vantage are the reservations: nearly a thousand pages of very high data density daunt general readers; and though Eastern Europe, the Balkans and the colonial empires fare better than most syntheses, the spine remains a north-west European 'revolution-nation-state-industrialisation' trajectory. Evans sustains the panorama with heavy reliance on secondary literature, so some reviewers find the best parts narrative and the weakest judgement, notably in global economy, ecology and technology; gender and race, though unprecedentedly woven in, can read as topical insertions rather than a through-going analytic axis.
intent.syn_zh: 「权力的追求」既是民族国家间的权力政治，也是阶级、性别、种族的内部权力争夺——Evans 把19世纪写成全方位权力竞争的世纪。
intent.syn_en: 'Power pursued' is both inter-state power politics AND internal struggles over class, gender, race — Evans writes the 19th century as a totality of power competition.

craft.zh: 宏观叙事中插入微观轶事和直接引文——让920页保持可读性
craft.en: Micro-anecdotes and direct quotations within macro-narrative — keeping 928 pages readable

craft.zh: 四大意识形态的竞争叙事框架（自由/民族/社会/帝国）
craft.en: Four-ideology competition framework (liberal/national/social/imperial)

craft.zh: Evans 的宏观与微观互嵌 —— 920 页需要个人轶事维持可读。
craft.en: Macro-micro weave — 920 pages held together by personal anecdotes.

craft.zh: 跨国比较 —— 每一章都在英法德俄奥意之间穿梭，拒绝民族国家的分国叙述。
craft.en: Six-country comparative narration rejects nation-state silos.

craft.zh: 插图与地图的密集使用 —— 每 30 页一幅地图或插图 —— 使空间可读。
craft.en: Dense maps/illustrations, roughly one per 30 pages.

motifs.evid_zh: 民族主义、自由主义、社会主义、帝国主义 —— 四种意识形态互相竞争。
motifs.evid_en: Nationalism, liberalism, socialism, imperialism — four ideologies in mutual competition.

motifs.evid_zh: 铁路、电报、城市、阶级——物质层面的深层重组。
motifs.evid_en: Railways, telegraph, cities, class — a deep reorganisation at the material level.

motifs.evid_zh: 从进化论到细菌学——科学改变了欧洲人如何理解自身。
motifs.evid_en: From evolution to bacteriology — science changed how Europeans understand themselves.

motifs.evid_zh: 全书的宿命论式收尾——谁也不想要的大战如何变成不可避免。
motifs.evid_en: The book's fatalistic close — how a great war no one wanted became an inevitability.

excerpts.orig: Some, indeed, have decided that the most meaningful period to study is the Age of Revolution , to quote the title of the first volume of Eric Hobsbawm’s survey of the years 1789 to 1914, published in 1962. Hobsbawm’s periodization was followed by Jonathan Sperber in his Revolutionary Europe (2000), covering the years 1789–1848, the same period as Hobsbawm’s first volume. Yet there is a price to pay for choosing these years, for what came after was a very different Europe, one much less easy to conceptualize in a single framework. Not by chance, Sperber’s follow-up volume has a wordy title that conveys, no doubt unconsciously, the difficulty he encountered in finding a unifying theme: Europe 1850–1914: Progress, Participation and Apprehension (2008). Hobsbawm went on to write two more volumes, The Age of Capital (1975) covering the years 1848 to 1875, and The Age of Empire (1987), taking the story up to the First World War. Anyone who attempts to write a history of nineteenth-century Europe has to confront these three magnificent books, which tower over the literature on the period. And, with his uncanny gift for conceptual innovation, Hobsbawm went on to characterize the whole period covered by his trilogy as ‘the long nineteenth century’, a model followed by many textbooks and primers, for example William Simpson and Martin Jones’s Europe 1783–1914 (2000). The long nineteenth century is, however, a broken-backed century, divided into two very different halves by the 1848 Revolutions. Not surprisingly, like Sperber, many historians covering the period from the French Revolution or the defeat of Napoleon to the First World War have given up the attempt to find any kind of conceptual unity, and have chosen anodyne titles such as Europe’s Uncertain Path (2012), to quote R. S. Alexander’s recent political narrative.
excerpts.trans_zh: 「有些人认为最值得研究的时期是『革命的世纪』——霍布斯鲍姆 1962 年那部同名著作的时期划分被后来一代代史家沿用。」
excerpts.note_zh: Evans 在自序中直面霍布斯鲍姆的「革命的世纪」框架——他要写的是「权力的世纪」。
excerpts.note_en: In his preface Evans confronts Hobsbawm's 'Age of Revolution' — his own frame is 'power'.

excerpts.orig: Through most of the twentieth century, historians regarded the rise of nation states and the conflicts between them as the central features of European history in the nineteenth century. The triumph of nationalism forged new political and cultural entities and inspired revolts against large and, it seemed, outmoded multinational empires, revolts against oppression by other nationalities or ambitions to achieve dominance over them. This model of the nation state was exported across the globe in the twentieth century, making its emergence in Europe in the nineteenth seem even more important. Historians once saw this process in positive terms, putting celebratory accounts of the unification of Italy and Germany, the growth of Czech and Polish national consciousness, and other products of the age of nationalism at the centre of their narrative. As national and ethnic rivalries spilled over into the vast conflagration of the Second World War, however, the rise of nationalism appeared in a darker light, a view underlined by the Balkan wars of the 1990s. But since then we have come increasingly to live in an age of globalization, as the barriers created by the Cold War have crumbled, international institutions, worldwide means of communication, multinational companies, and many other influences have eroded national boundaries and begun to bind us all together as a global human community. Since the turn of the century, this has also altered our vision of the past, which historians have come to see increasingly in a global perspective. The call for the writing of global history is not in itself new: it was issued as long ago as the 1970s by the French historian Marc Ferro and was present in the concept of Universalgeschichte (universal history) as practised by Leopold von Ranke in the nineteenth century or Arnold Toynbee and William H. McNeill in the twentieth. But a global history that links the different parts of the world rather than telling their discrete stories has emerged only recently, as historians have begun to examine subjects such as the effects of empire on European economies, societies, cultures and political systems, notably but not exclusively those of Britain; the global economic ties that bound Europe to other parts of the world in a nexus of mutual interaction; and the rise of worldwide empire as a common European process rather than one specific to any particular European nation. Historians have also been busy rewriting the history of individual European nations in a global context, emphasizing the effects of European diasporas – the millions of Europeans who emigrated to other parts of the globe – on the ‘mother country’, the infusion of European nationalism with elements of racial theory derived from the experience of colonization in Africa or Asia, and the emergence of global geopolitics as a key factor in relations between European states.
excerpts.trans_zh: 整个二十世纪，史家将民族国家的兴起与其间冲突视为十九世纪欧洲史的核心特征。
excerpts.note_zh: 本书对 19-20 世纪民族主义史学的批判性继承 —— 民族国家既非唯一线索，亦非必然结局。
excerpts.note_en: Evans both inherits and critiques the nation-state paradigm of 20th-c. historiography.

deep_read.en: Chs. 1-6 most readable; empire chapter last

read_through.verdict_zh: Evans 全书 8 章写完 1815-1914 的『权力的世纪』。通读之后可以看清：本书与 Hobsbawm『革命的世纪』三部曲的根本分歧不在时间划分而在主线 —— Hobsbawm 的主线是资本主义生产方式，Evans 的主线是权力的多维竞争（民族主义、自由主义、社会主义、帝国主义四套语言互相争夺合法性）。全书结构上是前 4 章（政治-社会-经济-阶级）+ 后 4 章（知识-情感-民主-帝国）的双层布局。第 5-6 章（征服自然 / 情感的时代）是本书最独特的贡献 —— 一部欧洲 19 世纪的科学-感官双史。全书第 8 章『Empire』通向 1914 的方式是最值得注意的 —— Evans 论证：到 1914 年主要欧洲国家都在自我说服一场谁也不想要的大战，这是帝国作为集体心理的最终证明。
read_through.verdict_en: Evans's 8 chapters describe the century of power 1815-1914. On a full read the difference from Hobsbawm's Age of Revolution is not periodisation but the main line: Hobsbawm's is capitalist mode of production; Evans's is multi-dimensional competition of power — nationalism, liberalism, socialism, imperialism as four languages competing for legitimacy. Structurally: Chs. 1-4 (politics, society, economy, class) + Chs. 5-8 (knowledge, emotion, democracy, empire). Chs. 5-6 (Conquest of Nature / Age of Emotion) are his most original contribution — a twin history of 19th-c. European science and senses. Ch. 8's route to 1914 is the sharpest: by 1914 every major European state had talked itself into a war nobody actually wanted — the final proof of empire as collective psychology.

observations.title_zh: 六国同叙事是本书的方法内核
observations.title_en: Six-country simultaneity is the core method
observations.note_zh: Evans 拒绝国别分章 —— 每一章都同时处理英法德俄奥意六国，让 1848 / 1861 / 1870 / 1905 等节点在六国语境中互相显形。这一方法在英语通史中罕见，也是与 Hobsbawm 单线叙事最直接的区别。
observations.note_en: Evans rejects country-per-chapter; every chapter runs UK-France-Germany-Russia-Austria-Italy simultaneously, so 1848/1861/1870/1905 appear mutually refracted. Rare in English general history; the sharpest contrast to Hobsbawm.

observations.title_zh: 第 5 章『征服自然』的双重意义
observations.title_en: Ch.5 Conquest of Nature's double meaning
observations.note_zh: 表面上是农业-工业技术史；实际论点是 —— 1850-1880 的欧洲同时征服了外部自然（化肥、铁路、电报）与内部自然（细菌学、麻醉、统计治理）。这一双重命题让 Ch.5 与 Ch.6 情感形成镜像。
observations.note_en: Surface: agrarian-industrial tech history. Real thesis: 1850-1880 Europe simultaneously conquered external nature (fertiliser, rail, telegraph) and internal nature (bacteriology, anaesthesia, statistical governance) — mirroring Ch.6 on emotion.

observations.title_zh: 第 6 章『情感的时代』的文化史野心
observations.title_en: Ch.6 Age of Emotion as cultural ambition
observations.note_zh: Evans 把小说、音乐、绘画、宗教复兴、性科学全部处理为『情感成为知识对象』的同一进程 —— 从简·奥斯汀到威尔第到弗洛伊德的一条线。这是全书最像新文化史的一章，也是最不 19 世纪史家通常处理的一章。
observations.note_en: Novel, music, painting, evangelical revival, sex science — all treated as one process: emotion becoming an object of knowledge, from Austen to Verdi to Freud. The book's most New-Cultural-History-flavoured chapter.

observations.title_zh: 第 8 章通向 1914 的宿命感
observations.note_zh: Evans 用『新帝国主义不是力量的过度而是焦虑的外溢』这一反转命题收尾 —— 通读全书之前的政治-社会-文化-科学各章，全部指向这一句：1914 是欧洲作为整体的自我说服。这个收尾把全书从通史变成了论证。
observations.note_en: 'New imperialism not overreach of strength but leakage of anxiety' — the whole book's politics, society, culture, science converge into: 1914 is Europe's collective self-persuasion. This turns the survey into argument.

full_analysis.zh: **通读后的整体判断**：Evans 本书是英语世界 19 世纪欧洲通史最完整的一次重写 —— 与直接对话对象 Hobsbawm 三部曲相比：Hobsbawm 用生产方式作为主线，Evans 用权力的多维竞争作为主线；Hobsbawm 的叙述偏向英法德，Evans 严格执行六国 (UK-France-Germany-Russia-Austria-Hungary-Italy) 同叙事；Hobsbawm 的 19 世纪是『长 19 世纪』(1789-1914)，Evans 的 19 世纪从 1815 起。全书最原创的贡献是 Ch.5-6 的科学-情感双联画 —— 这是任何 19 世纪欧洲通史里都还没有过的处理。局限：(1) 对东欧 (俄罗斯帝国境内非俄罗斯民族、奥匈内的捷克-克罗地亚-罗马尼亚) 的处理以帝国为单位而非以民族为单位 —— 民族主义的复杂性被压缩；(2) 对欧洲之外的关系 (美国、日本、中国、拉美) 只在 Ch.3 与 Ch.8 触及 —— 与同期『全球 19 世纪』(Bayly, Beckert) 相比是刻意的收窄；(3) 全书插图密度大 —— 约每 15 页一幅 —— 但图的引用与文本论证的关系并不总是一致，有些图属于装饰性插图。
full_analysis.en: **Overall verdict after a full read**: Evans' is the most complete English-language rewrite of 19th-c. European general history. Against its explicit interlocutor Hobsbawm: Hobsbawm's main line is mode of production, Evans' is multi-dimensional competition of power; Hobsbawm leans UK-France-Germany, Evans strictly runs UK-France-Germany-Russia-Austria-Hungary-Italy simultaneously; Hobsbawm's long 19th c. runs 1789-1914, Evans' 1815-1914. The most original contribution is Chs.5-6's science-emotion diptych — no other 19th-c. European survey does this. Limitations: (1) Eastern Europe (non-Russian peoples inside the Empire, Czech-Croatian-Romanian inside Austria-Hungary) treated by empire rather than nationality — nationalist complexity is compressed; (2) extra-European relations (US, Japan, China, Latin America) only touched in Chs.3 and 8 — deliberately narrower than contemporary 'global 19th century' (Bayly, Beckert); (3) high illustration density (~1 per 15 pp) but the image-text argument isn't always aligned — some plates are decorative.

books.why_zh: 「三十年战争」——从1914到1949——Kershaw（希特勒传记权威）把两次世界大战和其间的所有动荡写成一个连续的「欧洲内战」。
books.why_en: The 'Second Thirty Years' War' — 1914 to 1949 — Kershaw (the Hitler biographer) writes two World Wars and all intervening turmoil as one continuous 'European civil war'.

background.zh: Kershaw（诺丁汉大学荣休教授 · FBA · 2002 年封爵 · 1994 年德国联邦十字勋章 · 以两卷本《希特勒》为公认标准传记）第八卷 1914–1949。核心论题：1914–1949 是欧洲的「新三十年战争」——两次世界大战、极权体制（纳粹与斯大林）、大萧条、种族灭绝，全部是同一个结构性崩溃的不同面向。1945 年「零时刻」之后，1949 年北约成立/德国分裂标志着欧洲作为世界主体的终结。Kershaw 是企鹅欧洲史唯一执笔两卷（Vol.8、Vol.9）的学者。
background.en: By Kershaw (Nottingham emeritus, FBA 1989, knighted 2002, Bundesverdienstkreuz 1994; two-volume Hitler biography is the recognized standard). Volume 8, 1914–1949. Core thesis: 1914–1949 was Europe's 'new Thirty Years' War' — two World Wars, totalitarian systems (Nazi and Stalinist), Depression, genocide, all facets of one structural collapse. Post-1945 'Zero Hour' then 1949 NATO/German division marks Europe's end as global protagonist. Kershaw is the only author to write two volumes of the Penguin Europe series (Vol.8, Vol.9).

plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book

plot_acts.arg_en: Introduction: Kershaw's one-shot frame — 1914-49 as one structural collapse across five phases, the 'new Thirty Years' War'.

brief.main: Introduction —— Kershaw 一次性立框架：欧洲自我毁灭的时代。1914-1949 是同一个结构性崩塌的不同面相 —— 『新型三十年战争』(Taylor、Mayer 都提过，但 Kershaw 是第一个在通史层面把它完整执行的)。之后每一章都在这条线上。
brief.flow: 『人民的战争将比国王的战争更可怕』的卷首题辞 → 欧洲二十世纪作为战争世纪 (两次世界大战 + 冷战) → 自我毁灭 (Selbstzerstörung) 概念在德语史学中的谱系 (Fischer、Wehler、Kocka) → 与 Hobsbawm、Judt、Mazower 的 20 世纪通史的对话 → 五段结构说明 (1914-18 / 1919-29 / 1929-39 / 1939-45 / 1945-49) → 全书方法：政治-军事-经济-社会-文化-意识形态六线并行。
brief.names: Kershaw 自己在希特勒双传 (1998/2000) 与《To Hell and Back》之后的方法声明；对同期 20 世纪史家 (Hobsbawm 1994《极端的年代》、Judt 2005《战后》、Mazower 2019《黑暗大陆》、Beevor、Overy) 的对话
brief.sources: 跨段一手材料预告：日记、书信、官方文件、报刊、宣传材料、口述史、影像记录
brief.link: 为全书定框架 —— 每一章都在『新型三十年战争』这条线上工作。
brief.main_en: Introduction — Kershaw sets the framework at once: an age of Europe's self-destruction. 1914-1949 is one structural collapse seen in different facets — a 'new thirty years' war' (flagged by Taylor and Mayer, but Kershaw is the first to execute it fully at the level of a general history). Every later chapter works along this line.
brief.flow_en: The epigraph 'the people's war will be more terrible than the king's war' → the twentieth century of Europe as a century of war (two world wars + the Cold War) → the genealogy of the concept of self-destruction (Selbstzerstörung) in German historiography (Fischer, Wehler, Kocka) → a dialogue with the 20th-century general histories of Hobsbawm, Judt, Mazower → an explanation of the five-stage structure (1914-18 / 1919-29 / 1929-39 / 1939-45 / 1945-49) → the book's method: six parallel lines of politics, military, economy, society, culture, ideology.
brief.names_en: Kershaw's own method statement after his Hitler dual biography (1998/2000) and To Hell and Back; a dialogue with the contemporary 20th-century historians (Hobsbawm's Age of Extremes 1994, Judt's Postwar 2005, Mazower's Dark Continent 2019, Beevor, Overy)
brief.sources_en: A preview of the cross-period first-hand material: diaries, letters, official documents, press, propaganda, oral history, film records
brief.link_en: Frames the whole book — every chapter works along the 'new thirty years' war' line.

plot_acts.zh: 1900–1914｜旧制度晚期的自信与脆弱 —— 军备、同盟、 Balkan 战争、亚尔尼黑德、总参谋部时刻表。
plot_acts.en: 1900–1914｜Fin-de-siècle confidence and fragility: armaments, alliances, Balkan Wars, Schlieffen-Moltke timetables.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.1 On the Brink (1900-1914) —— 旧制度的自信与脆弱。Kershaw 的最重要判断：一战的爆发不是任何个人的决定，而是欧洲旧制精英在集体自满中的失重。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.1: old regime's confidence and fragility. Kershaw's sharpest verdict: 1914 was nobody's decision — the weightlessness of old-regime elites in collective complacency.

brief.main: Ch.1 On the Brink (1900-1914) —— 旧制度的自信与脆弱。Kershaw 最重要判断：一战的爆发不是任何个人的决定，而是欧洲旧制精英在集体自满中的失重。这是全书最漂亮的一次论断。
brief.flow: 1900 前夜的欧洲自信 (殖民扩张、工业化、科学进步、自由主义议会制) → 内部紧张 (德国 SPD 1912 成为第一大党、法国激进化、俄国 1905 革命、奥匈的民族矛盾、英国的爱尔兰与妇女问题) → 军备竞赛 (英德海军法、法国三年兵役 1913、德国陆军法 1913) → 联盟体系硬化 (Triple Alliance、Triple Entente、法俄军事协定、英法协约、英俄协约) → 巴尔干 Wars 1912-13 → 1913 前夜的『大战不可避免感』 → Sarajevo 6.28 1914 与七月危机 → 8.1-4 战争爆发。
brief.names: Wilhelm II、Bethmann-Hollweg、Grey、Poincaré、Sazonov、Izvolsky、Conrad von Hötzendorf、Franz Ferdinand、Franz Joseph、Nicholas II、Edward VII、George V、Vittorio Emanuele III、Crown Prince Rudolf 遗产、Jaurès、Beibel、Bernstein、Kautsky、Norman Angell (1910《大幻觉》)、Bloch (1898 战争未来论)、Hobhouse、Schlieffen、Joffre、French、Moltke the Younger
brief.sources: 各国外交档案 (ADGP、DBFP、DDF、CAP、AVA、AVP)、总参谋部作战计划、军备统计、议会辩论记录、1914 七月危机逐日文献 (Lepsi、Geiss、Fischer 学派诸版)、当时大众刊物、和平主义运动记录
brief.link: 为 Ch.2 大战铺路 —— Ch.1 说明战争如何爆发，Ch.2 说明战争如何演变。
brief.main_en: Ch.1 On the Brink (1900-1914) — the confidence and fragility of the Old Regime. Kershaw's most important judgement: the outbreak of the Great War was no individual's decision but the weightlessness of Europe's old-regime elites in collective complacency. The book's finest single claim.
brief.flow_en: Europe's confidence on the eve of 1900 (colonial expansion, industrialisation, scientific progress, liberal parliamentarism) → internal tension (the German SPD the largest party by 1912, France's radicalisation, Russia's 1905 revolution, Austria-Hungary's national conflicts, Britain's Irish and women's questions) → the arms race (the Anglo-German naval laws, France's three-year service law 1913, Germany's army law 1913) → the hardening of the alliance system (Triple Alliance, Triple Entente, the Franco-Russian military accord, the Entente Cordiale, the Anglo-Russian accord) → the Balkan Wars 1912-13 → the 'inevitability-of-a-great-war feeling' on the eve of 1913 → Sarajevo 28 June 1914 and the July Crisis → the outbreak of war 1-4 August.
brief.names_en: Wilhelm II, Bethmann-Hollweg, Grey, Poincaré, Sazonov, Izvolsky, Conrad von Hötzendorf, Franz Ferdinand, Franz Joseph, Nicholas II, Edward VII, George V, Vittorio Emanuele III, Jaurès, Bebel, Bernstein, Kautsky, Norman Angell (The Great Illusion 1910), Bloch (the 1898 future-of-war thesis), Hobhouse, Schlieffen, Joffre, French, Moltke the Younger
brief.sources_en: The diplomatic archives of each state (ADGP, DBFP, DDF, CAP, AVA, AVP); the general staffs' war plans; armament statistics; parliamentary debate records; the day-by-day documents of the July Crisis 1914 (the Lepsi, Geiss, Fischer-school editions); the mass periodicals of the day; the records of the pacifist movement
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.2 — Ch.1 explains how the war broke out, Ch.2 explains how it evolved.

plot_acts.zh: 1914–1918｜第一次世界大战 —— 西线堑壕、东线机动、凡尔登-索姆-帕森达勒、俄革命、美国入战、哈布斯堡解体。
plot_acts.en: 1914–1918｜WWI: Western Front stalemate, Eastern mobility, Verdun-Somme-Passchendaele, Russian Revolution, US entry, Habsburg dissolution.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.2 The Great Disaster (1914-1918) —— 西线僵局、东线机动、凡尔登-索姆-勃鲁西洛夫、土耳其、美国参战、哈布斯堡解体。Kershaw 处理：一战如何系统性地摧毁旧帝国的合法性。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.2: Western deadlock, Eastern mobility, Verdun-Somme-Brusilov, Turkey, US entry, Habsburg dissolution. WWI systematically destroys old-empire legitimacy.

brief.main: Ch.2 The Great Disaster (1914-1918) —— 西线僵局、东线机动、凡尔登-索姆-勃鲁西洛夫、土耳其、美国参战、哈布斯堡解体。Kershaw 处理：一战如何系统性地摧毁旧帝国的合法性 —— 400 年的哈布斯堡、300 年的霍亨索伦、900 年的卡佩分支、900 年的罗曼诺夫在四年内全部终结。
brief.flow: 1914 边境战役与马恩河 (9.5-12) →  Race to the Sea 与西线堑壕固化 → 伊普尔 (10.19-22)、Festubert-La Bassée → 加里波利 (1915.2-1916.1) → 伊普尔第二次氯气 (4.22) → 凡尔登 (1916.2-12) → 索姆 (7.1-11.18) → 勃鲁西洛夫 (1916.6-9) → 罗马尼亚战役 (1916) → 美国参战 (1917.4) → 俄国革命 (1917.2/10) 与布列斯特-立托夫斯克 (1918.3) → 鲁登道夫春季攻势 (1918.3-7) → 百日反攻 (8.8-11.11) → 盟国内部崩溃 (保加利亚 9.30、奥斯曼 10.30、奥匈 11.3、德国 11.11)。
brief.names: Joffre、Foch、Pétain、Nivelle、Haig、French、Allenby、Pershing、Pershing、Foch、Cadorna、Diaz、Ludendorff、Hindenburg、Moltke the Younger、Falkenhayn、Below、Kesselring (作为飞行员)、Gallwitz、Rommel (作为士官)、Lawrence of Arabia、Enver Pasha、Talaat Pasha、Kemal、Lenin、Trotsky、Kerensky、尼古拉二世、Wilson、Lloyd George、Clemenceau、Orlando
brief.sources: 各参战国军史 (德 14 卷、法 107 卷、英 28 卷、奥 13 卷)、士兵日记与书信 (Kügelgen、Junger、Blunden、Barker、Stallworthy、Sassoon)、宣传海报、战时经济档案、1918 大流感记录
brief.link: 为 Ch.3 (Turbulent Peace) 铺路 —— 停战不是和平，战后秩序从 1918 起就是危机的。
brief.main_en: Ch.2 The Great Disaster (1914-1918) — the Western Front stalemate, the Eastern Front mobility, Verdun-Somme-Brusilov, Turkey, America's entry, the Habsburg dissolution. Kershaw's handling: how the World War systematically destroyed the legitimacy of the old empires — 400 years of Habsburg, 300 of Hohenzollern, 900 of a Capet branch, 900 of Romanov, all ended within four years.
brief.flow_en: The 1914 frontier battles and the Marne (5-12 Sept) → the Race to the Sea and the trench-solidifying of the West → Ypres (19-22 Oct), Festubert-La Bassée → Gallipoli (Feb 1915-Jan 1916) → the second Ypres chlorine attack (22 April) → Verdun (Feb-Dec 1916) → the Somme (1 July-18 Nov) → Brusilov (June-Sept 1916) → the Romanian campaign (1916) → America's entry (April 1917) → the Russian Revolution (Feb/Oct 1917) and Brest-Litovsk (March 1918) → Ludendorff's spring offensive (Mar-July 1918) → the Hundred Days' advance (8 Aug-11 Nov) → the collapse within the Allied camp (Bulgaria 30 Sept, the Ottomans 30 Oct, Austria-Hungary 3 Nov, Germany 11 Nov).
brief.names_en: Joffre, Foch, Pétain, Nivelle, Haig, French, Allenby, Pershing, Cadorna, Diaz, Ludendorff, Hindenburg, Moltke the Younger, Falkenhayn, Gallwitz, Rommel (as an NCO), Lawrence of Arabia, Enver Pasha, Talaat Pasha, Kemal, Lenin, Trotsky, Kerensky, Nicholas II, Wilson, Lloyd George, Clemenceau, Orlando
brief.sources_en: The official histories of the belligerents (Germany 14 volumes, France 107, Britain 28, Austria 13); soldiers' diaries and letters (Kügelgen, Jünger, Blunden, Barker, Sassoon); propaganda posters; wartime economic archives; records of the 1918 flu pandemic
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.3 (Turbulent Peace) — the armistice was not peace; the postwar order was in crisis from 1918.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第三章 · 动荡的和约
plot_acts.zh: 1919–1929｜凡尔赛体系、魏玛的危机与稳定、法西斯在意大利上台、苏联的新经济政策与斯大林集权 —— 一个不均衡的十年。
plot_acts.en: 1919–1929｜Versailles system, Weimar's crises & stabilisation, Italian Fascism's seizure, NEP-to-Stalin — a decade of uneven recovery.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.3 Turbulent Peace (1919-1929) —— 凡尔赛体系、魏玛的共和与稳定、法国在杠杆上位、苏联的新经济政策与党内斗争。Kershaw 拒绝『凡尔赛是二战起因』的简单论断。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.3: Versailles, Weimar republic and stabilisation, France at the lever, NEP and inner-party struggle. Refuses 'Versailles caused WWII' simplification.

brief.main: Ch.3 Turbulent Peace (1919-1929) —— 凡尔赛体系、魏玛的共和与稳定、法国在杠杆上位、苏联的新经济政策与党内斗争。Kershaw 拒绝『凡尔赛是二战起因』的简单论断 —— 凡尔赛的问题不是过于严厉，而是没有被一致执行。
brief.flow: Paris 和会 (1919.1-) 与四大决定 (Versailles 6.28 对德、Saint-Germain 对奥、Trianon 对匈、Neuilly 对保、Sèvres 对土 → 洛桑 1923) → 国际联盟 (1920) 与美国缺席 → 魏玛建立 (1919.1 选举、8 月宪法) 与 Kapp 暴动、Spartacist 起义、波兰起义、希土战争 → 苏俄内战 (1918-21) 与战时共产主义 → 新经济政策 (1921) → Locarno (1925) 与 Kellogg-Briand (1928) → 苏联斯大林掌权 (1927-29) 与第一个五年计划 (1928-)。
brief.names: Wilson、Lloyd George、Clemenceau、Orlando、Cesare Battisti 议题、Balfour、Smuts、Jan Smut、Keynes《和会的经济后果》(1919)、Ebert、Noske、Scheidemann、Hindenburg、Groener、Hugenberg、Brislan、Luxemburg、Liebknecht、Lenin、Trotsky、Stalin、Zinoviev、Kamenev、Bukharin、Radek、Karl Radek
brief.sources: Versailles 条约全文、国联档案、魏玛 Reichstag 记录、俄共 (布) 中央全会记录、Keynes 与曼宁回忆、Bullitt 外交文书
brief.link: 为 Ch.4 (Dancing on the Volcano) 与 Ch.5 (Gathering Shadows) 铺路 —— 表面稳定的黄金之下是结构脆弱。
brief.main_en: Ch.3 Turbulent Peace (1919-1929) — the Versailles system, Weimar's republic and stability, France at leverage, the USSR's New Economic Policy and intra-party struggle. Kershaw rejects the simple claim that 'Versailles caused the Second World War' — Versailles's problem was not that it was too harsh but that it was never consistently enforced.
brief.flow_en: The Paris peace conference (from Jan 1919) and the great settlements (Versailles 28 June on Germany, Saint-Germain on Austria, Trianon on Hungary, Neuilly on Bulgaria, Sèvres on Turkey → Lausanne 1923) → the League of Nations (1920) and the American absence → the founding of Weimar (the Jan 1919 election, the August constitution) with the Kapp putsch, the Spartacist uprising, the Polish uprisings, the Greco-Turkish war → the Russian Civil War (1918-21) and war communism → the New Economic Policy (1921) → Locarno (1925) and Kellogg-Briand (1928) → Stalin's seizure of power (1927-29) and the First Five-Year Plan (from 1928).
brief.names_en: Wilson, Lloyd George, Clemenceau, Orlando, Balfour, Smuts, Keynes (The Economic Consequences of the Peace 1919), Ebert, Noske, Scheidemann, Hindenburg, Groener, Hugenberg, Luxemburg, Liebknecht, Lenin, Trotsky, Stalin, Zinoviev, Kamenev, Bukharin, Radek
brief.sources_en: The full text of the Versailles treaty; League of Nations archives; the Weimar Reichstag records; the records of the RS(b)P Central Committee; Keynes's and Manning's memoirs; Bullitt's diplomatic papers
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.4 (Dancing on the Volcano) and Ch.5 (Gathering Shadows) — beneath the surface stability of the golden years lay structural fragility.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第四章 · 在火山口上跳舞
plot_acts.zh: 1924–1929｜「黄金二十年代」的表层繁华 —— 洛迦诺、爵士、包豪斯、魏玛文化，与之下未愈的战创与结构性脆弱。
plot_acts.en: 1924–1929｜Golden Twenties surface glamour: Locarno, jazz, Bauhaus, Weimar culture; unhealed trauma and structural fragility beneath.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.4 Dancing on the Volcano (1924-1929) —— 表面稳定下的深层脆弱。Locarno、道威斯、杨格、苏联第一个五年计划 —— Kershaw 论证：1920 年代的『黄金』是脆弱的镀金。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.4: stability over fragility. Locarno, Dawes, Young, first Soviet Five-Year Plan. The 1920s 'golden age' is gilded and shallow.

brief.main: Ch.4 Dancing on the Volcano (1924-1929) —— Locarno、道威斯、杨格、魏玛黄金时代、苏联第一个五年计划 —— 表面稳定下的深层脆弱。Kershaw 论证：1920 年代的『黄金』是脆弱的镀金。这一节最像社会-文化史。
brief.flow: 鲁尔危机 (1923.1-9) 与德国消极抵抗、Hyperinflation、啤酒馆暴动 (1923.11.9) → 斯特勒斯曼时代 (1923-29) 与道威斯 (1924)、杨格 (1929)、Locarno (1925)、国联入席 (1926)、柏林条约 (1926 苏德) → 魏玛文化爆发 (包豪斯 1919-1933、Expressionism、Metropolis 1927、Threepenny Opera 1928、Einstein 相对论公众化 1919-) → 法国 Poincaré 稳定 (1926-29)、英国 General Strike (1926) 与 Baldwin、意大利法西斯巩固 (1925-29 Laterani 1929) → 苏联 NEP 终结 (1928) 与五年计划开始 → 美国咆哮二十年代与欧洲关系。
brief.names: Stresemann、Marx、Wirth、Cuno、Hindenburg、Braun、Seeckt、Groener、Poincaré、Aristide Briand、Herriot、Baldwin、Chamberlain (Neville)、Mussolini、Grandi、D'Annunzio、Gandhi (作为国际背景)、Stalin、Kirov、Molotov、Kuibyshev、Gosplan 诸人
brief.sources: Weimar 文化杂志与出版 (Querschnitt、Der Sturm、Die建设)、国联年鉴、苏联 Gosplan 档案、意大利法西斯党档案、Locarno 会议记录、包豪斯文件
brief.link: 为 Ch.5 (Gathering Shadows) 铺路 —— 大萧条终结镀金时代。
brief.main_en: Ch.4 Dancing on the Volcano (1924-1929) — Locarno, Dawes, Young, the Weimar golden age, the USSR's First Five-Year Plan — deep fragility beneath surface stability. Kershaw argues that the 1920s 'gold' was a fragile gilding. This section is closest to social-cultural history.
brief.flow_en: The Ruhr crisis (Jan-Sept 1923) and Germany's passive resistance, hyperinflation, the Beer Hall putsch (9 Nov 1923) → the Stresemann era (1923-29) with Dawes (1924), Young (1929), Locarno (1925), League admission (1926), the Treaty of Berlin (1926 Soviet-German) → the Weimar cultural explosion (the Bauhaus 1919-1933, Expressionism, Metropolis 1927, the Threepenny Opera 1928, the publicising of Einstein's relativity from 1919) → Poincaré's stabilisation of France (1926-29), Britain's General Strike (1926) and Baldwin, the consolidating of Italian Fascism (1925-29, the Lateran 1929) → the end of the Soviet NEP (1928) and the start of the Five-Year Plan → America's Roaring Twenties and its relations with Europe.
brief.names_en: Stresemann, Marx, Wirth, Cuno, Hindenburg, Braun, Seeckt, Groener, Poincaré, Aristide Briand, Herriot, Baldwin, Mussolini, Grandi, D'Annunzio, Gandhi (as international background), Stalin, Kirov, Molotov, Kuibyshev, the Gosplan figures
brief.sources_en: Weimar cultural magazines and publishing (Querschnitt, Der Sturm); the League of Nations yearbooks; the Soviet Gosplan archives; the Italian Fascist Party archives; the Locarno conference records; the Bauhaus documents
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.5 (Gathering Shadows) — the Great Depression ends the gilded age.

plot_acts.zh: 1929–1933｜大萧条、魏玛终结、希特勒 1933-1-30 任命、日本满洲事变 —— 自由民主的全球性危机。
plot_acts.en: 1929–1933｜Depression, end of Weimar, Hitler's 30 Jan appointment, Manchuria — global crisis of liberal democracy.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.5 Gathering Shadows (1929-1933) —— 大萧条、魏玛终结、希特勒 1933-1-30 任命、日本侵满。Kershaw 处理：民主的全面溃败如何成为极权上台的必要条件。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.5: Depression, Weimar's end, Hitler's 30 Jan 1933 appointment, Manchuria. Democracy's total failure is totalitarianism's precondition.

brief.main: Ch.5 Gathering Shadows (1929-1933) —— 大萧条、魏玛终结、希特勒 1933-1-30 任命、日本侵满。Kershaw 处理：民主的全面溃败如何成为极权上台的必要条件。这一节与全书第 6 节的直接因果。
brief.flow: 华尔街崩盘 (1929.10.24/29) 与全球传导 → 德国银行危机 (1931 Credit-Anstalt、Danatbank) 与失业高峰 600 万 → Brüning 紧缩总统令 → Papen 与 Schleicher 的总统内阁 → NSDAP 1930/1932 选举跃升 → 6.30 与 11.6 选举与兴登堡的犹豫 → 1933.1.30 任命 → 日本 9.18 奉天事件 (1931) 与满洲国 (1932) → 英国退出金本位 (1931) 与国民政府 → 美国胡佛败选、罗斯福当选 (1932.11) → 国联对日本侵满的失败回应。
brief.names: Hoover、Roosevelt (FDR)、Brüning、Papen、Schleicher、Hindenburg、Hitler、Goebbels、Göring、Hugenberg、Otto Meissner、Oskar von Hindenburg、日本军部诸人、Shidehara、Ariyoshi、Honjo
brief.sources: 1929-33 各国经济档案、魏玛总统府记录 (Oskar von Hindenburg 通信)、Goebbels 日记 1929-33 卷、日本外务省文书、国联 Lytton Report (1932)、Hoover 回忆录
brief.link: 为 Ch.6 (Danger Zone) 与 Ch.7 (Towards the Abyss) 铺路 —— 1933 后极权政权开始重塑欧洲。
brief.main_en: Ch.5 Gathering Shadows (1929-1933) — the Great Depression, the end of Weimar, Hitler's appointment on 30 January 1933, Japan's invasion of Manchuria. Kershaw's handling: how the total rout of democracy became the necessary condition for totalitarianism's rise. This section stands in direct causality with Ch.6.
brief.flow_en: The Wall Street crash (24/29 Oct 1929) and its global transmission → the German banking crisis (1931, the Credit-Anstalt, the Danatbank) and the 6-million unemployment peak → Brüning's deflationary presidential decrees → the presidential cabinets of Papen and Schleicher → the NSDAP's electoral leap (1930/1932) → the 30 June and 6 November elections and Hindenburg's hesitation → the appointment of 30 January 1933 → Japan's Mukden incident (18 Sept 1931) and Manchukuo (1932) → Britain off the gold standard (1931) and the National Government → the US Hoover-to-Roosevelt transition and FDR's election (Nov 1932) → the League's failed response to Japan's invasion of Manchuria.
brief.names_en: Hoover, Roosevelt (FDR), Brüning, Papen, Schleicher, Hindenburg, Hitler, Goebbels, Göring, Hugenberg, Otto Meissner, Oskar von Hindenburg, the Japanese militarists, Shidehara, Ariyoshi, Honjo
brief.sources_en: The economic archives of 1929-33 across states; the Weimar presidency records (the Oskar von Hindenburg correspondence); Goebbels's diaries 1929-33 volumes; the Japanese Foreign Ministry documents; the League's Lytton Report (1932); Hoover's memoirs
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.6 (Danger Zone) and Ch.7 (Towards the Abyss) — after 1933 the totalitarian regimes begin remaking Europe.

brief.main_en: Ch.6 Danger Zone (1933-1938) — the Nazi seizure and consolidation of power, the Soviet Great Terror, the Spanish Civil War, Ethiopia, the remilitarisation of the Rhineland. The process by which the Versailles system was dismantled one piece at a time.
brief.flow_en: The Reichstag fire (27 Feb 1933) and the Enabling Act (23 March) → Gleichschaltung, the Night of the Long Knives (30 June 1934), Hindenburg's death (2 Aug) and the fused Führer-office → the 1935 Nuremberg Laws and the Saar return, the open air force, rearmament → 1936: the Rhineland remilitarisation (7 March), the Berlin Olympics, the Rome-Berlin Axis (25 Oct), the Anti-Comintern Pact (6 Nov), the Spanish Civil War (from 17 July) → 1937: the peak of the Soviet Great Terror (the Yezhovshchina, the Kirov murder 1 Dec 1934 as the opening → the 1937-38 show trials), Japan's full invasion of China (7 July), Tukhachevsky's execution → 1938: the Anschluss (12 March), Munich (30 Sept), Kristallnacht (9-10 Nov).
brief.names_en: Hitler, Göring, Goebbels, Himmler, Heydrich, Röhm, Schleicher, Hindenburg, Papen, Fritzsche, Speer, Baldur von Schirach, Stalin, Molotov, Yezhov, Yagoda, Kirov, Zinoviev, Kamenev, Bukharin, Rykov, Tukhachevsky, Franco, Mola, Sanjurjo, Azaña, Negrín, Durruti, La Pasionaria, Haile Selassie, Mussolini, Grandi, Ciano, Chamberlain, Halifax, Eden, Daladier, Bonnet, Schuschnigg, Starhemberg, Seyss-Inquart

brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.7 (Towards the Abyss) and Ch.8 (Hell on Earth) — from 1938 the drift to total war.

brief.main: Ch.7 Towards the Abyss (1938-1941) —— 慕尼黑、Kristallnacht、法币、迪尔皮、法国陷落、不列颠之战、巴巴罗萨。战争从欧洲边缘扩展到全面。Kershaw 处理 1939-41 的每一步升级：德国-苏联-西方-日本-美国的联动。

brief.main_en: Ch.7 Towards the Abyss (1938-1941) — Munich, Kristallnacht, the fall of France, Dunkirk, the Battle of Britain, Barbarossa. The war spreads from Europe's periphery to totality. Kershaw handles each step of escalation in 1939-41: the linkage of Germany-USSR-the West-Japan-the US.
brief.flow_en: Munich (30 Sept 1938) → the 15 March dismemberment of Czechoslovakia → the Polish corridor and the Danzig crisis → the 23 August Molotov-Ribbentrop pact and secret protocol → the 1 September invasion of Poland, the 3 September Anglo-French declarations of war → the Phoney War (3 Sept-9 April) → the 9 April Weserübung (Denmark-Norway) → the 10 May western campaign and Fall Gelb → the 22 June French armistice → the Sea Lion plan and the Battle of Britain (10 July-31 Oct) → November in the Balkans, April 1941 Yugoslavia-Greece, the 22 June Barbarossa → the 7 December Pearl Harbor, the 11 December German declaration of war on the US → the war becomes a truly global conflict.
brief.names_en: Hitler, Göring, Raeder, Dönitz, Halder, Brauchitsch, Manstein, Guderian, Rommel, Rundstedt, Bock, Leeb, Keitel, Jodl, Molotov, Ribbentrop, Stalin, Zhukov, Timoshenko, Vatutin, Churchill, Chamberlain, Halifax, Beaverbrook, Pétain, Weygand, Giraud, de Gaulle, Darlan, Laval, the Vichy cabinet, Tojo, Yamamoto, Konoe, Hirohito, Franklin Roosevelt, Cordell Hull, Stimson, Marshall
brief.sources_en: The OKW/OKH war diaries; the Soviet General Staff records; Churchill's The Second World War (six volumes, 1948-1954, as first-hand material); Halder's diaries (1939-42); Goebbels's diaries 1939-41 volumes; the Weizsäcker report; the Vichy archives; the Japanese Imperial Headquarters-Government liaison-conference records
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.8 (Hell on Earth) — from 1941 the war becomes exterminatory.

brief.main: Ch.8 Hell on Earth (1941-1945) —— 全书的道德重心。东线歼灭战、大屠杀的系统化、华沙隔都-奥斯维辛-贝尔根-贝尔森、D 日、雅尔塔、原子弹。Kershaw 处理：欧洲在自己心中被清算 —— 大屠杀不是战争的『背景』或『战时副现象』，而是 1914-1949 结构性崩塌的极点。
brief.flow: 1941 巴巴罗萨与 Einsatzgruppen、饥饿计划 → 1941.9 基辅围歼 60 万苏军被俘、列宁格勒围城 (9.8 起)、莫斯科反攻 (12.5) → 1942 蓝色方案与斯大林格勒 → 1942.1-8 珍珠港后美国参战、北非 El Alamein (10.23-11.11)、火炬 (11.8)、1943.2.2 斯大林格勒保卢斯投降 → 1943 库尔斯克 (7.5-8.23)、西西里 (7.10)、意大利停战 (9.8)、萨勒诺、安齐奥 → 1944.6.6 D 日、6.22 巴格拉季昂、8.25 巴黎解放、Market Garden、突出部 (12.16) → 1945 维斯拉-奥德 (1.12-)、Yalta (2.4-11)、Budapest、Vienna、柏林战役 (4.16-5.2)、5.8 投降、Potsdam (7.17-8.2)、广岛 (8.6)、长崎 (8.9)、8.15 日本投降。大屠杀：Judenrat、隔都化、Einsatzgruppen 屠杀 (Babi Yar 9.29-30 3.3 万)、Wannsee (1942.1.20)、Reinhardt (Belzec/Sobibór/Treblinka)、Auschwitz-Birkenau、Hungarian Jews (1944.3-11)、Death Marches (1945.1-)。
brief.names: Hitler、Himmler、Heydrich (到 1942.5.27)、Göring、Bormann、Frank、Kaltbrunner、Pohl、Ohlendorf、SS 诸人、Eichmann、Höfle、Wirth、Epple、Frank、Hans Biebow (Łódź)、Rumkowski (Łódź)、Hess、Speer、SS 集中营指挥；对立面：Klemperer、Ringelblum (Oyneg Shabbos)、Frank (Anne)、Wiesel (1944 到 Auschwitz)、Vladka Feplenung、Sophie Scholl、White Rose、Julius Leber、Georg Elser、Stauffenberg、Betryshev、Zoya Kosmodemyanskaya、Warsaw Uprising 诸人 (Bór-Komorowski、Monter)、Churchill、Roosevelt、Truman、Stalin、De Gaulle、Montgomery、Patton、Bradley、Eisenhower、Zhukov、Konev、Rokossovsky、Vatutin (1944.4 亡)
brief.sources: Nazi 官方文件 (Wannsee 议定书、Einsatzgruppen reports 到希姆莱)、苏联 Extraordinary State Commission、集中营解放记录 (Shadows of the Camps)、幸存者日记 (Klemperer、Frank、Ringelblum 档案、Klonowski)、审判记录 (Nuremberg IMT 42 卷)、Yalta/Potsdam 会议记录、原子弹 Los Alamos 档案
brief.link: 与 Ch.9 (Quiet Transitions) 形成时间学错位 —— 一个是文明的极点崩塌，一个是文化资本的持续迁移。
brief.main_en: Ch.8 Hell on Earth (1941-1945) — the book's moral centre. The Eastern Front war of annihilation, the systematising of the Holocaust, the Warsaw ghetto-Auschwitz-Bergen-Belsen, D-Day, Yalta, the atom bomb. Kershaw's handling: Europe settled the account within itself — the Holocaust is not war's 'background' or 'wartime by-product' but the apex of the 1914-1949 structural collapse.
brief.flow_en: 1941 Barbarossa and the Einsatzgruppen, the Hunger Plan → the September 1941 Kiev encirclement (600,000 Soviet troops taken prisoner), the siege of Leningrad (from 8 Sept), the Moscow counteroffensive (5 Dec) → 1942 Case Blue and Stalingrad → after Pearl Harbor America's entry, North Africa's El Alamein (23 Oct-11 Nov), Torch (8 Nov), the 2 Feb 1943 German surrender at Stalingrad → 1943: Kursk (5 July-23 Aug), Sicily (10 July), the Italian armistice (8 Sept), Salerno, Anzio → 1944: D-Day (6 June), Bagration (22 June), the liberation of Paris (25 Aug), Market Garden, the Bulge (16 Dec) → 1945: the Vistula-Oder (from 12 Jan), Yalta (4-11 Feb), Budapest, Vienna, the battle of Berlin (16 April-2 May), the 8 May surrender, Potsdam (17 July-2 Aug), Hiroshima (6 Aug), Nagasaki (9 Aug), Japan's surrender 15 August. The Holocaust: the Judenrat, ghettoisation, the Einsatzgruppen massacres (Babi Yar 29-30 Sept, 33,000), Wannsee (20 Jan 1942), Reinhard (Belzec/Sobibór/Treblinka), Auschwitz-Birkenau, the Hungarian Jews (Mar-Nov 1944), the death marches (from Jan 1945).
brief.names_en: Hitler, Himmler, Heydrich (until 27 May 1942), Göring, Bormann, Frank, Pohl, Ohlendorf, the SS men, Eichmann, Höfle, Wirth; the camp commandants; the victims and resisters: Klemperer, Ringelblum (Oyneg Shabbos), Anne Frank, Wiesel (to Auschwitz 1944), Sophie Scholl, the White Rose, Georg Elser, Stauffenberg, the figures of the Warsaw Uprising (Bór-Komorowski, Monter); Churchill, Roosevelt, Truman, Stalin, de Gaulle, Montgomery, Patton, Bradley, Eisenhower, Zhukov, Konev, Rokossovsky, Vatutin (killed April 1944)
brief.sources_en: The Nazi official documents (the Wannsee protocol, the Einsatzgruppen reports to Himmler); the Soviet Extraordinary State Commission; the camp-liberation records (Shadows of the Camps); survivors' diaries (Klemperer, Frank, the Ringelblum archive); the trial records (Nuremberg IMT, 42 volumes); the Yalta/Potsdam conference records; the Los Alamos atom-bomb archives
brief.link_en: Forms a temporal disjunction with Ch.9 (Quiet Transitions) — one the apex collapse of a civilisation, the other the continuing migration of cultural capital.

plot_acts.zh: 1930s–1950s｜在极权与战火的阴影下 —— 科学流亡、艺术迁移、宗教与思想的暗流、日常生活的欧洲仍在延续。

brief.main: Ch.9 Quiet Transitions in the Dark Decades (1930s-1950s) —— 科学流亡、艺术迁移、宗教与哲学的续命 —— 与 Ch.8 与 Ch.10 的战争-革命叙事形成时间学上的错位。Kershaw 最被低估的一章：欧洲即便在最深崩塌中，文化资本仍在缓慢迁移与保存。
brief.flow: 纳粹驱逐与科学流亡 (1933-1941)：Einstein (1933 普林斯顿)、Born、Peierls、Frisch、Meitner (1938 到瑞典)、Bethe、Teller、Wigner、Szilard、von Neumann、Fermi (1938 美国)、Chaplygin (苏联)、Landau (苏联内部) → 哲学-社会学流亡：Horkheimer、Adorno、Marcuse、Benjamin、Kraus、Löwith、Strauss、Popper (1937 新西兰)、Arendt、Berlin、Schumpeter、Polanyi、Gombrich → 音乐：Schoenberg (1933 洛杉矶)、Bartók (1940 纽约)、Stravinsky (1939 哈佛讲学后留美)、Krenek、Weill、Korngold、Milhaud (1940)、Szell → 绘画：Kandinsky (保留巴黎到 1944)、Chagall (1941)、Breton (1941)、Ernst (1941)、Dali (1940)、Monde → 文学：Mann (1938 美国)、Werfel、Zweig (1942 巴西自杀)、Cioran (巴黎)、Nabokov (1940 美国)、Auden (1939)、Poblet、Neruda → 宗教与哲学的续命：Barth (瑞士)、Brun、Gogarten、Bultmann (保留德国)、Tillich (1933 美国)、Niebuhr、Scheler (1928 亡)、Heidegger (1933-45 弗莱堡的争议)、Sartre-Camus 法国存在主义、Levinas (1961)、Ricoeur (稍后)。
brief.names: Einstein、Born、Peierls、Frisch、Meitner、Bethe、Teller、Wigner、Szilard、von Neumann、Fermi、Oppenheimer、Bohr (1943 逃瑞典 → 英国 → Los Alamos 化名 Nicholas Baker)、Heisenberg；Horkheimer、Adorno、Marcuse、Benjamin、Löwith、Strauss、Popper、Arendt、Berlin、Schumpeter、Polanyi、Gombrich；Schoenberg、Bartók、Stravinsky、Krenek、Weill、Korngold、Milhaud；Kandinsky、Chagall、Breton、Ernst、Dali；Thomas Mann、Werfel、Zweig、Cioran、Nabokov、Auden、Neruda；Barth、Tillich、Niebuhr、Heidegger、Sartre、Camus、Merleau-Ponty、Levinas、Simone Weil (1943 伦敦亡)
brief.sources: Emergency Committee in Aid of Displaced German Scholars (Rockefeller Foundation 档案)、Academy of Emergency Assistance to Refugee Scholars (ALA)、Princeton IAS 创立档案 (1930)、Columbia 与 Harvard 招聘档案、Broadway 剧院与 Hollywood 制片厂记录、纽约现代艺术博物馆 MoMA 流亡艺术家的展览目录
brief.link: 在 Ch.8 与 Ch.10 之间形成时间错位 —— 战争-革命的两头叙事之间插入一条安静的文化资本转移线。
brief.main_en: Ch.9 Quiet Transitions in the Dark Decades (1930s-1950s) — the flight of the scientists, the migration of the arts, the survival of religion and philosophy — in temporal disjunction with the war-revolution narratives of Ch.8 and Ch.10. Kershaw's most underrated chapter: even in its deepest collapse, Europe's cultural capital was still slowly migrating and being preserved.
brief.flow_en: The Nazi expulsions and the flight of the scientists (1933-1941): Einstein (Princeton 1933), Born, Peierls, Frisch, Meitner (to Sweden 1938), Bethe, Teller, Wigner, Szilard, von Neumann, Fermi (to the US 1938) → the flight of philosophy-sociology: Horkheimer, Adorno, Marcuse, Benjamin, Löwith, Strauss, Popper (New Zealand 1937), Arendt, Berlin, Schumpeter, Polanyi, Gombrich → music: Schoenberg (Los Angeles 1933), Bartók (New York 1940), Stravinsky (stayed in the US after the 1939 Harvard lectures), Krenek, Weill, Korngold, Milhaud (1940) → painting: Kandinsky (in Paris until 1944), Chagall (1941), Breton (1941), Ernst (1941), Dalí (1940) → literature: Thomas Mann (1938 US), Werfel, Zweig (suicide in Brazil 1942), Cioran (Paris), Nabokov (1940 US), Auden (1939), Neruda → the survival of religion and philosophy: Barth (Switzerland), Brun, Gogarten, Bultmann (remained in Germany), Tillich (1933 US), Niebuhr, Heidegger (the Freiburg controversy 1933-45), Sartre-Camus French existentialism, Levinas (1961), Ricoeur (slightly later).
brief.names_en: Einstein, Born, Peierls, Frisch, Meitner, Bethe, Teller, Wigner, Szilard, von Neumann, Fermi, Oppenheimer, Bohr (fled to Sweden 1943 → Britain → Los Alamos under the alias Nicholas Baker), Heisenberg; Horkheimer, Adorno, Marcuse, Benjamin, Löwith, Strauss, Popper, Arendt, Berlin, Schumpeter, Polanyi, Gombrich; Schoenberg, Bartók, Stravinsky, Krenek, Weill, Korngold, Milhaud; Kandinsky, Chagall, Breton, Ernst, Dalí; Thomas Mann, Werfel, Zweig, Cioran, Nabokov, Auden, Neruda; Barth, Tillich, Niebuhr, Heidegger, Sartre, Camus, Merleau-Ponty, Levinas, Simone Weil (died London 1943)
brief.sources_en: The Emergency Committee in Aid of Displaced German Scholars (Rockefeller Foundation archives); the Academic Council to Aid Refugees; the founding archives of Princeton's IAS (1930); the Columbia and Harvard hiring files; Broadway theatre and Hollywood studio records; the MoMA exhibition catalogues of émigré artists
brief.link_en: Inserts a quiet line of cultural-capital transfer between the two-ended war-revolution narratives of Ch.8 and Ch.10.

plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.10: Nuremberg, Marshall Plan, Communist coups (Prague 1948), Berlin Blockade, NATO (1949), German partition. Post-war order crystallises in 1949.

brief.main: Ch.10 Out of the Ashes (1945-1949) —— 纽伦堡、马歇尔计划、共产党政变 (1948 捷克政变)、柏林封锁、北约 (1949)、德国分裂。战后秩序在 1949 年定型。Kershaw 处理：从 1945 的『零时刻』到 1949 的两副格局 —— 欧洲自我毁灭的三十年以分裂为欧洲的新常态结束。
brief.flow: 零时刻 (Stunde Null) 1945.5.8 → Potsdam (7.17-8.2) 与德国四分区、波兰西移 (Oder-Neisse)、欧洲排犹余波 (Kielce 1946.7) → 联合国 (1945.10)、Nuremberg (11.20-1946.10)、布雷顿森林 (1944.7)、关贸总协定 GATT (1947) → Kennan Long Telegram (1946.2)、Churchill 铁幕演说 (1946.3)、Truman Doctrine (1947.3)、马歇尔计划 (1947.6)、Cominform (1947.9)、捷克二月政变 (1948.2)、柏林封锁 (1948.6-1949.5) → 以色列建立 (1948.5)、欧洲委员会 (1949.5)、德国基本法 (1949.5) 与 BRD/DDR (1949.9)、北约 (1949.4)、中国革命 (1949.10) 作为全球影响 → 1949 战后秩序定型。
brief.names: Truman、Stettinius、Byrnes、Marshall、Acheson、Kennan、Bevin、Attlee、Morrison、Eden、de Gaulle、Bidault、Schuman、Adenauer、Erhard、Ollenhauer、Stalin、Molotov、Zhdanov、Gottwald、Slánský、Rákösi、Gomulka、Bielerut、Tito、De Gasperi、Nenni、Togliatti、Pius XII、Ben Gurion、Weizmann、Sayre、Mohammad Reza Pahlavi
brief.sources: Nuremberg IMT 与后续 NMT 记录 (12 trials)、国务院 FRUS 系列、Cominform 文件、马歇尔计划 ECA 档案、北约创始文件、捷克 1948 二月事件档案、Bundeskarchiv、Churchill《The Second World War》六卷 (作为战后回忆录，也作为 1948-49 冷战初期的政治宣言)
brief.link: 与下一卷 Vol.9《The Global Age》(1950-) 直接衔接 —— 1949 的定型正是 1950 的起点。Kershaw 两卷合起来是他版的『漫长的 20 世纪』。
brief.main_en: Ch.10 Out of the Ashes (1945-1949) — Nuremberg, the Marshall Plan, the communist coups (the 1948 Czech coup), the Berlin Blockade, NATO (1949), the division of Germany. The postwar order took fixed shape by 1949. Kershaw's handling: from the 'zero hour' of 1945 to the two blocs of 1949 — Europe's thirty years of self-destruction ended with division as Europe's new normal.
brief.flow_en: Zero hour (Stunde Null) 8 May 1945 → Potsdam (17 July-2 Aug) and Germany's four-zone division, Poland's westward shift (the Oder-Neisse), the aftermath of European antisemitism (Kielce, July 1946) → the United Nations (Oct 1945), Nuremberg (20 Nov 1945-Oct 1946), Bretton Woods (July 1944), the GATT (1947) → Kennan's Long Telegram (Feb 1946), Churchill's Iron Curtain speech (March 1946), the Truman Doctrine (March 1947), the Marshall Plan (June 1947), the Cominform (Sept 1947), the Czech February coup (Feb 1948), the Berlin Blockade (June 1948-May 1949) → the founding of Israel (May 1948), the Council of Europe (May 1949), the German Basic Law (May 1949) and the FRG/GDR (Sept 1949), NATO (April 1949), the Chinese revolution (Oct 1949) as global effect → the postwar order fixed by 1949.
brief.names_en: Truman, Byrnes, Marshall, Acheson, Kennan, Bevin, Attlee, Morrison, Eden, de Gaulle, Bidault, Schuman, Adenauer, Erhard, Stalin, Molotov, Zhdanov, Gottwald, Slánský, Rákosi, Gomulka, Tito, De Gasperi, Nenni, Togliatti, Pius XII, Ben Gurion, Weizmann
brief.sources_en: The Nuremberg IMT and the subsequent NMT records (12 trials); the State Department FRUS series; the Cominform documents; the Marshall Plan's ECA archives; the NATO founding documents; the archives of Czechoslovakia's February 1948 events; the Bundesarchiv; Churchill's The Second World War (six volumes, as postwar memoir and also as a political manifesto of the early Cold War 1948-49)
brief.link_en: Connects directly to Vol.9 (The Global Age, from 1950) — the 1949 fixing is precisely the 1950 starting point. Kershaw's two volumes together are his version of 'the long twentieth century'.

narrative.zh: 严格编年但按「战争-和平-战争」大节奏；Kershaw 特色：以德国为轴心但始终保持全欧视角，大量使用日记、信件、回忆录让宏观叙事有个人温度。
narrative.en: Strictly chronological within war-peace-war rhythm; Kershaw signature: Germany as pivot but maintaining pan-European perspective, heavy use of diaries, letters, memoirs giving personal warmth to macro-narrative.
