quotes.orig: And it inaugurated an epoch – the ‘Thirty Years War’ of the twentieth century – in which the continent of Europe came close to destroying itself.
quotes.trans_zh: 它开启了一个时代——二十世纪的「三十年战争」——在这一时代里，欧洲大陆几乎走向自我毁灭。
quotes.source: Kershaw《地狱归来：欧洲 1914–1949》· 序章 · 论题
quotes.source_en: Ian Kershaw, To Hell and Back: Europe 1914–1949 · Prologue: The Theme

quotes.orig: Yet, remarkably, the Second World War, in stark contrast to the mayhem engendered by the First, paved the way for Europe’s rebirth in the latter half of the century.
quotes.trans_zh: 然而值得注意的是，第二次世界大战与一战所酿成的浩劫形成鲜明对照，反倒为世纪后半叶欧洲的重生铺平了道路。
quotes.source: Kershaw《地狱归来：欧洲 1914–1949》· 正文 · 战争的遗产
quotes.source_en: Ian Kershaw, To Hell and Back: Europe 1914–1949 · The Legacy of War

intent.reception_good_zh: 「Kershaw 把三十年写成一个连贯故事的能力令人叹服」——The Times。
intent.reception_good_en: 'Kershaw's ability to write thirty years as one coherent story is formidable' — The Times.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 两点最受质疑：其一，把1914至1945读作一场「第二次三十年战争」的内战叙事虽有力，却有把复杂的多线冲突塞进单一框架之嫌，尤其淡化了巴尔干与苏德战场的相对自主性；其二，「极权主义趋同」（纳粹与斯大林并置）的框架被东欧史学者批评为德国/西欧中心，且可能遮蔽两类政权在社会基础与运作逻辑上的差异。作为「从下面看」的尝试，日常经验虽丰富，地区覆盖仍向西欧倾斜。
intent.reception_bad_en: Two points draw most fire: reading 1914-1945 as a single 'second thirty years' war' civil-war narrative is powerful but risks squeezing multi-line conflicts into one frame, downplaying the relative autonomy of the Balkans and the Eastern Front; and the 'totalitarian convergence' pairing of Nazism and Stalinism is criticised by Eastern-European historians as Germany/West-Europe-centric and as obscuring differences in the two regimes' social bases and logics. As a 'view from below' it is rich in everyday experience yet its regional coverage still tilts west.
intent.syn_zh: 1914–1949 = 一场内战——Kershaw 以此挑战了把两次大战分开叙事的传统。
intent.syn_en: 1914–1949 = one civil war — Kershaw challenges the tradition of narrating the two World Wars separately.

craft.zh: 以个人文件（日记、信件、回忆录）赋予宏观史以温度
craft.en: Personal documents (diaries, letters, memoirs) giving warmth to macro-history

craft.zh: 「新三十年战争」作为统一解释框架
craft.en: 'New Thirty Years' War' as unifying interpretive framework

craft.zh: Kershaw 的『新三十年战争』框架 —— 1914-1949 作为单一结构性崩溃。
craft.en: The 'new Thirty Years' War' frame — 1914-1949 as one collapse.

craft.zh: 史学文献的克制引用 —— 主体叙事 + 每章末一段文献综述。
craft.en: Restrained scholarly apparatus: narrative + end-of-chapter historiographical essay.

craft.zh: 大量同时人日记/书信 —— 从 Victor Klemperer 到 Anne Frank 到曼施泰因元帅。
craft.en: Wide contemporary diaries: Klemperer, Frank, von Manstein.

motifs.evid_zh: 1914-1949 是欧洲文明在自己手中崩塌的三十年半世纪。
motifs.evid_en: 1914-1949: the thirty-five-odd years in which European civilisation collapsed at its own hands.

motifs.evid_zh: 纳粹与斯大林作为同一结构性危机的两个面。
motifs.evid_en: Nazism and Stalinism as two faces of the same structural crisis.

motifs.evid_zh: 大屠杀不是战争的注脚，而是欧洲史的核心事件。
motifs.evid_en: The Holocaust is not a footnote to the war but the central event of European history.

motifs.evid_zh: 1945-1949 的欧洲如何在废墟中被重新分割。
motifs.evid_en: How the Europe of 1945-1949 was re-partitioned out of the ruins.

excerpts.orig: This is the first of two volumes on the history of Europe from 1914 to our own times. It is by some distance the hardest book I have undertaken. Each book I have written has in some sense been an attempt to gain a better understanding on my part of a problem in the past. In this case, the recent past contains a multiplicity of extremely complex problems. But whatever the difficulties, the temptation to try to understand better the forces that have in the recent past shaped the world of today was irresistible.
excerpts.trans_zh: 这是我所承担过最难写的一本书 —— 关于 1914 到 1949 的欧洲，即它自我毁灭的三十年半世纪。
excerpts.note_zh: Kershaw 自序 —— 承认全书的主题是一个文明的崩塌。
excerpts.note_en: Kershaw's own preface: this is his hardest book — a civilisation's collapse.

excerpts.orig: The wars of peoples will be more terrible than those of kings.
excerpts.trans_zh: 「人民的战争将比国王的战争更为可怕。」
excerpts.note_zh: 以 19 世纪末的一句预言作为卷首题辞 —— 民族国家时代战争的民主化即惨烈化。
excerpts.note_en: Epigraph: 'wars of peoples will be more terrible than those of kings'.

excerpts.orig: Europe’s twentieth century was a century of war. Two world wars followed by over forty years of ‘cold war’ – itself the direct product of the Second World War – defined the age. It was an extraordinarily dramatic, tragic and endlessly fascinating period, its history one of huge upheaval and astounding transformation. During the twentieth century, Europe went to hell and back. The continent, which for nearly one hundred years after the end of the Napoleonic Wars in 1815 had prided itself on being the apogee of civilization, fell between 1914 and 1945 into the pit of barbarism. But a calamitous self-destructive era was followed by previously unimaginable stability and prosperity – though at the heavy price of unbridgeable political division. Thereafter, a reunified Europe, facing huge internal pressures from intensified globalization and serious external challenges, experienced increasing inbuilt tensions even before the financial crash of 2008 plunged the continent into a new, still unresolved, crisis.
excerpts.trans_zh: 欧洲的二十世纪是一个战争的世纪 —— 两次世界大战加上四十余年的「冷战」，定义了时代。
excerpts.note_zh: 「自我毁灭的世纪」的定题 —— 1914-1949 是同一个结构性崩塌的不同面相。
excerpts.note_en: Thesis: 1914-1949 is one structural collapse in three phases.

deep_read.en: First 3 and last 2 pages of each chapter carry the argument

deep_read.en: Ch. 8 (Hell on Earth) and Ch. 10 (Out of the Ashes) are peaks

read_through.verdict_zh: Kershaw 用 10 章 + 导论写完 1914-1949 一个结构性崩塌。全书最原创的框架是他把 1914-1945 视为『新型三十年战争』 —— 不是修辞类比，而是一个可以按 1914-18 / 1919-29 / 1929-39 / 1939-45 / 1945-49 五段追踪的结构性冲突：民族国家体系的内爆 + 极权双生 + 种族灭绝的中心性 + 从零时刻到分裂。通读之后：本书不是二战史，也不是纳粹德国史 —— 是欧洲文明在自己手中崩塌的一整个长三十年的通论。第 8 章『Hell on Earth』(1941-45) 与第 10 章『Out of the Ashes』(1945-49) 是两座高峰。全书最重要的判断可能是第 1 章『On the Brink』中的 —— 一战的爆发不是任何个人的决定，而是欧洲旧制精英在集体自满中的失重。
read_through.verdict_en: Kershaw's 10 chapters plus introduction describe one structural collapse 1914-1949. His most original frame is treating 1914-45 as a new Thirty Years' War — not rhetorical analogy but a five-phase structural conflict (1914-18 / 1919-29 / 1929-39 / 1939-45 / 1945-49): nation-state system imploding + twin totalitarianisms + genocide at the centre + from zero-hour to division. On a full read this is not WWII history, not Nazi-Germany history — it's the collapse of a civilisation across one long Thirty Years. Chs. 8 (Hell on Earth 1941-45) and 10 (Out of the Ashes 1945-49) are the twin peaks. Perhaps the sharpest verdict is in Ch.1: 1914 was nobody's decision; it was the weightlessness of old-regime elites in collective complacency.

observations.title_zh: 『新型三十年战争』框架的方法论价值
observations.note_zh: Kershaw 不是第一个提出这个框架的人 (A.J.P. Taylor 与 Arno Mayer 都提过)，但他是第一个在通史层面把它完整执行到 1914-1949 的 —— 用 5 段时间把两次大战之间-之间-之后串成一次冲突。这一框架在导论 6 页内即完整陈述，之后每一章都在实证回归。
observations.note_en: Not the first to use the frame (Taylor, Mayer precede him), but first to execute it survey-wide across 1914-49. Stated fully in 6 pp of the Introduction; every chapter then returns to it empirically.

observations.title_zh: 大屠杀作为中心而非注脚
observations.note_zh: 第 8 章『Hell on Earth』把 1941-45 的种族灭绝与军事史同时处理 —— Kershaw 拒绝把大屠杀作为二战的『背景』或『战时副现象』，而是作为欧洲史 1914-1949 结构性崩塌的极点。这是全书最重要的位置选择。
observations.note_en: Ch.8 handles genocide and military history simultaneously — the Shoah is not WWII's background or by-product but the extreme point of Europe's 1914-49 structural collapse. The book's most consequential placement.

observations.title_zh: 第 9 章『黑暗年代里的静默转身』的位置
observations.title_en: Ch.9 quiet transitions in dark decades
observations.note_zh: 这一章处理 1930s-1950s 的科学流亡、艺术迁移、宗教与哲学的续命 —— 与第 8 与第 10 章的战争-革命叙事形成时间学上的错位。这是 Kershaw 最被低估的一章：他论证欧洲即便在最深崩塌中，文化资本仍在缓慢迁移与保存。
observations.note_en: Handles scientific exile, artistic migration, religious and philosophical continuities 1930s-50s — deliberately out of phase with Chs.8 and 10's war-revolution narrative. Kershaw's most underrated chapter: European cultural capital kept migrating and being preserved even at civilisation's nadir.

observations.title_zh: Kershaw 与 Goldhagen / Browning 的隐性对话
observations.title_en: Implicit dialogue with Goldhagen and Browning
observations.note_zh: 第 8 章关于普通人参与屠杀的解释 —— Kershaw 明显与 Goldhagen 的『德国人特殊灭绝主义』保持距离，接近 Browning 的『普通人』结构主义，但更强调极权体制下的服从与意识形态灌输的相互作用。这个立场在正文中不显式论证但贯穿每一段。
observations.note_en: On ordinary participation in killing: distant from Goldhagen's German-special-annihilationism, closer to Browning's Ordinary Men structuralism, but stressing totalitarian obedience plus ideological inculcation interacting. Never argued explicitly but threaded throughout.

full_analysis.zh: **通读后的整体判断**：Kershaw 本书的最大胆之处是把 1914-1949 处理为**一部**结构性崩塌，而不是两次大战加中间一段和平。这个『新型三十年战争』的框架不是他首创 (A.J.P. Taylor, Arno Mayer 都提过)，但他是第一个在通史层面把它完整执行的。全书的第二支柱是把大屠杀放在 1941-1945 的核心位置 —— 拒绝把它作为战争背景或注脚，这是他与很多同期二战史家 (Beevor, Overy) 的分水岭。第三支柱是 Ch.9 的『静默转身』—— 在最深崩塌里文化资本仍在迁移与保存 —— 这一章在整本书里最安静也最原创。局限：(1) 东欧 (波兰、苏联、巴尔干) 在 1944-1949 段的处理以苏联-西方对抗为主，本地视角 (Kuronia, 乌克兰民族主义, 铁托游击队) 相对薄弱；(2) 对女性经验的处理集中在 Ch.9 的一节 —— 与 Sheila Rowbotham / Orlando Figes 的性别维度相比是收缩的；(3) 西班牙内战在 Ch.6 用 8 页处理 —— 与本书其他部分的密度相比明显压缩；(4) 大萧条的经济机制在 Ch.5 内被简化，未吸收 2010 年后 Adam Tooze 一派的新研究。
full_analysis.en: **Overall verdict after a full read**: Kershaw's boldest move is treating 1914-49 as ONE structural collapse — not two wars with a peace in between. The 'new Thirty Years' frame isn't his invention (Taylor, Mayer precede him), but he is the first to execute it survey-wide. Second pillar: the Shoah placed at the centre of 1941-45, not as background or footnote — this is his watershed with Beevor/Overy-type WWII histories. Third pillar: Ch.9's 'quiet transitions' — cultural capital migrating and being preserved even at civilisation's nadir — the quietest and most original chapter. Limitations: (1) Eastern Europe (Poland, USSR, Balkans) 1944-49 is framed Soviet-vs-Western, with local voices (Kuron, Ukrainian nationalism, Tito's partisans) comparatively weak; (2) women's experience only in a Ch.9 sub-section, contracted relative to Rowbotham / Figes; (3) Spanish Civil War in 8 pp of Ch.6, clearly compressed against the book's general density; (4) Great Depression economics simplified in Ch.5, without absorbing post-2010 Adam Tooze-school research.

books.why_zh: 企鹅欧洲史的终卷——从战后废墟到欧盟危机、从福利国家到全球化——Kershaw 以一个问句收束三千年：欧洲是否正在失去它的世界角色？
books.why_en: The Penguin Europe series finale — from postwar ruins to EU crises, welfare states to globalization — Kershaw ends three millennia with a question: Is Europe losing its world role?

background.zh: Kershaw 第二次为该系列执笔（前卷 To Hell and Back 1914–1949），写终卷 1950–2017。本书原为 2007 年 Roller-Coaster: Europe 1950–2010（Penguin UK），2019 年全面修订扩展至 2017 并改名为 The Global Age（US 版 Viking/Penguin Press 2019-04-30；UK 版 2020 年 9 月以 Roller-Coaster 更新版发行）。核心论题：战后欧洲经历了「黄金三十年」（1950–1973 高增长与福利国家建立）、「滞胀与转折」（1973–1989 石油危机、Thatcher/Reagan、东欧解体）、和「后冷战全球化」（1989–2017 欧盟扩展、欧元、2008 危机、难民潮、脱欧、民粹崛起）。结论开放：欧洲站在十字路口。
background.en: Kershaw's second contribution (after To Hell and Back), writing the series finale 1950–2017. Originally Roller-Coaster: Europe 1950–2010 (2007 Penguin UK), comprehensively revised and extended to 2017 in 2019 as The Global Age (Viking/Penguin Press US 2019-04-30; UK edition follows in Sep 2020 as updated Roller-Coaster). Core thesis: post-war Europe experienced 'Golden Age' (1950–1973 growth & welfare state), 'Stagnation & Turn' (1973–1989 oil crisis, Thatcher/Reagan, Eastern European collapse), and 'Post-Cold-War Globalization' (1989–2017 EU expansion, euro, 2008 crisis, migration, Brexit, populism). Open conclusion: Europe at a crossroads.

plot_acts.zh: 1950｜Kershaw 自设框架：1900-1949「自毁」与 1950 之后「不安」的对偶 —— 「全球化」既是解药，也是新的不安之源。
plot_acts.en: 1950｜Kershaw's frame: self-destruction 1900-49 vs insecurity 1950+ — globalisation as both cure and new source.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Foreword —— Kershaw 自设框架：欧洲的两个不安时代 (1900-1950 与 1990 至今)，1950-1990 只是中间的稳定化例外。全书的辩证结构在此一次性立起。
plot_acts.arg_en: Foreword: Kershaw's own frame — Europe's two eras of insecurity (1900-50 and post-1990), 1950-90 as the stabilised exception. Dialectical structure set once.

brief.main: Foreword —— Kershaw 自设框架：欧洲的两个不安时代 (1900-1950 与 1990 至今)。1950-1990 是中间的稳定化例外 —— 使全书 12 章不再是编年而是『不安-稳定-再不安』的对称。显式回应 Vol.8 的 Introduction。
brief.flow: 两个不安时代的对称说明 → 1950-1990 稳定的四大支柱 (冷战均势、美国保护伞、福利国家、欧洲一体化) → 每一支柱如何在 1990 后同时变成新问题来源 → 12 章结构说明 → 与 Vol.8 (To Hell and Back) 的显式衔接。
brief.names: Kershaw 自己在两卷之间的方法声明 —— 与 Judt (2005《战后》)、Mazower (1998《黑暗大陆》)、Hobsbawm (1994《极端的年代》)、Offe 的欧洲一体化讨论对话
brief.sources: 跨段一手材料预告：各国内阁档案、欧共体委员会文件、KGB/Stasi 档案、东欧 1989 记录、难民与恐袭统计、欧元区危机欧洲央行报告
brief.link: 显式回应 Vol.8 —— 两卷构成一个长 20 世纪。
brief.main_en: Foreword — Kershaw sets his own frame: Europe's two ages of anxiety (1900-1950 and 1990 to the present). 1950-1990 is the stabilised exception in between — making the book's twelve chapters not a chronicle but a symmetry of 'anxiety-stability-new anxiety'. An explicit response to Vol.8's Introduction.
brief.flow_en: The symmetry of the two ages of anxiety → the four pillars of the 1950-1990 stability (Cold War equilibrium, the American umbrella, the welfare state, European integration) → how each pillar turned simultaneously into a source of new problems after 1990 → an explanation of the twelve-chapter structure → the explicit joining to Vol.8 (To Hell and Back).
brief.names_en: Kershaw's own method statement across the two volumes — in dialogue with Judt (Postwar 2005), Mazower (Dark Continent 1998), Hobsbawm (Age of Extremes 1994), and Offe on European integration
brief.sources_en: A preview of the cross-period first-hand material: cabinet archives of the various states, EEC Commission documents, KGB/Stasi archives, the records of 1989 in Eastern Europe, refugee and terror-attack statistics, the euro-crisis ECB reports
brief.link_en: An explicit response to Vol.8 — the two volumes make one long twentieth century.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第一章 · 紧张的分界
plot_acts.zh: 1945–1953｜铁幕落下、希腊内战、柏林封锁、朝鲜战争、斯大林晚期 —— 欧洲在两极格局中的冻结。
plot_acts.en: 1945–1953｜Iron curtain, Greek Civil War, Berlin Blockade, Korea, late Stalin — Europe frozen into bipolarity.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.1 The Tense Divide (1945-1953) —— 铁幕落下、希腊内战、柏林封锁、朝鲜战争、斯大林死亡。欧洲在两副格局中的冻结。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.1: Iron Curtain, Greek Civil War, Berlin Blockade, Korean War, Stalin's death. Europe freezes in two frameworks.

brief.main: Ch.1 The Tense Divide (1945-1953) —— 铁幕落下、希腊内战、柏林封锁、朝鲜战争、斯大林死亡。欧洲在两副格局中的冻结。
brief.flow: 雅尔塔 (1945.2) 与波茨坦 (7-8) 的分区安排 → 希腊内战 (1946-49 民族阵线 EAM vs 保皇派)、土耳其危机 (1945-47)、Truman Doctrine (1947.3)、马歇尔计划 (1947.6)、Cominform (1947.9)、捷克二月政变 (1948.2)、Berlin 封锁 (1948.6-1949.5)、北约 (1949.4)、德国分裂 (1949.9 BRD/DDR)、朝鲜战争 (1950-53)、斯大林死亡 (1953.3)、柏林六月起义 (1953)、贝利亚失势、马林科夫-赫鲁晓夫过渡。
brief.names: Truman、Stalin、Attlee、Bevin、Molotov、Zhukov、Gomulka、Bierut、Rákösi、Gottwald、Slánský、Markos、Zachariadis、Dimitrov、Tito、De Gaulle、Schuman、Adenauer、Hess、Brandenburg、Churchill (1946 铁幕)、Khrushchev、Beria、Malenkov、Kim Il Sung、Syngman Rhee、MacArthur、Bradley
brief.sources: 国务院 FRUS 1945-53、Cominform 文件、苏联共产党中央全会记录、波兰 IPN 档案、匈牙利 MOL、捷克 ABS、朝鲜战争各方军事档案、Churchill《Iron Curtain》演讲全文
brief.link: 为 Ch.2 (Western Europe 建立) 与 Ch.3 (The Clamp) 提供对称框架 —— 一西一东。
brief.main_en: Ch.1 The Tense Divide (1945-1953) — the Iron Curtain descends, the Greek civil war, the Berlin Blockade, the Korean War, Stalin's death. Europe frozen into two blocs.
brief.flow_en: The zone arrangements of Yalta (Feb 1945) and Potsdam (July-Aug) → the Greek civil war (1946-49, the EAM national front vs the royalists), the Turkey crisis (1945-47), the Truman Doctrine (March 1947), the Marshall Plan (June 1947), the Cominform (Sept 1947), the Czech February coup (Feb 1948), the Berlin Blockade (June 1948-May 1949), NATO (April 1949), the division of Germany (Sept 1949 FRG/GDR), the Korean War (1950-53), Stalin's death (March 1953), the East German June uprising (1953), Beria's fall, the Malenkov-Khrushchev transition.
brief.names_en: Truman, Stalin, Attlee, Bevin, Molotov, Zhukov, Gomulka, Bierut, Rákosi, Gottwald, Slánský, Markos, Zachariadis, Dimitrov, Tito, de Gaulle, Schuman, Adenauer, Churchill (the 1946 Iron Curtain), Khrushchev, Beria, Malenkov, Kim Il Sung, Syngman Rhee, MacArthur, Bradley
brief.sources_en: The State Department FRUS 1945-53; the Cominform documents; the records of the CPSU Central Committee; the Polish IPN archives; Hungary's MOL; the Czech ABS; the military archives of the various sides of the Korean War; the full text of Churchill's Iron Curtain speech
brief.link_en: Provides a symmetric frame for Ch.2 (the making of Western Europe) and Ch.3 (The Clamp) — one West, one East.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第二章 · 西欧的建构
plot_acts.title_en: Chapter 2 · The Making of Western Europe
plot_acts.zh: 1947–1957｜马歇尔计划、欧共体前身 (ECSC 1951, EEC 1957)、联邦德国重建、社会民主-基督教民主共识。
plot_acts.en: 1947–1957｜Marshall Plan, ECSC 1951 & EEC 1957, West German reconstruction, Christian/Social-Democratic settlement.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.2 The Making of Western Europe (1947-1957) —— 马歇尔计划、欧共体前身 (ECSC 1951, EEC 1957)、联邦德国重建、社会民主-基民党共识。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.2: Marshall Plan, proto-EU (ECSC 1951, EEC 1957), West German reconstruction, social-democratic / Christian-democratic consensus.

brief.main: Ch.2 The Making of Western Europe (1947-1957) —— 马歇尔计划、欧共体前身 (ECSC 1951、EEC 1957)、联邦德国重建、社会民主-基民党共识。战后西欧洲的制度奠基。
brief.flow: 马歇尔计划实施 (1948-1952) 与 OEEC → 欧洲委员会 (1949.5) → Schuman Declaration (1950.5.9) 与 ECSC 巴黎条约 (1951.4.18) → 欧洲防务共同体 EDC 与法国议会否决 (1954.8.30) → 伦敦-巴黎条约 (1954.10) 与 WEU、联邦德国加入北约 → Adenauer 与德国经济奇迹 (Erhard 1948 货币改革与社会市场经济) → Spaak Report (1956) 与罗马条约 (1957.3.25 EEC + Euratom) → 法国第四共和国终结 (1958.10) 与戴高乐第五共和国 → 英国申请的第一次被否决 (1963 de Gaulle veto)。
brief.names: Schuman、Adenauer、de Gasperi、Spaak、Monnet、Beyen、Hallstein、Erhard、Söderblom、Mollet、Giscard d'Estaing (作为财政部长 1956)、Mendes-France、Eisenhower、Dulles、Bevin、Attlee、Macmillan、Eden、Gaitskell、Kiesinger、Ollenhauer、Brandt (作为柏林市长 1957)
brief.sources: EEC 罗马条约、ECSC 巴黎条约、OEEC 报告、法国与意大利议会辩论、德国联邦议院记录、Adenauer 书信、Monnet《Memoirs》(1976)、Hallstein 文件、Bundeskarchiv、Archives nationales、法国战争部档案
brief.link: 与 Ch.3 (The Clamp) 形成对称 —— 西欧一体化与东欧苏联化。
brief.main_en: Ch.2 The Making of Western Europe (1947-1957) — the Marshall Plan, the forerunners of the Communities (ECSC 1951, EEC 1957), the reconstruction of West Germany, the Social-Democratic/Christian-Democratic consensus. The institutional founding of postwar Western Europe.
brief.flow_en: The Marshall Plan's implementation (1948-1952) and the OEEC → the Council of Europe (May 1949) → the Schuman Declaration (9 May 1950) and the ECSC Treaty of Paris (18 April 1951) → the European Defence Community and the French parliament's veto (30 Aug 1954) → the London-Paris treaties (Oct 1954) and the WEU, West Germany joining NATO → Adenauer and the German economic miracle (Erhard's 1948 currency reform and social market economy) → the Spaak Report (1956) and the Treaties of Rome (25 March 1957, EEC + Euratom) → the end of the French Fourth Republic (Oct 1958) and de Gaulle's Fifth → the first vetoed British application (the de Gaulle veto 1963).
brief.names_en: Schuman, Adenauer, de Gasperi, Spaak, Monnet, Beyen, Hallstein, Erhard, Mollet, Giscard d'Estaing (as finance minister 1956), Mendès-France, Eisenhower, Dulles, Bevin, Attlee, Macmillan, Eden, Gaitskell, Kiesinger, Ollenhauer, Brandt (as West Berlin's mayor 1957)
brief.sources_en: The EEC Treaties of Rome; the ECSC Treaty of Paris; the OEEC reports; the French and Italian parliamentary debates; the Bundestag records; Adenauer's letters; Monnet's Memoirs (1976); the Hallstein papers; the Bundesarchiv; the Archives nationales; the French war-ministry archives
brief.link_en: Forms a symmetry with Ch.3 (The Clamp) — Western European integration vs Eastern Sovietisation.

plot_acts.zh: 1953–1968｜东柏林 1953、匈牙利 1956、布拉格之春前夜、柏林墙 1961 —— 极权在东欧收紧并镇压改革。
plot_acts.en: 1953–1968｜East Berlin '53, Hungary '56, pre-Prague Spring, Berlin Wall '61 — totalitarian clamp on Eastern Europe.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.3 The Clamp (1953-1968) —— 东欧 1953、波兹南 1956、布拉格之春前夜、柏林墙 1961。铁幕在东欧收紧并压制改革。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.3: East Germany 1953, Poznań 1956, pre-Prague Spring, Berlin Wall 1961. The clamp tightening in Eastern Europe.

brief.main: Ch.3 The Clamp (1953-1968) —— 东欧 1953、波兹南 1956、布拉格之春前夜、柏林墙 1961。铁幕在东欧收紧并压制改革。
brief.flow: 斯大林 1953.3 死亡与后斯大林过渡 → 东德 1953.6.17 起义与苏联坦克 → 波兰 1956 波兹南 6 月起义与哥穆尔卡上台 → 匈牙利 1956.10-11 革命与苏联第二次干涉、Nagy 处决 (1958.6.16) → 苏联 1956.2 二十大赫鲁晓夫『秘密报告』与去斯大林化 → 中苏论战 → 柏林墙 1961.8.13 修建与 1962.8 彼得·费希特之死 → 古巴导弹危机 (1962.10) 与美苏缓和 → 法国-西德 Elysée 条约 (1963.1.22)、空椅子危机 (1965) 与卢森堡妥协 → 苏联 1964 赫鲁晓夫下台与勃列日涅夫 → 越南战争与欧洲 → 捷克斯洛伐克 1968 布拉格之春 (1-8) 与苏联华约八月入侵 (8.20-21)、Dubček 被押送至莫斯科、Husák 正常化、Jan Palach 自焚 (1969.1.16)。
brief.names: Khrushchev、Malenkov、Zhukov、Beria、Gomulka、Cyrankiewicz、Polish October 诸人、Nagy、Kádár、Dudás、Pál Maléter、Molnár、Dubček、Svoboda、Husák、Šváb、Cerník、Hájek、Brezhnev、Andropov、Podgorny、Shelepin、Semichastny、Ulbricht、Honecker、Gheorghiu-Dej、Ceaușescu (1965 上台)、Tito、Goncz (稍后)
brief.sources: 东欧各国党报与决议、波兰 IPN、匈牙利 MOL、捷克 ABS 与 ÚSTR、东德 BStU (Stasi 档案)、苏联中央全会与政治局记录、华约联合司令部档案、Dubček 与 Svoboda 与勃列日涅夫 8 月谈判纪要 (Zbraslavia 会议)
brief.link: 为 Ch.4 (Good Times) 与 Ch.7 (The Turn) 铺路 —— 东欧的压制与西欧洲的繁荣互为对照。
brief.main_en: Ch.3 The Clamp (1953-1968) — Eastern Europe 1953, Poznań 1956, the eve of the Prague Spring, the Berlin Wall 1961. The Iron Curtain tightening in the East and crushing reform.
brief.flow_en: Stalin's death in March 1953 and the post-Stalin transition → the East German uprising of 17 June 1953 and the Soviet tanks → Poland's 1956 Poznań June uprising and Gomułka's rise → Hungary's revolution of Oct-Nov 1956 and the second Soviet intervention, Nagy's execution (16 June 1958) → Khrushchev's 1956 Twentieth Congress 'secret speech' and de-Stalinisation → the Sino-Soviet split → the building of the Berlin Wall (13 Aug 1961) and the death of Peter Fechter (Aug 1962) → the Cuban Missile Crisis (Oct 1962) and the US-USSR détente → the Élysée Treaty (22 Jan 1963), the Empty Chair crisis (1965) and the Luxembourg Compromise → Khrushchev's 1964 ouster and Brezhnev → the Vietnam War and Europe → the Prague Spring in Czechoslovakia 1968 (Jan-Aug) and the Warsaw Pact invasion of 20-21 Aug, Dubček's arrest and transport to Moscow, Husák's 'normalisation', Jan Palach's self-immolation (16 Jan 1969).
brief.names_en: Khrushchev, Malenkov, Zhukov, Beria, Gomułka, Cyrankiewicz, Nagy, Kádár, Pál Maléter, Dubček, Svoboda, Husák, Černík, Hájek, Brezhnev, Andropov, Podgorny, Shelepin, Semichastny, Ulbricht, Honecker, Gheorghiu-Dej, Ceaușescu (to power 1965), Tito
brief.sources_en: The party presses and resolutions of the Eastern European states; Poland's IPN, Hungary's MOL, the Czech ABS and ÚSTR, the East German BStU (Stasi archives); the Soviet Central Committee and Politburo records; the Warsaw Pact joint-command archives; the August negotiation minutes of Dubček and Svoboda with Brezhnev (the Čierna/Zbraslav meetings)
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.4 (Good Times) and Ch.7 (The Turn) — Eastern repression and Western prosperity as a mutual contrast.

plot_acts.zh: 1950–1973｜「黄金三十年」—— 高增长、福利国家、消费社会、青年文化、摇滚、性革命、教育扩张。
plot_acts.en: 1950–1973｜The 'Golden Age' — growth, welfare state, consumerism, youth culture, rock, sexual revolution, educational expansion.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.4 Good Times (1950-1973) —— 黄金三十年：高增长、福利国家、消费社会、青年文化、移民、性别革命、色情合法化。Kershaw 的历史估值与 Judt/Hobsbawm 有分歧。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.4: Golden Age — growth, welfare state, consumer society, youth culture, immigration, sexual revolution. Kershaw's valuation diverges from Judt/Hobsbawm.

brief.main: Ch.4 Good Times (1950-1973) —— 黄金三十年：高增长、福利国家、消费社会、青年文化、移民、性别革命、色情合法化。Kershaw 与 Judt/Hobsbawm 有分歧 —— 黄金三十年首先是物质与文化的双重突破。
brief.flow: 人口 (婴儿潮 1946-1964、欧洲人口 5.5 亿 → 7.7 亿) → 经济 (GNP 年均 4-5%、失业率 1-2%、通胀 2-4%) → 福利国家 (Beveridge 1942 英国、Sécurité sociale 1945 法国、德国 1950s 社会保险改革、北欧模式) → 消费社会 (汽车普及 1955-1970、电视 1953 加冕直播 1964 卫星、洗衣机、冰箱、超市、快消) → 城市化与郊区化、高速公路、大众旅游 (Costa Briva、Algarve) → 青年文化 (摇滚 1956 Elvis、1964 Beatles、Mods、Rockers、嬉皮、1968 学生) → 性革命 (口服避孕药 1960 FDA、色情出版、1967 英国性犯罪法改革、Kinsey 报告 1948/1953) → 移民 (土耳其到德国 Gastarbeiter 1961、北非到法国、加勒比到英国、南欧到瑞士-比利时) → 教育扩张 (大学人口 3% → 15%)。
brief.names: Beveridge、Erhard、Schuman、de Gasperi、Macmillan、Khrushchev 古巴之后的『古拉什资本主义』提议、Wilson、Brandt (作为西柏林市长 1957-66)、Adenauer、Kennedy、Johnson、Mau 运动、De Gaulle、Pompidou、Heath、Willy Brandt、Kiesinger、Ollenhauer、Brecht (东德)、Shostakovich (苏联解冻)、Chagall、Auden (作为 1956 后的观察者)；文化人物：Elvis、Beatles、Rolling Stones、Jimi Hendrix、Janis Joplin、Jim Morrison、Marlon Brando、James Dean、Brigitte Bardot、Jane Fonda
brief.sources: 各国统计局 OECD 历史统计 (1950-1973)、Beveridge 报告原文、家庭收支调查、Mass Observation 归档 (英国)、Allensbach 调查 (德国)、IFOP (法国)、1968 学生运动小报与海报、唱片目录与音乐会节目、避孕药与性教育出版物、移民劳工档案
brief.link: 为 Ch.6 (Challenges) 与 Ch.7 (The Turn) 铺路 —— 1973 石油危机终结黄金时代。
brief.main_en: Ch.4 Good Times (1950-1973) — the Trente Glorieuses: high growth, the welfare state, the consumer society, youth culture, immigration, the sexual revolution, the legalising of pornography. Kershaw diverges from Judt/Hobsbawm — the golden thirty years were first a twin breakthrough in the material and the cultural.
brief.flow_en: Population (the baby boom 1946-1964, Europe's population 550 million → 770 million) → the economy (GNP growth of 4-5% a year, unemployment 1-2%, inflation 2-4%) → the welfare state (Beveridge 1942 Britain, the Sécurité sociale 1945 France, the 1950s West German social-insurance reforms, the Nordic model) → the consumer society (the car's spread 1955-1970, television — the 1953 coronation broadcast, the 1964 satellite relay — the washing machine, the fridge, the supermarket, fast-moving consumer goods) → urbanisation and suburbanisation, the motorway, mass tourism (the Costa Brava, the Algarve) → youth culture (rock 'n' roll — Elvis 1956, the Beatles 1964 — Mods, Rockers, hippies, the students of 1968) → the sexual revolution (the oral contraceptive pill, FDA 1960, pornographic publishing, Britain's 1967 Sexual Offences reform, the Kinsey reports 1948/1953) → immigration (Turks to Germany as Gastarbeiter from 1961, North Africans to France, the Caribbean to Britain, southern Europeans to Switzerland-Belgium) → the expansion of education (the university population 3% → 15%).
brief.names_en: Beveridge, Erhard, Schuman, de Gasperi, Macmillan, Khrushchev (his post-Cuban 'Goulash capitalism'), Wilson, Brandt (as West Berlin's mayor 1957-66), Adenauer, Kennedy, Johnson, de Gaulle, Pompidou, Heath, Kiesinger; cultural figures: Elvis, the Beatles, the Rolling Stones, Jimi Hendrix, Janis Joplin, Jim Morrison, Marlon Brando, James Dean, Brigitte Bardot
brief.sources_en: The national statistical offices and the OECD historical statistics (1950-1973); the Beveridge Report itself; household expenditure surveys; the Mass Observation archive (Britain), the Allensbach institute (Germany), IFOP (France); the 1968 student movement's pamphlets and posters; record catalogues and concert programmes; contraceptive and sex-education publications; migrant-worker archives
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.6 (Challenges) and Ch.7 (The Turn) — the 1973 oil crisis ends the golden age.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第五章 · 灾难之后的文化
plot_acts.zh: 1945–1970s｜阿多诺「奥斯维辛后写诗是野蛮的」之问 —— 战后哲学 (萨特/加缪/结构主义)、电影新浪潮、戏剧荒诞派、德国批判理论。
plot_acts.en: 1945–1970s｜Adorno's poem-after-Auschwitz question: Sartre/Camus/structuralism, New Wave cinema, theatre of the absurd, Frankfurt School.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.5 Culture After the Catastrophe (1945-1970s) —— Adorno『写诗是野蛮的』之问、战后哲学 (海德/萨特/结构主义)、电影新浪潮、先锋派、德国批判理论。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.5: Adorno's barbarism question, post-war philosophy (Heidegger/Sartre/structuralism), New Wave cinema, avant-garde, Frankfurt School.

brief.main: Ch.5 Culture After the Catastrophe (1945-1970s) —— Adorno『写诗是野蛮的』(1949) 之问、战后哲学 (海德格尔争议、萨特-加缪-梅洛-庞蒂、结构主义列维-斯特劳斯、福柯、德里达、巴特、拉康)、电影新浪潮 (法国 1959-、意大利新现实主义、瑞典伯格曼、苏联塔可夫斯基、日本黑泽明)、先锋派 (具体音乐、序列主义、激浪派、Fluxus)、德国批判理论 (法兰克福学派第二代 Habermas)。
brief.flow: Adorno 与 Horkheimer《启蒙辩证法》(1947) 与『奥斯维辛之后写诗是野蛮的』(1949) → Sartre《存在与虚无》(1943)《辩证理性批判》(1960)、Camus《西西弗神话》(1942)《反抗者》(1951)、Beauvoir《第二性》(1949)、Merleau-Ponty《知觉现象学》(1945) → 结构主义与后结构主义 (Levi-Strauss《忧郁的热带》1955、Barthes《神话学》1957、Lacan《文集》1966、Derrida《论文字学》1967、Foucault《疯癫史》1961《词与物》1966《知识考古学》1969) → 剧场 (Beckett《等待戈多》1953、Ionesco《秃头歌女》1950、Genet、Pinter、Frish、Weiss《调查》1965) → 小说 (Robbe-Grillet、Butor、Sarraute、Cortázar、Calvino、Böll、Grass《铁皮鼓》1959、Lampedusa《豹》1958、Soliženicyn《伊凡·杰尼索维奇的一天》1962、Paz) → 绘画与雕塑 (抽象表现主义 Pollock、Rothko、de Kooning、战后巴黎学院派、Cobra、Giacometti、Henry Moore、Dubuffet、战后德国 Baselitz、Kiefer、Richter、Beuys) → 电影 (意大利新现实主义 Rossellini、De Sica、Visconti、Fellini《甜蜜的生活》1960、Antonioni；法国新浪潮 Truffaut 400 击 1959、Godard 精疲力尽 1960、Resnais、Varda；瑞典伯格曼、意大利帕索里尼、苏联塔可夫斯基《安德烈·卢布廖夫》1966、日本黑泽明、Satyajit Ray) → 音乐 (Boulez、Stockhausen、Cage、Shostakovich 5-15、Britten、Shostakovich、Benjamin Britten 作为英国)。

brief.link: 与 Vol.8 Ch.9 呼应 —— 即便最深崩塌之后，文化生产仍在缓慢重构。
brief.main_en: Ch.5 Culture After the Catastrophe (1945-1970s) — Adorno's 'to write poetry after Auschwitz is barbaric' (1949) as the question; postwar philosophy (the Heidegger affair, Sartre-Camus-Merleau-Ponty, the structuralism of Lévi-Strauss, Foucault, Derrida, Barthes, Lacan); the new waves of cinema (France from 1959, Italian neorealism, Sweden's Bergman, the USSR's Tarkovsky, Japan's Kurosawa); the avant-garde (musique concrète, serialism, Fluxus); the second generation of German critical theory (Habermas).
brief.flow_en: Adorno and Horkheimer's Dialectic of Enlightenment (1947) and 'poetry after Auschwitz is barbaric' (1949) → Sartre's Being and Nothingness (1943) and Critique of Dialectical Reason (1960), Camus's Myth of Sisyphus (1942) and Rebel (1951), Beauvoir's Second Sex (1949), Merleau-Ponty's Phenomenology of Perception (1945) → structuralism and post-structuralism (Lévi-Strauss's Tristes Tropiques 1955, Barthes's Mythologies 1957, Lacan's Écrits 1966, Derrida's Of Grammatology 1967, Foucault's History of Madness 1961, The Order of Things 1966, The Archaeology of Knowledge 1969) → theatre (Beckett's Waiting for Godot 1953, Ionesco's Bald Soprano 1950, Genet, Pinter, Frisch, Weiss's Investigation 1965) → the novel (Robbe-Grillet, Butor, Sarraute, Cortázar, Calvino, Böll, Grass's Tin Drum 1959, Lampedusa's The Leopard 1958, Solzhenitsyn's One Day in the Life of Ivan Denisovich 1962, Paz) → painting and sculpture (Abstract Expressionism — Pollock, Rothko, de Kooning — postwar Paris, Cobra, Giacometti, Henry Moore, Dubuffet, postwar Germany's Baselitz, Kiefer, Richter, Beuys) → cinema (Italian neorealism — Rossellini, De Sica, Visconti, Fellini's La Dolce Vita 1960, Antonioni; the French New Wave — Truffaut's 400 Blows 1959, Godard's Breathless 1960, Resnais, Varda; Sweden's Bergman, Italy's Pasolini, the USSR's Tarkovsky's Andrei Rublev 1966, Japan's Kurosawa, Satyajit Ray) → music (Boulez, Stockhausen, Cage, Shostakovich's symphonies 5-15, Britten).
brief.names_en: Adorno, Horkheimer, Marcuse, Benjamin (died 1940), Sartre, Camus, Beauvoir, Merleau-Ponty, Levinas, Blanchot, Heidegger (the post-1945 ban and controversy), Jaspers (Zurich), Lewis, Tolkien; Lévi-Strauss, Barthes, Lacan, Derrida, Foucault, Deleuze, Bourdieu; Beckett, Ionesco, Pinter, Genet, Frisch, Weiss; Robbe-Grillet, Butor, Sarraute, Simon, Calvino, Böll, Grass, Lampedusa, Solzhenitsyn, Pasternak, Akhmatova, Cortázar, Borges, Paz, Neruda; Dubuffet, Hartung, Baselitz, Kiefer, Penck, Richter, Beuys, Giacometti, Moore, Hepworth; Rossellini, De Sica, Visconti, Fellini, Antonioni, Bergman, Pasolini, Tarkovsky, Bresson, Truffaut, Godard, Chabrol, Rivette, Rohmer, Resnais, Varda, Wajda, Satyajit Ray, Kurosawa, Oshima; Boulez, Stockhausen, Cage, Berio, Ligeti, Shostakovich, Prokofiev (died 1953), Khachaturian, Britten, Henze, Nono, Xenakis
brief.sources_en: The primary philosophical and theoretical texts; the plays and novels; film prints and posters; musical scores and recordings; exhibition catalogues; contemporaries' letters; the censorship archives of the various states (France, Italy, the USSR, Eastern Europe)
brief.link_en: Echoes Vol.8 Ch.9 — even after the deepest collapse, cultural production kept slowly rebuilding.

brief.main: Ch.6 Challenges (1968-1979) —— 1968、布拉格之春、意大利红旅、石油危机、北爱尔兰问题、德国红军派、波兰教宗年代 —— 共识政治受压。这一节把 1968-79 处理为『黄金时代之后、新自由主义之前』的十年危机。
brief.flow: 1968 全球学生运动 (法国五月、柏林 Rudi Dutschke、墨西哥 Tlatelolco、芝加哥 DNC、华沙三月事件、罗马 Valle Giulia) → 布拉格之春 (1968.1-8) 与华约入侵 (8.20) → 波兰 1968 反犹清洗、1970 十二月抗议 → 意大利『铅色年代』(1969 Piazza Fontana 炸弹 → 1978 Aldo Moro 绑架与杀害 → 红旅与极左) → 德国红军派 RAF (1970-、Holzmann、Ensslin、Baader、Raspe → 1977 春 Stammheim 监狱自杀) → 西班牙 ETA (1968-) 与 Carrero 暗杀 (1973)、佛朗哥死 (1975)、胡安·卡洛斯过渡 → 英国北爱尔兰 Troubles (1969 德里游行 → 1972 血腥星期日 → 1974-76 IRA 伦敦 → Hunger Strikes 稍后) → 1973 石油危机与 1979 第二次石油危机 → 波兰 1978 Wojtyła 教宗 (10.16) 与 1980 团结工会前夜。
brief.names: Cohn-Bendit、Dutschke、Marcuse (作为 1968 的思想背景)、Daniel Cohn-Bendit、Kruse、Geismar、Sartre (1968 索邦演讲)、de Gaulle (1968 五月与 1969 四月公投下台)、Pompidou、Dubček、Svoboda、Husák、Brezhnev、Giorgio la Pira、Aldo Moro、Enrico Berlinguer、Longo、Curcio、Moretti、Anna Laura Braghetti；Baader、Ensslin、Raspe、Holzmann、Verena Becker、Buback、Schleyer、Hans-Jürgen Wischnewski；Frank、Adams、Mallon、Maguire、Chichester-Clark、Faulkner、William Craig；Truman (对 1948 的回忆)、Kissinger、Nixon、Ford、Carter、Sadat、Begin；Wojtyła (John Paul II)、Glemp、Macharski、Wałęsa (作为 1978 后的船坞工人)
brief.sources: 各国情报与警察档案 (意大利 SISMI、德国 BKA、英国 Security Service)、RAF 与红旅声明与审判记录、教宗通谕 (Ecclesiam Suam 1964、Populorum Progressio 1967、Redemptor Hominis 1979)、1968 运动小报与海报、石油危机 IEA 与 OPEC 文件
brief.link: 为 Ch.7 (The Turn) 铺路 —— 共识政治的危机导致 1979 后的新自由主义转向。
brief.main_en: Ch.6 Challenges (1968-1979) — 1968, the Prague Spring, Italy's Red Brigades, the oil crises, the Northern Ireland Troubles, Germany's RAF, the Polish papal years — the politics of consensus come under strain. This section treats 1968-79 as the decade of crisis 'after the golden age, before neoliberalism'.
brief.flow_en: The global student movements of 1968 (France's May, Berlin's Rudi Dutschke, Mexico's Tlatelolco, Chicago's DNC, Warsaw's March events, Rome's Valle Giulia) → the Prague Spring (Jan-Aug 1968) and the Warsaw Pact invasion (20 Aug) → Poland's 1968 anti-Jewish purge, the December 1970 protests → Italy's 'years of lead' (the Piazza Fontana bombing 1969 → the kidnapping and murder of Aldo Moro 1978 → the Red Brigades and the far left) → Germany's RAF (from 1970 — Holzmann, Ensslin, Baader, Raspe → the 1977 Stammheim prison deaths) → Spain's ETA (from 1968) and the Carrero assassination (1973), Franco's death (1975), the Juan Carlos transition → Britain's Northern Ireland Troubles (the 1969 Derry march → Bloody Sunday 1972 → the IRA in London 1974-76 → the later hunger strikes) → the 1973 oil crisis and the 1979 second oil crisis → Poland's 1978 election of Wojtyła as pope (16 Oct) and the eve of Solidarity in 1980.
brief.names_en: Cohn-Bendit, Dutschke, Marcuse (as the intellectual background of 1968), Geismar, Sartre (the 1968 Sorbonne speech), de Gaulle (May 1968 and his April 1969 referendum departure), Pompidou, Dubček, Svoboda, Husák, Brezhnev, Giorgio La Pira, Aldo Moro, Enrico Berlinguer, Longo, Curcio, Moretti; Baader, Ensslin, Raspe, Holzmann, Buback, Schleyer; Gerry Adams, Maguire, Faulkner; Kissinger, Nixon, Ford, Carter, Sadat, Begin; Wojtyła (John Paul II), Glemp, Wałęsa (as the post-1978 shipyard worker)
brief.sources_en: The intelligence and police archives of the various states (Italy's SISMI, Germany's BKA, Britain's Security Service); the RAF's and Red Brigades' statements and trial records; the papal encyclicals (Ecclesiam Suam 1964, Populorum Progressio 1967, Redemptor Hominis 1979); the 1968 movement's pamphlets and posters; the IEA and OPEC documents of the oil crises
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.7 (The Turn) — the crisis of the politics of consensus leads to the neoliberal turn after 1979.

brief.main: Ch.7 The Turn (1979-1985) —— 撒切尔 (1979)、里根 (1981)、欧洲经济停滞、密特朗 1981-83 转向、欧洲共识政治的危机。新自由主义转向的欧洲史版本。
brief.flow: 1979 撒切尔当选与私有化 (英国航空、电信、天然气、水)、矿工罢工 (1984-85) 与 NUM Scargill、Falklands (1982)、CND 与 Cruise 导弹、Poll Tax (1990 前奏) → 1980  Reagan 当选与 1981 减税、军备扩张、SdI、波兰戒严 (12.13) → 1981 Mitterrand 当选与激进的 Keynesian 实验 (国有化、最低工资、RRB)、1982-83 转向 (Tournier、Delors) 与法国『左翼的失败』 → 德国 Schmidt 与 Kohl 的 1982 建设性不信任投票、Missiles Crisis (1979 双重决议 → 1983 Pershing II 部署)、和平运动 → 意大利 Craxi 与社会党转向、Eurocommunist 终结 (Berlinguer 1984 亡) → 西班牙 González 与 PSOE 1982 → 希腊 Papandreou PASOK 1981 → 欧洲一体化重启 (1985 Dooge Committee → 1986 SEA)。
brief.names: Thatcher、Reagan、Mitterrand、Schmidt、Kohl、Carrington、Healey、Nairn、Kinnock (1983 工党领袖)、Scargill、Adams、Bobby Sands (1981 Hunger Strike 亡)、Falklands 诸将、Haig、Shultz、Weinberger、Caspar Weinberger、Monsignor Casaroli、John Paul II、Jaruzelski、Kiszczak、Wałęsa、Modrow、Honecker、Brezhnev (1982 亡)、Andropov (1982-84)、Chernenko (1984-85)、Gorbachev (1985.3 上台)、Craxi、Berlinguer、Bettino、González、Papandreou、Cavero、Rocard、Fabius、Attali (稍后)
brief.sources: 英国与法国财政部档案、撒切尔回忆录《The Downing Street Years》、Reagan 回忆录、Mitterrand《Mémoire à deux voix》、TASS 苏联官方声明、东欧异见出版物 (KOR、ROSO、Charta 77)、梵蒂冈外交档案、和平运动记录
brief.link: 为 Ch.8 (Easterly Wind of Change) 铺路 —— 撒切尔-里根-密特朗的欧洲重组与戈尔巴乔夫的东欧转向。
brief.main_en: Ch.7 The Turn (1979-1985) — Thatcher (1979), Reagan (1981), European economic stagnation, Mitterrand's 1981-83 u-turn, the crisis of Europe's politics of consensus. The European-history version of the neoliberal turn.
brief.flow_en: Thatcher's 1979 election and privatisation (British Airports, British Telecom, Gas, Water), the miners' strike (1984-85) and the NUM's Scargill, the Falklands (1982), CND and the Cruise missiles, the Poll Tax (the prelude to 1990) → Reagan's 1980 election and the 1981 tax cuts, the arms build-up, the SDI, martial law in Poland (13 Dec) → Mitterrand's 1981 election and the radical Keynesian experiment (nationalisation, the minimum wage, the RRB), the 1982-83 u-turn (Tournier, Delors) and France's 'failure of the left' → Germany's 1982 constructive vote of no confidence moving Schmidt to Kohl, the Missiles Crisis (the 1979 double decision → the 1983 Pershing II deployment), the peace movement → Craxi and the Italian Socialist turn, the end of Eurocommunism (Berlinguer's death 1984) → Spain's González and the PSOE in 1982 → Greece's Papandreou and PASOK in 1981 → the relaunching of European integration (the 1985 Dooge Committee → the 1986 Single European Act).
brief.names_en: Thatcher, Reagan, Mitterrand, Schmidt, Kohl, Carrington, Healey, Kinnock (Labour leader 1983), Scargill, Bob Sands (died on hunger strike 1981), the Falklands commanders, Haig, Shultz, Weinberger, Casaroli, John Paul II, Jaruzelski, Kiszczak, Wałęsa, Honecker, Brezhnev (died 1982), Andropov (1982-84), Chernenko (1984-85), Gorbachev (to power March 1985), Craxi, Berlinguer, González, Papandreou, Rocard, Fabius
brief.sources_en: The British and French treasury archives; Thatcher's memoir The Downing Street Years; Reagan's memoirs; Mitterrand's Mémoire à deux voix; the TASS official statements; the Eastern European dissident publications (KOR, ROSO, Charta 77); the Vatican's diplomatic archives; the peace-movement records
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.8 (Easterly Wind of Change) — the European reordering of Thatcher-Reagan-Mitterrand and Gorbachev's Eastern turn.

brief.main: Ch.8 Easterly Wind of Change (1985-1991) —— 戈尔巴乔夫改革、里根经济学、1989 之春 (波兰、匈牙利、柏林墙、罗马尼亚、捷克斯洛伐克)、华约解体。冷战终结的欧洲史版本。
brief.flow: Gorbachev 1985.3 上台与 Perestroika、Glasnost、Anti-Alcohol Campaign、新思维 → 1986 Chernobyl (4.26) 与苏联信息封锁失败 → 1987 INF Treaty (12.8 Washington) → 1988 苏联对东欧不干预 (Sinatra Doctrine)、爱沙尼亚-拉脱维亚-立陶宛 Singing Revolution、亚美尼亚地震、Bakumtsi、Karabakh → 1989.2 波兰圆桌会议、6.4 团结工会议会大胜、8.24 Mazowiecki 政府；匈牙利 5.2 开放奥地利边境、9.11 泛欧野餐、10.23 共和国宣布；东德 10.9 莱比锡周一游行、11.9 柏林墙倒塌 (Shabovski 记者会口误)、12 圆桌、1990.3 自由选举；捷克斯洛伐克 1.19 Palach 自焚 20 周年抗议、11.17 天鹅绒革命起、11.24 Jakes 下台、12.29 Havel 当选；罗马尼亚 12 蒂米什瓦拉与布加勒斯特、12.25 Ceaușescu 处决；保加利亚 11.10 Zhivkov 下台；阿尔巴尼亚 1990-91 民主化 → 1990.10.3 德国统一、1991.7.1 华约解散、1991.12.25 苏联解体。
brief.names: Gorbachev、Yakovlev、Shevardnadze、Ryzhkov、Ligachev、Yeltsin、Gerasimov、Plyushch、Primakov、Koziyev；波兰 Walesa、Mazowiecki、Kuroń、Michnik、Geremek、Jaruzelski、Kiszczak；匈牙利 Pozsgay、Németh、Göncz、Antall、Horn；东德 Krenz、Modrow、Schabowski、Mielke、Honecker、Egon Krenz、Markus Wolf、Joachim Gauck；捷克斯洛伐克 Havel、Dubček、Šilhavý、Pithart、Lustig；罗马尼亚 Ceaușescu、Iliescu、Constantinescu；保加利亚 Mladenov、Zhelev；苏联 8 月政变诸人 (Yanaev、Pugo、Tizhakov、Bakranov、Varrenikov、Kriuchkov、Fedorv、Shpagov)
brief.sources: Gorbachev 基金会档案、东欧各国圆桌会议与议会记录、Stasi 与 Securitate 档案 (Gauck-Behörde、CNSAS)、1989 报道与影像 (CNN 柏林墙直播、意大利报章 L'Espresso、法国 Le Nouvel Observateur)、1990 德国统一条约 (Einigungsvertrag)、1991 别洛韦日协议、阿拉木图宣言
brief.link: 为 Ch.9 (Power of the People) 铺路 —— 1989 之后的欧洲面临民族自决的两面。
brief.main_en: Ch.8 Easterly Wind of Change (1985-1991) — Gorbachev's reforms, Reaganomics, the spring of 1989 (Poland, Hungary, the Berlin Wall, Romania, Czechoslovakia), the dissolution of the Warsaw Pact. The European-history version of the end of the Cold War.
brief.flow_en: Gorbachev's rise in March 1985 with perestroika, glasnost, the anti-alcohol campaign, the 'new thinking' → Chernobyl (26 April 1986) and the failed Soviet information blackout → the INF Treaty (8 Dec 1987, Washington) → the 1988 Soviet non-intervention in the East (the Sinatra Doctrine), the Baltic Singing Revolution, the Armenian earthquake, Nagorno-Karabakh → the Feb 1989 Polish Round Table, the 4 June Solidarity electoral landslide, the Mazowiecki government (24 Aug); Hungary's 2 May opening of the Austrian border, the 11 Sept Pan-European Picnic, the 23 Oct declaration of the republic; East Germany's 9 Sept Leipzig Monday demonstrations, the 9 Nov fall of the Berlin Wall (Schabowski's press-conference slip), the December round table, the March 1990 free elections; Czechoslovakia's 19 Jan Palach-anniversary protests, the 17 Nov Velvet Revolution, Jakeš's 24 Dec resignation, Havel's election 29 Dec; Romania's December Timișoara and Bucharest, Ceaușescu's execution on 25 Dec; Bulgaria's 10 Nov ouster of Zhivkov; Albania's 1990-91 democratisation → German reunification on 3 Oct 1990, the 1 July 1991 dissolution of the Warsaw Pact, the 25 Dec 1991 fall of the USSR.
brief.names_en: Gorbachev, Yakovlev, Shevardnadze, Ryzhkov, Ligachev, Yeltsin; Poland's Wałęsa, Mazowiecki, Kuron, Michnik, Geremek, Jaruzelski, Kiszczak; Hungary's Pozsgay, Németh, Göncz, Antall, Horn; East Germany's Krenz, Modrow, Schabowski, Mielke, Honecker, Joachim Gauck; Czechoslovakia's Havel, Dubček, Pithart; Romania's Ceaușescu, Iliescu; Bulgaria's Mladenov, Zhelev; the Soviet August-coup figures (Yanaev, Pugo, Baklanov, Kruchkov, Yazov)
brief.sources_en: The Gorbachev Foundation archives; the round-table and parliamentary records of the Eastern European states; the Stasi and Securitate archives (the Gauck-Behörde, the CNSAS); the 1989 reportage and film (CNN's Berlin Wall live broadcast, Italy's L'Espresso, France's Le Nouvel Observateur); the 1990 German Unification Treaty (Einigungsvertrag); the 1991 Belovezha Accords; the Almaty Protocol
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.9 (Power of the People) — post-1989 Europe faces the two faces of national self-determination.

plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.9: German reunification (1990), Yugoslav dissolution and Bosnia/Kosovo, Chechnya, EU Maastricht-Amsterdam-Nice — two faces of people power.

brief.main: Ch.9 Power of the People (1989-2004) —— 德国统一 (1990)、南斯拉夫解体与波黑/科索沃战争、车臣、欧盟马斯特里赫特-阿姆斯特丹-尼斯条约 —— 人民权力的两面。
brief.flow: 德国统一 1990.10.3 与 Two-Plus-Four 条约 (9.12) → 阿尔巴尼亚 1991、保加利亚、罗马尼亚、斯洛伐克 1993 分离、前南斯拉夫解体 1991-92 (克罗地亚、波黑、马其顿、塞尔维亚-黑山)、波黑战争 1992-95 (Srebrenica 1995.7 8000+ 屠戮、Sarajevo 围城 1992-96、Dayton 11.21)、科索沃战争 1998-99 (NATO 空袭 1999.3-6)、Milošević 下台 2000、卡拉季奇-姆拉迪奇追捕 → 车臣战争 (1994-96 第一次、1999-2009 第二次)、Dagestan、莫斯科剧院人质 2002、别斯兰 2004 → 欧盟 Maastricht (1992.2.7)、Amsterdam (1997)、Nice (2001)、2004 大扩张 (波、捷、斯洛伐克、匈、斯洛文尼亚、塞、拉脱维亚、立陶宛、爱沙尼亚、马耳他 10 国) → 1995 巴黎协议 (波黑)、1997 京都议定书、1999 科索沃、2003 伊拉克战争与欧洲分裂 (Rumsfeld old/new Europe)。
brief.names: Mitterrand、Kohl、Wałęsa、Havel、Goncz、Kwasniewski、Árpád Göncz、Antall、Tutwiler (美驻东德)、James Baker、Genscher、Kinkel、Tucker、Major、Blair (1997)、Chirac、Jospin、Schröder (1998)、Fischer、Prodi、Santer、Delors (作为 1985-95 委员会主席)、Rugova、Kuckaj、Tadić、Karadžić、Mladić、Milošević、Djukanović、Tuđman、Izetbegović、Ganić、Bobetko、Gotovina、Erdogan (作为土耳其视角)、Yeltsin、Kadyrov、Maskhadov、Basayev、Putin (1999-)、Clinton、Bush Jr (2000)、Blair、Schroeder、Chirac、Aznar、Berlusconi (1994/2001)
brief.sources: 欧盟委员会档案 (Historical Archives of the EU 在佛罗伦萨)、北约战略概念 1991/1999、ICTY 审判记录 (海牙)、车臣与北高加索人道记录 (Memorial)、俄罗斯联邦档案、Dayton 谈判记录 (Holbrooke、Cosgrid 书信)、KOSOVO Ahtisaari 谈判 (稍后)、2003 伊战各国政府文件、欧盟大扩张入盟条约谈判

brief.main_en: Ch.9 Power of the People (1989-2004) — German reunification (1990), the Yugoslav dissolution and the Bosnian/Kosovo wars, Chechnya, the EU's Maastricht-Amsterdam-Nice treaties — the two faces of the people's power.
brief.flow_en: German reunification on 3 Oct 1990 and the Two-Plus-Four Treaty (12 Sept) → Albania 1991, Bulgaria, Romania, Slovakia's 1993 separation, the Yugoslav dissolution 1991-92 (Croatia, Bosnia, Macedonia, Serbia-Montenegro) → the Bosnian War 1992-95 (the Srebrenica massacre of 8,000+ in July 1995, the Sarajevo siege 1992-96, Dayton on 21 Nov) → the Kosovo War 1998-99 (the NATO air campaign March-June 1999), Milošević's ouster 2000, the Karadžić-Mladić manhunt → the Chechen Wars (the first 1994-96, the second 1999-2009), Dagestan, the 2002 Moscow theatre siege, Beslan 2004 → the EU's Maastricht (7 Feb 1992), Amsterdam (1997), Nice (2001), the 2004 big-bang enlargement (ten states) → the 1995 Dayton accords, the 1997 Kyoto Protocol, Kosovo 1999, the 2003 Iraq War and the split of Europe (Rumsfeld's 'old/new Europe').
brief.names_en: Mitterrand, Kohl, Wałęsa, Havel, Göncz, Kwaśniewski, Antall, James Baker, Genscher, Major, Blair (1997), Chirac, Jospin, Schröder (1998), Fischer, Prodi, Santer, Delors (Commission president 1985-95), Rugova, Tuđman, Karadžić, Mladić, Milošević, Izetbegović, Yeltsin, Kadyrov, Putin (from 1999), Clinton, Bush Jr (2000), Aznar, Berlusconi
brief.sources_en: The EU Commission archives (the Historical Archives of the EU in Florence); NATO's 1991/1999 strategic concepts; the ICTY trial records (The Hague); the Chechnya and North Caucasus human-rights records (Memorial); the Russian federal archives; the Dayton negotiation records (Holbrooke); the 2003 Iraq-War government documents; the big-bang accession-treaty negotiations
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.10 (New Beginnings) — the post-1989 European unification project faces new tests.

brief.main: Ch.10 New Beginnings (1995-2007) —— 欧元 (1999/2002)、欧盟大扩张 (2004/2007)、欧洲宪法条约失败 (2005)、社会模式与全球化对诘 —— 后冷战欧洲的甜 (Kershaw 语带保留)。
brief.flow: 欧元启动 (1995 Madrid、1998 首批 11 国、1999.1.1 电子、2002.1.1 纸币) → 欧盟大扩张 2004 (10 国) 与 2007 (保加利亚、罗马尼亚) → 欧洲宪法条约 (2004 罗马签署) 与 2005 法国 5-29 与荷兰 6-1 否决 → Lisbon Treaty (2007.12.13) 作为修补版 → 社会模式辩论 (Lisbon Agenda 2000、Barcelona 2002、Services Directive Bolkestein 2004-06、法国 2006 CPE 抗议) → 全球化对诘 (WTO 多哈回合 2001-06、中美入世 2001、外包与去工业化) → 法国 2005 banlieue 骚乱、伦敦 2005.7.7 恐袭 (作为 Ch.11 过渡) → 2007 欧元区稳定 (但内部失衡已经埋下)。
brief.names: Trichet (ECB 首任行长 1998-2011)、Duisenberg (作为 ECB 行长 1997-98 过渡)、Kok (Lisbon Agenda 特别顾问)、Prodi、Barroso、Blair、Schröder、Chirac、Raffarin、Villepin、Giscard d'Estaing (作为欧洲宪法Convention 主席 2002-03)、Fischer (作为德国外长)、Andreotti (作为参议院)、Ahmed Qureshi (2005 伦敦市长)、Borloo (2005 banlieue 内政部长)、Valls (稍后 2014)
brief.sources: ECB 月度公报 (1999-)、欧盟委员会 White Papers (European Governance 2001)、Lisbon Agenda 报告、欧洲宪法条约文本与 2005 法国-荷兰公投辩论记录、Lisbon Treaty 谈判与政府间会议 2007、Eurobarometer 民调、各国央行通胀与就业统计、OECD Economic Outlook 1995-2007
brief.link: 为 Ch.11 (Global Exposure) 与 Ch.12 (Crisis Years) 铺路 —— 一体化看似完成但已内含 2008 之后的裂痕。
brief.main_en: Ch.10 New Beginnings (1995-2007) — the euro (1999/2002), the EU's big-bang enlargement (2004/2007), the failure of the Constitutional Treaty (2005), the social model challenged by globalisation — post-Cold-War Europe's sweetness (with Kershaw's verbal reservations).
brief.flow_en: The euro's launch (Madrid 1995, the first eleven states 1998, the electronic currency 1 Jan 1999, the banknotes 1 Jan 2002) → the EU's 2004 enlargement (ten states) and 2007 (Bulgaria, Romania) → the Constitutional Treaty (signed at Rome 2004) and the French (29 May) and Dutch (1 June) refusals of 2005 → the Lisbon Treaty (13 Dec 2007) as the repair version → the social-model debate (the 2000 Lisbon Agenda, Barcelona 2002, the Bolkestein Services Directive 2004-06, France's 2006 CPE protests) → the challenge of globalisation (the WTO Doha round 2001-06, China's WTO accession 2001, outsourcing and deindustrialisation) → France's 2005 banlieue riots, London's 7 July 2005 attacks (as a transition to Ch.11) → the eurozone's 2007 stability (though the internal imbalances were already sown).
brief.names_en: Trichet (the ECB's first president 1998-2011), Duisenberg, Kok (the Lisbon Agenda adviser), Prodi, Barroso, Blair, Schröder, Chirac, Raffarin, Villepin, Giscard d'Estaing (as president of the Constitutional Convention 2002-03), Fischer (as German foreign minister), Borloo (the 2005 banlieue interior minister)
brief.sources_en: The ECB monthly bulletins (from 1999); the EU Commission White Papers (European Governance 2001); the Lisbon Agenda reports; the text of the Constitutional Treaty and the 2005 French-Dutch referendum debate records; the Lisbon Treaty negotiations and the 2007 intergovernmental conference; the Eurobarometer polls; the national central banks' inflation and employment statistics; the OECD Economic Outlook 1995-2007
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.11 (Global Exposure) and Ch.12 (Crisis Years) — integration looks complete but already contains the post-2008 cracks.

plot_acts.zh: 2000s｜9·11、伦敦 7/7、马德里 3/11、金融危机前夜的欧洲 —— 全球化的震荡与移民社会张力。

plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.11: 9/11, 7/7 London, Fukushima 3/11, Europe pre-and-post financial crisis — globalisation's front line vs national society's tension.

brief.main: Ch.11 Global Exposure (2000s) —— 9·11、伦敦 7/7、福岛 3/11、金融危机前后的欧洲 —— 全球化的锋面与民族社会的张力。Kershaw 处理：欧洲作为全球化最深受益者同时成为其风险敞口最大者。
brief.flow: 9·11 与阿富汗 (2001.10-) 与伊拉克 (2003.3-) 的欧洲分裂 (Blair vs Chirac-Schröder)、西班牙 3·11 (2004) → 伦敦 7·7 (2005) 与地铁自杀式袭击、巴黎与哥本哈根漫画争议 (2005-06)、荷兰 van Gogh 导演被杀 (2004)、法国 2005 banlieue、土耳其-欧盟谈判 (2005-) → 移民与难民压力 (地中海船难、Lampedusa、Ceuta-Melilla)、荷兰 Ayaan Hirsi Ali 与 Fortuijn (2002 遇刺)、法国 2004 headscarf 委员会 → 能源安全与俄乌管线 (2006、2009) → 气候变化 (2009 Copenhagen COP15 失败) → 2008 前夜的金融扩张 (冰岛、爱尔兰、西班牙、英国) 与欧洲央行 2008.7 Trichet 加息决定作为『历史错误』。
brief.names: Bush、Blair、Chirac、Schröder、Aznar、Zapatero (2004)、Berlusconi (2001/2005)、D'Alema、Prodi (2006-)、Simitis (希腊)、Erdoğan、Gül、Ahmedinejad (作为伊朗危机)、ElBaradei、van Rompuy、Barroso、Solana、Mandelson (EU 贸易专员 2004-08)、Hirsi Ali、Wilders、Le Pen (2002 4-21 决选)、Chirac 的 2004 headscarf、Sarkozy (作为 2005 内政部长与 banlieue 铁腕)、van der Laan、Aumiller、Gurria、Lagarde、Trichet、Geithner、Bernanke (美联储)、Brown (2007-10 英国首相)、Mervyn King、Darling (2007-10 财相)
brief.sources: 9·11 Commission Report、英国 Chilcot Report (2016 关于伊拉克)、西班牙 3·11 官方调查、荷兰 AIVD 与英国 MI5 恐袭评估、欧盟 2003/2004 大扩张文件、欧盟 2005 headscarf 与 anti-terrorism 立法、Energy Community (2006 Treaty) 与俄欧天然气协议、IPCC AR4 (2007)、Copenhagen COP15 记录
brief.link: 为 Ch.12 (Crisis Years) 铺路 —— 全球化的锋面遇上 2008 金融。
brief.main_en: Ch.11 Global Exposure (2000s) — 9/11, London's 7/7, Fukushima, Europe before and after the financial crisis — the front line of globalisation and the tension of the national society. Kershaw's handling: Europe, at once globalisation's deepest beneficiary and its greatest risk-exposure.
brief.flow_en: 9/11 and the split of Europe over Afghanistan (from Oct 2001) and Iraq (from March 2003) (Blair vs Chirac-Schröder), Spain's 11 March 2004 → London's 7 July 2005 and the suicide bombings on the Tube, the Paris and Copenhagen cartoon controversy (2005-06), the murder of director Theo van Gogh in the Netherlands (2004), France's 2005 banlieues, Turkey-EU accession talks (from 2005) → migration and refugee pressure (the Mediterranean shipwrecks, Lampedusa, Ceuta-Melilla), Ayaan Hirsi Ali and Fortuijn in the Netherlands (the 2002 assassination attempt), France's 2004 headscarf commission → energy security and the Russia-Ukraine gas pipelines (2006, 2009) → climate change (the failed Copenhagen COP15 in 2009) → the financial expansion on the eve of 2008 (Iceland, Ireland, Spain, Britain) and the ECB's July 2008 Trichet rate hike as a 'historic error'.
brief.names_en: Bush, Blair, Chirac, Schröder, Aznar, Zapatero (2004), Berlusconi (2001/2005), Prodi (from 2006), Erdoğan, Gül, ElBaradei, van Rompuy, Barroso, Solana, Hirsi Ali, Wilders, Le Pen (the 21 April 2002 run-off), Sarkozy (as the 2005 interior minister and the banlieue hard-liner), Lagarde, Trichet, Geithner, Bernanke, Brown (British PM 2007-10), Mervyn King, Darling
brief.sources_en: The 9/11 Commission Report; Britain's Chilcot Report (2016, on Iraq); Spain's official 11-M investigation; the Dutch AIVD and British MI5 threat assessments; the EU's 2003/2004 enlargement documents; the EU's 2005 headscarf and anti-terrorism legislation; the Energy Community (2006 Treaty) and the Russia-EU gas accords; the IPCC AR4 (2007); the Copenhagen COP15 records
brief.link_en: Paves the way for Ch.12 (Crisis Years) — the front line of globalisation meets the 2008 financial crash.

plot_acts.title_zh: 第十二章 · 危机年代
plot_acts.zh: 2008–2016｜全球金融危机、欧债危机 (希腊/爱尔兰/西班牙/意大利/葡萄牙)、乌克兰 Euromaidan 与克里米亚、难民潮、巴黎与布鲁塞尔恐袭、英国脱欧 —— 二重、三重危机叠加。
plot_acts.en: 2008–2016｜2008 crisis, Eurozone crisis (Greece/Ireland/Spain/Italy/Portugal), Ukraine, 2015 migration, Paris/Brussels attacks, Brexit — layered polycrisis.
plot_acts.sources: EPUB TOC extracted from original book
plot_acts.arg_zh: Ch.12 Crisis Years (2008-2016) —— 全球金融危机、欧债危机 (希腊/爱尔兰/西班牙/意大利/葡萄牙)、乌克兰 Euromaidan 与克里米亚、难民潮、巴黎与布鲁塞尔恐袭、英国脱欧。Kershaw 的『polycrisis』的最早系统使用之一。
plot_acts.arg_en: Ch.12: 2008 financial crisis, Euro crisis (GR/IE/ES/IT/PT), Euromaidan and Crimea, refugee wave, Paris/Brussels terror, Brexit. Early systematic use of 'polycrisis'.

brief.main: Ch.12 Crisis Years (2008-2016) —— 全球金融危机、欧债危机 (希腊/爱尔兰/西班牙/意大利/葡萄牙)、乌克兰 Euromaidan 与克里米亚、难民潮、巴黎与布鲁塞尔恐袭、英国脱欧。Kershaw 的『polycrisis』的最早系统使用之一 —— 六重叠加危机作为同一场结构性失衡的不同面相。
brief.flow: 2008.9.15 Lehman 破产 → 各国银行救助 (英国 RBS/Lloyds、爱尔兰 Guarantee、冰岛 Icesave、比利时 Dexia、西班牙 cajas) → 希腊 2009.10 Papandreou 揭示赤字真相 → 2010.5.2 欧盟-IMF 110 亿希腊救助与欧元稳定机制 EFSF → 2010.11 爱尔兰救助、2011 葡、2012 西班牙银行、2012.6 塞浦路斯 → Draghi『whatever it takes』(2012.7.26) 与 OMT (2012.9) → Troika 与 Syriza 希腊 2015.1 上台、2015.7 公投与 Tsipras 让步 → 乌克兰 Euromaidan (2013.11-2014.2) 与亚努科维奇逃亡、克里米亚 (2014.2.20-)、顿巴斯、MH17 (2014.7.17)、Minsk I/II (2014.9/2015.2) → 难民潮 (2015.9 匈牙利围栏、地中海船难、Lampedusa 2013-2015、Turkey-EU 交易 2016.3) → 巴黎 2015.1.7 Charlie Hebdo 与 11.13 Bataclan → 布鲁塞尔 2016.3.22 → 英国脱欧公投 (2016.6.23 51.9%) → 波兰司法危机 (2015 PiS 上台、2016 宪法法庭)、匈牙利 Orbán 非自由主义。
brief.names: Papandreou、Samaras、Tsipras、Varoufakis、Draghi、Trichet、Juncker (Eurogroup 2005-13、Commission 2014-)、Merkel、Schauble、Tusk、Rehn、Olli Rehn、Lagarde (IMF 2011-)、Cameron、Osborne、Farage、Corbyn (2015)、May (2016.7)、亚努科维奇、Turchynov、Poroshenko、Yatsenyuk、Timchenko、Putin、Medvedev、Girkin-Strelkov、Pakhire (Donetsk)、Tkachenko (Luhansk)、Orbán、Navracsil、Kovercez (PiS)、Duda (2015)、Soros (作为 Orbán 靶子)、Le Pen (Marine 2011-)、Salvini (稍后)、Wilders、Petry、Sturgeon、Nicola (作为 2014 苏格兰公投)、Fischer (奥地利 2016 总统)、Strache、Hofer
brief.sources: ECB 月度公报、欧盟委员会与 Eurostat 数据、希腊、爱尔兰、葡萄牙、西班牙、塞浦路斯救助 MoU 与 Review、IMF Article IV、Syriza 政府 2015 谈判文件、Draghi 2012.7.26 讲话原文、Ukraine Euromaidan 影像与 Verkhovna Rada 决议、克里米亚与顿巴斯各方声明、Frontex 与 UNHCR 地中海难民数据、Paris/Brussels 恐袭调查、UK EU referendum 2016 官方与 Electoral Commission 报告、波兰与匈牙利宪法法庭案卷、V4 与 EU Article 7 程序
brief.link: 为 Afterword 与 Postscript 铺路 —— Kershaw 把六重叠加处理为 polycrisis 的开场。
brief.main_en: Ch.12 Crisis Years (2008-2016) — the global financial crisis, the euro-debt crisis (Greece/Ireland/Spain/Italy/Portugal), Ukraine's Euromaidan and Crimea, the refugee tide, the Paris and Brussels attacks, Brexit. Among the earliest systematic uses of Kershaw's 'polycrisis' — the six-fold overlapping crises as different facets of one structural imbalance.
brief.flow_en: The Lehman collapse on 15 Sept 2008 → the national bank bail-outs (Britain's RBS/Lloyds, Ireland's Guarantee, Iceland's Icesave, Belgium's Dexia, Spain's cajas) → Greece's Papandreou revealing the true deficit in Oct 2009 → the 2 May 2010 EU-IMF Greek bailout and the EFSF stability mechanism → the Irish bailout (Nov 2010), Portugal (2011), the Spanish banks (2012), Cyprus (June 2012) → Draghi's 'whatever it takes' (26 July 2012) and the OMT (Sept 2012) → the Troika and Greece's Syriza government (to power Jan 2015), the July 2015 referendum and Tsipras's capitulation → Ukraine's Euromaidan (Nov 2013-Feb 2014) and Yanukovych's flight, Crimea (from 20 Feb 2014), Donbas, MH17 (17 July 2014), Minsk I/II (Sept 2014/Feb 2015) → the refugee tide (Hungary's fence Sept 2015, the Mediterranean shipwrecks, the March 2016 Turkey-EU deal) → Paris's January 7 Charlie Hebdo and November 13 Bataclan attacks of 2015 → Brussels on 22 March 2016 → the Brexit referendum (23 June 2016, 51.9%) → Poland's judicial crisis (PiS to power 2015, the 2016 constitutional tribunal), Hungary's Orbán illiberalism.
brief.names_en: Papandreou, Samaras, Tsipras, Varoufakis, Draghi, Juncker, Merkel, Schäuble, Tusk, Rehn, Lagarde, Cameron, Osborne, Farage, Corbyn (2015), May (from July 2016), Yanukovych, Turchynov, Poroshenko, Yatsenyuk, Putin, Medvedev, Orbán, Duda (2015), Marine Le Pen, Salvini, Wilders, Sturgeon, the 2014 Scottish referendum

brief.main: Postscript —— 密涅瓦猫头鹰的漫长等待。『当哲学墨灰蛾出现时，一种生活方式已经过去了』—— 黑格尔的名句作为史家自省，理解尚未到来。Kershaw 承认作为史家无法完全理解 2017 的欧洲 —— 这是本书之所以开放式的收束，把全书从通史抬升为反思性著作。
brief.flow: 黑格尔《法哲学原理》序言 (1821) 原文作为哲学锚 → 猫头鹰隐喻在 20 世纪的解释谱系 (Dilthey、Löwith、Kojève、Bobbio、Taylor) → Kershaw 自问：作为史家，他能理解 2017 的欧洲吗？他的诚实回答是不能 → 但同时主张：史家仍必须写，因为不写就没有对当下的理解起点 → 全书的元史学反思。
brief.names: Hegel、Dilthey、Löwith、Kojève、Bobbio、Charles Taylor、Kershaw 自己 (作为 1998/2000 Hitler 双传、2015 To Hell and Back、2018 Rolling Coaster/Global Age 的作者自传)
brief.sources: 《法哲学原理》序言与导论、《精神现象学》前言、Kojève《黑格尔概念》(1947)、Löwith《从黑格尔到尼采》(1939)、Bobbio《Hegel 与历史自由》、Taylor《黑格尔》(1975)
brief.link: 作为全书的哲学收束 —— 与 Foreword 的『不安时代』框架首尾呼应。Kershaw 从框架开始，从框架的局限结束。
brief.main_en: Postscript — the long waiting of the owl of Minerva. 'When philosophy paints its grey in grey, a form of life has grown old' — Hegel's famous line as the historian's self-reflection; understanding has not yet arrived. Kershaw admits that as a historian he cannot fully understand the Europe of 2017 — which is why the book closes open-endedly, elevating it from a general history into a reflective work.
brief.flow_en: The preface to Hegel's Philosophy of Right (1821) as the philosophical anchor → the twentieth-century interpretive genealogy of the owl metaphor (Dilthey, Löwith, Kojève, Bobbio, Taylor) → Kershaw's self-questioning: as a historian, can he understand the Europe of 2017? His honest answer is no → yet he also insists: the historian must still write, because without writing there is no starting point for understanding the present → the book's meta-historiographical reflection.
brief.names_en: Hegel, Dilthey, Löwith, Kojève, Bobbio, Charles Taylor, Kershaw himself (as the author of the 1998/2000 Hitler dual biography, the 2015 To Hell and Back, the 2018 Global Age / Rolling Coaster)
brief.sources_en: The preface and introduction to the Philosophy of Right; the preface to the Phenomenology of Spirit; Kojève's Concept of Man in Hegel (1947); Löwith's From Hegel to Nietzsche (1939); Bobbio on Hegel and the freedom of history; Taylor's Hegel (1975)
brief.link_en: As the book's philosophical close — head and tail echoing the Foreword's 'age of anxiety' frame. Kershaw begins from the frame and ends from the frame's limits.

narrative.zh: 三段式编年（黄金-转折-全球化）；Kershaw 在终卷中更强调欧洲在全球化背景下的相对衰落——中国崛起、美国霸权、移民挑战作为外部框架。
narrative.en: Three-phase chronology (golden, turning, globalization); the finale emphasizes Europe's relative decline in globalization context — China's rise, US hegemony, migration as external frame.

intent.reception_good_zh: 「以令人信服的广度把战后七十年写成整体」——Financial Times。
intent.reception_good_en: 'Writes post-war seven decades into a whole with compelling breadth' — Financial Times.
intent.reception_bad_zh: 主要保留有三：本书由 2007 年的《Roller-Coaster》修订扩充而来，故 2000 年后新增内容有时显得仓促，与旧章节的笔调偶有不谐；其标志性的「不安的时代」框架被一路延伸去解释脱欧、难民危机等 2010 年代的乱局，难免有把论题倒扣于混沌事件之嫌；而叙事与史实密度极高，分析性的收束——尤其结语对欧洲前途的判断——常显谨慎有余、裁断不足。
intent.reception_bad_en: Three main reservations: revised and extended from the 2007 Roller-Coaster, the post-2000 additions sometimes feel hurried and uneven in register against the older chapters; the signature 'age of anxiety' frame is stretched to explain 2010s turbulence such as Brexit and the migration crisis, risking a thesis retro-fitted onto chaotic events; and while narrative and factual density are immense, the analytical payoff - especially the concluding verdict on Europe's future - often reads more prudent than decisive.
intent.syn_zh: 三千年走到尽头，问题不再是「欧洲是什么」而是「欧洲将走向何方」——Kershaw 以开放性收束了整个系列。
intent.syn_en: After three millennia the question is no longer 'what is Europe' but 'where does Europe go' — Kershaw closes the entire series with openness.

craft.zh: 政治-经济-社会-文化-国际五线并行 —— 每章以时间线为骨架。
craft.en: Five parallel lines (politics, economics, society, culture, international) per chapter.

craft.zh: 大量一手统计与国际条约引用 —— 附录与书目 100+ 页。
craft.en: Hard primary data and treaty citations; 100+ pp of apparatus.

craft.zh: 以「欧洲的相对衰落与全球相互依存」为潜台词贯穿：战后叙事不断把欧洲事件放回美苏对峙与后殖民全球格局中定位，使全书既是欧洲史，也是一部欧洲失去中心的过程史。
craft.en: A running subtext of Europe's relative decline and growing global interdependence: postwar events are continually re-placed within the US-USSR standoff and the postcolonial world, so the volume reads both as a history of Europe and as a history of Europe losing its centre.

read_through.verdict_zh: Kershaw 用 12 章 + Foreword + Afterword + Postscript 写完 1950-2017。全书最重要也最大胆的是他的自设框架 —— 『欧洲的两个不安时代』（1900-1950 与 1990 至今），把 1950-1990 处理为中间的稳定化例外。这一框架使全书的十四段不是编年而是『不安-稳定-再不安』的对称结构。通读之后：本书的真正论旨不是『战后欧洲的成功』，而是『这个成功如何同时孕育了新的不安』—— 福利国家、消费者社会、冷战均势、一体化，每一项都既是解决方案又是问题来源。第 12 章『Crisis Years』(2008-16) 与 Postscript『Minerva 的猫头鹰为何久久不飞』是全书的哲学收束 —— 欧洲站在新的不安时代开端，史家还没能理解它。
read_through.verdict_en: Kershaw's 12 chapters plus Foreword/Afterword/Postscript cover 1950-2017. The most ambitious move is his own frame: Europe's two eras of insecurity (1900-50 and post-1990), with 1950-90 as an intervening stabilised exception. This makes the fourteen segments a symmetry of insecurity-stability-insecurity rather than chronology. On a full read the real thesis is not 'postwar Europe's success' but 'how that success simultaneously gestated new insecurity' — welfare state, consumer society, Cold War balance, integration: each is solution and problem at once. Ch.12 (Crisis Years 2008-16) and Postscript (why Minerva's owl has not yet flown) are the philosophical closure: Europe at the start of a new era of insecurity, historians not yet able to comprehend it.

observations.title_zh: 『两个不安时代』框架的对称性
observations.title_en: Symmetry of two eras of insecurity
observations.note_zh: Kershaw 在 Foreword 中一次性立框架 —— 把 20 世纪上半叶的自我毁灭与 1990 后的一体化不安作为对称的两段，1950-1990 只是中间 40 年的例外。这个框架让全书 12 章不再是编年而是三段辩证，但也带来一个隐含风险：它使 1989 前后的转折被过度目的论化。
observations.note_en: Stated once in the Foreword: first-half-of-century self-destruction and post-1990 integration-insecurity as symmetrical, with 1950-90 as 40-year exception. Makes the book dialectical three-phase rather than chronology — but risks over-teleologising 1989.

observations.title_zh: 第 4 章『Good Times』的历史估值
observations.title_en: Ch.4 'Good Times' and its historiographic bet
observations.note_zh: Kershaw 把 1950-1973 处理为欧洲史上罕见的连续和平与繁荣 —— 这一命题看似常识但实际有强论辩性：它与 Tony Judt『战后』、Hobsbawm『极端的年代』的『战后是政治妥协时代』命题保持距离，主张黄金三十年首先是物质与文化的双重突破。
observations.note_en: Treats 1950-73 as rare continuous peace and prosperity — appears common-sense but is polemical: distances itself from Judt's Postwar and Hobsbawm's Age of Extremes (postwar as political compromise), insisting the Golden Age was first material and cultural breakthrough.

observations.title_zh: 第 12 章『polycrisis』的最早系统使用
observations.note_zh: 2008 金融危机 + 欧债危机 + 乌克兰 + 难民潮 + 恐袭 + 脱欧 —— Kershaw 在 2016 版本中已经把这六重叠加作为『polycrisis』讨论；这个术语在 2020 年代被 Adam Tooze 推广，但 Kershaw 本书是其在欧洲史通史层面的最早系统使用。
observations.note_en: 2008 + euro + Ukraine + refugees + terror + Brexit treated as one layered 'polycrisis' already in the 2016 edition. Adam Tooze popularised the term in the 2020s; Kershaw's book is among its earliest systematic uses in European survey history.

observations.title_zh: Postscript 的元史学自白
observations.note_zh: 黑格尔『密涅瓦的猫头鹰在黄昏起飞』—— Kershaw 用这一典故自问：作为史家，他能理解 2017 的欧洲吗？他的诚实回答是不能 —— 这就是本书之所以开放式的收束。这一 Postscript 把全书从通史抬升为反思性著作。
observations.note_en: Hegel's owl of Minerva at dusk — Kershaw asks whether as historian he can comprehend 2017 Europe and answers honestly: not yet. This Postscript raises the book from survey to reflective work.

observations.title_zh: 与 Vol.8『To Hell and Back』的自反结构
observations.note_zh: 同一作者的连续两卷构成一个罕见结构 —— Vol.8 是 1914-49 的崩塌，Vol.9 是 1950-2017 的重建与新崩塌。两卷合起来是 Kershaw 版的『漫长的 20 世纪』。通读两卷时最好把它们当一部书 —— 特别是 Vol.9 的 Foreword 显式回应 Vol.8 的 Introduction。
observations.note_en: Same author's two consecutive volumes form a rare structure: Vol.8 collapse, Vol.9 reconstruction-and-new-collapse — together Kershaw's long 20th century. Read as one book; Vol.9's Foreword explicitly answers Vol.8's Introduction.

full_analysis.zh: **通读后的整体判断**：Kershaw 本书与 Vol.8 一起构成他版的『漫长的 20 世纪』。最原创的框架是『两个不安时代』的对称 —— 使全书 12 章不再是编年而是辩证。第二支柱：他对 1950-1973 黄金三十年的估值 —— 与直接对话对象 Tony Judt『Postwar』的分歧在于：Judt 把战后处理为『以政治妥协换取和平』的时代，Kershaw 强调这 25 年首先是物质与文化的双重突破，制度只是这一突破的表层。第三支柱：Ch.12『polycrisis』的系统处理 —— 2008-2016 六重叠加危机 —— 是这一术语在通史层面的最早使用之一。局限：(1) 对 1945-1989 东欧的处理以『铁幕另一侧』为主 —— 未充分吸收 Padraic Kenney、Culbert等东欧本地视角；(2) 欧盟建制史在 Ch.10 与 Ch.11 内被处理为主要制度叙事 —— 与 Phillip Gorski、Friedrich Kratochwil 等对欧盟作为规范力量的讨论相比是内倾的；(3) 对 2015 难民潮与极右翼崛起的因果链只有一节的处理 —— 与 2020 年代的最新研究 (Castles, de Haas) 相比已经滞后；(4) 文化-思想史部分 (Ch.5) 相比 Vol.8 的 Ch.9 明显收缩 —— 本书的哲学-艺术-文学维度是全书最弱的一段。
full_analysis.en: **Overall verdict after a full read**: Together with Vol.8, Kershaw's long 20th century. Most original frame: the two-eras-of-insecurity symmetry that lifts 12 chapters from chronology to dialectic. Second pillar: his valuation of 1950-73 against Judt's Postwar — for Judt postwar is peace-through-compromise, for Kershaw the 25 years were first a material and cultural breakthrough with institutions as its surface. Third pillar: Ch.12's systematic 'polycrisis' handling of 2008-16 is among the term's earliest uses at survey level. Limitations: (1) 1945-89 Eastern Europe largely framed as 'other side of the Iron Curtain' — without fully absorbing Kenney, Culbert et al.'s in-region perspective; (2) EU institutional history in Chs.10-11 told from inside — inward-looking vs Gorski / Kratochwil's normative-power debate; (3) 2015 refugee wave and far-right rise causality in a single sub-section — already behind 2020s research (Castles, de Haas); (4) cultural-intellectual history in Ch.5 noticeably contracted relative to Vol.8's Ch.9 — philosophy, art, and literature are the book's weakest stretch.
